```/Core/Connections/aliasMemory.ts diff
@@ -52 +52 @@ export function applyAliasEdit(worn: readonly string[], e: AliasEdit, title: str
     }
   }
 }
+
+/** The edit that takes back an add of `alias`: re-adding the spelling it respelled, forgetting the alias it appended, or none when it changed nothing. */
+export function addUndo(
+  worn: readonly string[],
+  alias: string,
+  title: string,
+): AliasEdit | undefined {
+  const named = alias.trim()
+  if (!keepsAlias(named, title)) return undefined
+  const was = heldAliases(worn, title).find((a) => normalizeTitle(a) === normalizeTitle(named))
+  if (was === undefined) return { op: 'forget', alias: named }
+  return was === named ? undefined : { op: 'add', alias: was }
+}
```

##### Core/Index/keyHolders.ts

```/Core/Index/keyHolders.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// Key holders: which pages and Spaces hold a key, found from the content index and the tree, and what each one holds.
+
+import { queryMembers, readPageRelations } from './contentIndex'
+import { nexusCorpus } from './indexSeed'
+import { parseJsonObject, readTextOrNull } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { splitFrontmatter, sweepParse } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import type { Json } from '../Files/stableJson'
+import { parseContextKey } from '../Contexts/contexts'
+import { isBlankRaw } from '../Files/rootValues'
+import { collectionFolders, rootId } from '../Nexus/governedSweep'
+import { addressable, nexusPages } from '../Nexus/heldPages'
+import { liveTreeOf } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import type { NexusTree, SpaceNode } from '../Nexus/tree'
+import { archiveReach } from '../Nexus/treePatch'
+import { exactTitle } from '../Paths/caseFold'
+import { SPACE_SIDECAR } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { isAtOrUnder, isMarkdownFile, join, relative } from '../Paths/posix'
+
+type Reach = 'governed' | { collection: string } | 'anywhere'
+
+/** A folder an op moved ahead of its sweep, root-relative. */
+export type FolderMove = { from: string; to: string }
+
+export type HolderQuery = {
+  keys: readonly string[]
+  reach: Reach
+  title?: string
+  id?: string
+  moved?: FolderMove
+}
+
+/** A holder a finder read: the id `byId` addresses it by, the query keys it holds, their values as written, or null when it couldn't be read, and, for a page read from its own file, the key each one's line stood above, in the page's own key order. */
+export type Held = {
+  file: string
+  id: string | null
+  keys: string[]
+  values: Json | null
+  above: Record<string, string | undefined>
+}
+
+export type Holders = { files: string[]; held: Held[] }
+
+/** The pages among `rels`, or among the whole corpus before the index is ready, that `reach` holds, as absolute paths. */
+export async function pagesInReach(
+  root: string,
+  tree: NexusTree,
+  rels: readonly string[] | null,
+  reach: Reach,
+): Promise<string[]> {
+  const files = (rels ?? (await nexusCorpus(root))).map((rel) => join(root, rel))
+  if (reach === 'anywhere') return files
+  const only = reach === 'governed' ? undefined : reach.collection
+  const archive = archiveReach(tree, only && relative(root, only))
+  const folders = [
+    ...(only === undefined ? collectionFolders(root, tree) : [only]),
+    ...(archive === null ? [] : [join(root, archive)]),
+  ]
+  return files.filter((abs) => folders.some((folder) => abs.startsWith(`${folder}/`)))
+}
+
+/** Where `rel` sits once `moved` has moved the folder holding it. */
+export const movedTo = (rel: string, moved?: FolderMove): string =>
+  moved && isAtOrUnder(rel, moved.from) ? `${moved.to}${rel.slice(moved.from.length)}` : rel
+
+const sidecarAt = (root: string, rel: string, moved?: FolderMove): string =>
+  join(root, movedTo(rel, moved), SPACE_SIDECAR)
+
+/** The sidecar of each Space the tree holds that `holds` answers for, at the folder `moved` sent it to when the tree still lists the one it left. */
+export const spaceFiles = (
+  root: string,
+  tree: NexusTree,
+  holds: (space: SpaceNode) => boolean,
+  moved?: FolderMove,
+): string[] =>
+  tree.contexts.flatMap((g) => g.spaces.filter(holds).map((s) => sidecarAt(root, s.path, moved)))
+
+// The pages and Spaces holding any of `keys`: pages from the content index (the corpus before it's ready), Spaces from the tree. A property's key means something only where a schema governs it, so `governed` reaches the pages of Collections and the Archive, and `{ collection }` one Collection's and its Archive's; a Context tag means something on any page, so `anywhere` reaches every one. Both of those reach every Space holding the key, every Space whose row order lists `id`, and every Space the tree couldn't read, which may hold anything. `title` narrows a Context key's pages to those naming that Space, and `moved` points a Space under a folder the op moved ahead of the tree.
+// With `read`, each file is read once: `held` lists each one holding a key or that couldn't be read, with the keys the index last read it holding, and `files` leaves out a holder no id addresses, which a strip passes over since no restore could put its value back.
+export async function findHolders(root: string, q: HolderQuery, read?: 'values'): Promise<Holders> {
+  const tree = await liveTreeOf(root)
+  const title = q.title === undefined ? undefined : exactTitle(q.title)
+  const rels = q.keys.map((key) => queryMembers(key, title))
+  const pages = await pagesInReach(
+    root,
+    tree,
+    rels.includes(null) ? null : [...new Set(rels.flatMap((r) => r ?? []))],
+    q.reach,
+  )
+  const holds = (s: SpaceNode): boolean =>
+    q.keys.some((key) =>
+      Object.hasOwn(s[parseContextKey(key) === null ? 'values' : 'contextKeys'] ?? {}, key),
+    ) ||
+    (q.id !== undefined && !!s.rowOrder?.includes(q.id))
+  const spaces =
+    typeof q.reach === 'string'
+      ? [
+          ...spaceFiles(root, tree, holds, q.moved),
+          ...(tree.unreadable ?? []).flatMap((u) =>
+            u.kind === 'space' ? [sidecarAt(root, u.path, q.moved)] : [],
+          ),
+        ]
+      : []
+  const files = [...pages, ...spaces]
+  if (!read) return { files, held: [] }
+  const listed = rels.map((r) => r && new Set(r))
+  const { byId } = await nexusPages(root, tree)
+  const held: Held[] = []
+  const heldOut = new Set<string>()
+  for (const file of files) {
+    const text = await readTextOrNull(file)
+    const page = text !== null && isMarkdownFile(file) ? sweepParse(text) : null
+    const rel = relative(root, file)
+    // An unreadable page answers the index's last read of it, so a delete's Trash entry keeps what its strip can't reach yet; a readable one answers its file, whose parsed values the index's JSON doesn't always carry.
+    const raw =
+      text !== null
+        ? isMarkdownFile(file)
+          ? (page?.raw ?? splitFrontmatter(text))
+          : parseJsonObject(text)
+        : isMarkdownFile(file)
+          ? ((readPageRelations([rel])?.pages[rel]?.values as Json | undefined) ?? null)
+          : null
+    const keys = q.keys.filter((k, i) => (raw ? Object.hasOwn(raw, k) : !!listed[i]?.has(rel)))
+    if (raw && !keys.length) continue
+    const id = raw ? rootId(file, raw) : undefined
+    const addressed = addressable(byId, id) ? id : null
+    if (raw && addressed === null) heldOut.add(file)
+    held.push({
+      file,
+      id: addressed,
+      keys,
+      values: raw && Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, raw[k]])),
+      above: Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, page?.above(k)])),
+    })
+  }
+  return { files: files.filter((file) => !heldOut.has(file)), held }
+}
+
+/** Each addressed holder's value under `key`, by its id, a blank one left out. */
+export const heldValues = (held: readonly Held[], key: string): Record<string, unknown> =>
+  Object.fromEntries(
+    held.flatMap((h) =>
+      h.id && h.values && !isBlankRaw(h.values[key]) ? [[h.id, h.values[key]]] : [],
+    ),
+  )
+
+/** Each addressed holder's `above` under `key`, by its id, as `heldValues` files its value. */
+export const heldAbove = (held: readonly Held[], key: string): Record<string, string> =>
+  Object.fromEntries(held.flatMap((h) => (h.id && h.above[key] ? [[h.id, h.above[key]]] : [])))
+
+/** The holders a values read leaves out of `files` because no id addresses them (none, or one another file shares): each keeps its value and counts as unfinished, since no restore could put it back. */
+export const unaddressed = (held: readonly Held[]): number =>
+  held.filter((h) => h.values && !h.id).length
```

```/Core/Interface/Notifications/notifications.ts diff
+/** Every refusal of something the user did reaches them here, offering Try Again when a retry is given; the answer says whether it went through. */
+export function reportRefusal<T>(r: Result<T>, retry?: () => void): r is { ok: true; value: T } {
+  if (r.ok) return true
+  if (retry) notifyRetry(r.error.message, retry)
+  else notifyReport(r.error.message, true)
+  return false
 }
```

```/Core/Nexus/cascade.ts diff
+export async function relinkReach(root: string, e: RelinkEntry): Promise<ConfigReach> {
+  const names = new Map(Object.entries(e.names))
+  if (e.files) {
+    const here = async (files: string[]): Promise<string[]> =>
+      (
+        await Promise.all(
+          files.map(async (f) => ((await pathExists(join(root, f))) ? [join(root, f)] : [])),
+        )
+      ).flat()
+    const landed = await sweepGovernedRoots(await here(Object.keys(e.values ?? {})), {
+      raw: (r, f) => landWorked(r, e.values?.[relative(root, f)]),
+    })
+    const { text, spaceMoved } = fileRewrites(root, await liveTreeOf(root), (t) =>
+      rewriteConnections(t, names),
+    )
+    const rekey = e.rekey && rekeyContext(...e.rekey)
+    const raw: Rewrite = rekey
+      ? (r, f) => rekey(spaceMoved(r, f) ?? r, f) ?? spaceMoved(r, f)
+      : spaceMoved
+    const swept = await sweepGovernedRoots(await here(e.files), { text, raw })
+    const missed = (k: 'skipped' | 'refused'): string[] => [...new Set([...landed[k], ...swept[k]])]
+    return { skipped: missed('skipped').length, refused: missed('refused'), hosts: [] }
+  }
+  const { missed, hosts, pages } = await renameCascade(root, { names, label: e.label })
+  return { ...missed, hosts, pages }
+}
+
+/** A move's or a restore's re-spell, on the runner under `id`'s relink entry, so what it misses is owed with Try Again; one whose note can't be written still re-spells, owing nothing. Its list step is the move or the landing, already made. */
+export async function noteRelink(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  note: (prior: Entry | undefined) => RelinkEntry,
+): Promise<CascadeReport> {
+  const ran = await runNoted(root, id, {
+    note,
+    list: async () => ok(null),
+    sweep: (_, prior) => relinkReach(root, note(prior)),
+    settle: () => undefined,
+  })
+  return ran.ok ? ran.value.cascade : reachReport(await relinkReach(root, note(undefined)))
+}
```

```/Core/Nexus/entities.ts diff
 import type { AgendaKind } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { basename, dirname, isMarkdownFile, titleFromPath } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { capitalize } from '@pommora/uix/Utilities/capitalize'

@@ -48 +50 @@ export const isContainer = <T extends { kind: unknown }>(
 export const namesContainer = <T extends { kind: unknown }>(

 ): n is T & { kind: ContainerKind | 'archive' } => isContainer(n) || n?.kind === 'archive'
+
+export type Counted = { kind: HeldKind | 'property' }
+
+const PLURALS: Record<Counted['kind'], string> = {
+  page: 'Pages',
+  collection: 'Collections',
+  set: 'Sets',
+  space: 'Spaces',
+  context: 'Contexts',
+  property: 'Properties',
+}
+
+export const itemCount = (n: number): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'Item' : 'Items'}`
+
+export function countPhrase(items: readonly Counted[]): string {
+  const kinds = new Set(items.map((r) => r.kind))
+  const kind = kinds.size === 1 ? [...kinds][0] : null
+  if (kind === null) return itemCount(items.length)
+  return items.length === 1 ? `1 ${capitalize(kind)}` : `${items.length} ${PLURALS[kind]}`
+}
+
+export const unsweptLine = (count: number, what = ''): string =>
+  `Couldn’t update ${what}${itemCount(count)}.`
+
+/** Names each file only a fix by hand lets Pommora rewrite: a page by its title, a Space sidecar by its Space. */
+export const refusedLine = (files: readonly string[]): string =>
+  `Couldn’t safely rewrite ${files.map((f) => `“${isMarkdownFile(f) ? titleFromPath(f) : basename(dirname(f))}”`).join(', ')}.`
```

```/Core/Nexus/finishOwed.ts diff
+// The one finishing pass, at the open and on Try Again: Context entries under the Contexts lock, then Space entries, then property entries under the schema lock, then the content deletes' and moves' entries in the settle's turn, the notes file's own lock innermost and never nested; each entry under a catch that logs it and counts it missed, so one that throws costs only itself and still offers Try Again. Every arm re-derives from the lists as they read now: a name a live entity holds now is skipped and dropped, and an entity gone takes its owed renames with it.
+
+import { errText } from '../Contract/result'
+import { readRegistry, serializeSchemaOp } from '../Properties/propertiesRegistry'
+import { removeFromRegistry, renameSweep } from '../Properties/registryProperty'
+import { deletePlan, stripProperty } from '../Properties/deleteProperty'
+import { dropOptionFromDef, optionCascade } from '../Properties/optionOps'
+import { collectionFolders } from './governedSweep'
+import { optionsOf, type PropertyDefinition } from '../Properties/properties'
+import { findOption } from '../Properties/propertyValue'
+import { memberKey } from '../Files/rootValues'
+import { discardFile, type TrashDeps } from '../Trash/discard'
+import { type CascadeReport, deleteCascade, relinkReach, type StrippedLink } from './cascade'
+import { patchRecord } from '../Bundles/record'
+import { parkLinks } from '../Trash/trashedCopies'
+import { findContainerById } from './treePatch'
+import { pagesByIdOf } from './record'
+import { type ConfigReach, NO_REACH, reachConfig, retries } from './configReach'
+import { oweWalk } from './fileEvents'
+import { machine } from '../Platform/machine'
+import { heldName, relocate, targetTaken } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { contextsDir } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { contextDirRel } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { basename, join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { readRegistryStrict, unlistContext } from '../Contexts/contextsRegistry'
+import { contextWorldOf } from '../Contexts/contextResolve'
+import {
+  cascadeTitle,
+  moveTitled,
+  rivalTitled,
+  titleHolders,
+  unlinkContextKey,
+  unlinkSpaceValue,
+} from '../Contexts/contextCascade'
+import { inSettleTurn, underContexts } from './settle'
+import { dropContextOrder } from './reorder'
+import { liveTreeOf, refreshTree } from './liveTree'
+import {
+  type ContainerEntry,
+  type ContextEntry,
+  editNote,
+  type Entry,
+  type Notes,
+  type Owed,
+  owedReport,
+  owesRename,
+  type PropertyEntry,
+  readNotes,
+  type SpaceEntry,
+} from './owed'
+import { stashAndStrip } from '../Properties/unassignProperty'
+import { contentPages, listBundles } from '../Bundles/bundle'
+import { refillStash } from '../Properties/assignment'
+
+type Finished<E extends Entry> = { left: E; reach: ConfigReach }
+
+/** An arm whose list file can't be read or written leaves its entry as it stood, counting that file as missed. */
+const stuck = <E extends Entry>(e: E): Finished<E> => ({
+  left: e,
+  reach: { skipped: 1, hosts: [] },
+})
+
+/** Counts `r` into `reach`, answering whether it missed a file a later sweep can reach; a file only a fix by hand reaches is named and let go (B-5). */
+const add = (reach: ConfigReach, r: ConfigReach): boolean => {
+  reach.skipped += r.skipped
+  reach.refused = [...(reach.refused ?? []), ...(r.refused ?? [])]
+  reach.hosts.push(...r.hosts)
+  if (r.pages?.length) reach.pages = [...(reach.pages ?? []), ...r.pages]
+  return retries(r) > 0
+}
+
+export async function finishOwed(root: string, deps: TrashDeps): Promise<CascadeReport> {
+  const total: ConfigReach = { skipped: 0, hosts: [] }
+  const each = async (kind: Entry['kind']): Promise<void> => {
+    for (const [id, e] of Object.entries(await readNotes(root))) {
+      if (e.kind !== kind) continue
+      try {
+        add(total, await finishEntry(root, id, deps))
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.error('owed work could not finish:', errText(err))
+        total.skipped += 1
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  await underContexts(root, async () => {
+    await each('context')
+    await each('space')
+  })
+  await serializeSchemaOp(root, () => each('property'))
+  await inSettleTurn(root, async () => {
+    await each('container')
+    await each('relink')
+  })
+  return owedReport(root, total)
+}
+
+/** Finishes one entry inside a caller already holding its kind's lock (the pass, or a Context or Space delete), writing back what it still owes. */
+export async function finishEntry(root: string, id: string, deps: TrashDeps): Promise<ConfigReach> {
+  const notes = await readNotes(root)
+  const e = notes[id]
+  if (!e) return NO_REACH
+  const done = await finishArm(root, id, e, notes, deps)
+  await editNote(root, id, () => done.left)
+  return done.reach
+}
+
+function finishArm(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  e: Entry,
+  notes: Notes,
+  deps: TrashDeps,
+): Promise<Finished<Entry>> {
+  switch (e.kind) {
+    case 'property':
+      return finishProperty(root, id, e)
+    case 'context':
+      return finishContext(root, id, e, deps)
+    case 'space':
+      return finishSpace(root, id, e, notes, deps)
+    case 'container':
+      return finishContainer(root, id, e)
+    case 'relink':
+      return relinkReach(root, e).then((reach) => ({
+        left: retries(reach) ? e : { ...e, names: {}, rekey: undefined, values: undefined },
+        reach,
+      }))
+  }
+}
+
+/** Sweeps each of `names` that `skip` passes over, answering those a sweep missed; `reach` counts the files. While `views`, reached once after, can't be reached, every name stays owed, so the next finish reaches them again. */
+async function sweepEach(
+  names: string[] | undefined,
+  skip: (name: string) => boolean,
+  sweep: (name: string) => Promise<ConfigReach>,
+  reach: ConfigReach,
+  views?: () => Promise<ConfigReach>,
+): Promise<string[] | undefined> {
+  const left: string[] = []
+  for (const name of names ?? []) {
+    if (skip(name)) continue
+    if (add(reach, await sweep(name))) left.push(name)
+  }
+  if (names && views && add(reach, await views())) return names
+  return left.length ? left : undefined
+}
+
+async function finishProperty(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  e: PropertyEntry,
+): Promise<Finished<PropertyEntry>> {
+  const reach: ConfigReach = { skipped: 0, hosts: [] }
+  let defs = (await readRegistry(root)).defs
+  // The current key sitting in `strip` is a delete whose list step hadn't landed.
+  if (defs[id] && e.strip?.includes(defs[id].key)) {
+    if (!(await removeFromRegistry(root, id)).ok) return stuck(e)
+    defs = (await readRegistry(root)).defs
+  }
+  const def = defs[id]
+  const held = (key: string): boolean =>
+    Object.values(defs).some((d) => d.id !== id && d.key === key)
+  if (!def) {
+    const strip = (e.strip ?? []).filter((key) => !held(key))
+    // With no Trash entry left for the property it can't come back, so the Collections and pages the Trash holds lose it as the live ones do.
+    const bundles = await listBundles(root, { kind: 'trash' })
+    const kept = bundles.some((b) => b.record.entity === 'property' && b.record.id === id)
+    const trashed = kept
+      ? []
+      : bundles.flatMap((b) =>
+          b.artifactName
+            ? [{ entity: b.record.entity, abs: join(root, b.bundlePath, b.artifactName) }]
+            : [],
+        )
+    const folders = [
+      ...collectionFolders(root, await liveTreeOf(root)),
+      ...trashed.flatMap((b) => (b.entity === 'collection' ? [b.abs] : [])),
+    ]
+    const planned = await deletePlan(root, id, strip)
+    const inTrash = strip.length
+      ? (await Promise.all(trashed.map((b) => contentPages(b.entity, b.abs)))).flat()
+      : []
+    const holders = { ...planned.holders, files: [...planned.holders.files, ...inTrash] }
+    const missed = add(reach, await stripProperty(root, id, folders, { ...planned, holders }))
+    return { left: { kind: 'property', strip: missed ? strip : undefined }, reach }
+  }
+  const rename = await sweepEach(
+    e.rename,
+    (key) => key === def.key || held(key),
+    (key) => renameSweep(root, key, def.key),
+    reach,
+  )
+  const options = await finishOptions(root, def, e.options ?? {}, reach)
+  // A Collection gone owes nothing more; one assigning the property refills its pages from the stash, and one that doesn't stashes and strips them.
+  const byId = new Map((await liveTreeOf(root)).collections.map((c) => [c.id, c] as const))
+  const collections = await sweepEach(
+    e.collections,
+    (cid) => !byId.has(cid),
+    async (cid) => {
+      const c = byId.get(cid)!
+      if (!c.propertyIds.includes(id)) return stashAndStrip(root, join(root, c.path), def)
+      return { skipped: await refillStash(root, join(root, c.path), id, cid), hosts: [] }
+    },
+    reach,
+  )
+  // A live definition holding a strip part only arrives by sync; its Collections aren't this entry's to purge, so the part leaves.
+  const left: PropertyEntry = { kind: 'property', rename, options, collections }
+  return { left: owesRename(left) ? { ...e, rename } : left, reach }
+}
+
+async function finishOptions(
+  root: string,
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  options: Record<string, Owed>,
+  reach: ConfigReach,
+): Promise<Record<string, Owed> | undefined> {
+  const left: Record<string, Owed> = {}
+  for (const [optionId, o] of Object.entries(options)) {
+    let option = findOption(def, optionId)
+    if (option && !o.kept && o.strip?.includes(option.key)) {
+      if (!(await dropOptionFromDef(root, def.id, option.id)).ok) {
+        left[optionId] = o
+        continue
+      }
+      option = undefined
+    }
+    const held = (word: string): boolean =>
+      optionsOf(def).some((x) => x.id !== optionId && memberKey(x.key) === memberKey(word))
+    const to = option?.key
+    const rename = to === undefined ? [] : (o.rename ?? []).filter((w) => w !== to && !held(w))
+    const strip = (o.strip ?? []).filter((w) => !held(w))
+    const renamed =
+      to !== undefined &&
+      rename.length > 0 &&
+      add(reach, await optionCascade(root, def, new Map(rename.map((w) => [w, to]))))
+    const stripped =
+      strip.length > 0 &&
+      add(
+        reach,
+        await optionCascade(
+          root,
+          def,
+          new Map(strip.map((w) => [w, null])),
+          o.kept ? undefined : optionId,
+        ),
+      )
+    if (renamed || stripped)
+      left[optionId] = {
+        ...o,
+        rename: renamed ? rename : undefined,
+        strip: stripped ? strip : undefined,
+      }
+  }
+  return Object.keys(left).length ? left : undefined
+}
+
+/** A deleted Context's or Space's folder, where its delete's list step left it, into its bundle or where Trash Mode sends it. */
+const leave = async (
+  root: string,
+  abs: string,
+  bundle: string | undefined,
+  deps: TrashDeps,
+): Promise<void> => {
+  if (bundle) await relocate(abs, join(root, bundle, basename(abs)))
+  else await machine().lock(abs, () => discardFile(root, abs, deps))
+  oweWalk(root)
+}
+
+async function finishContext(

+  const reg = await readRegistryStrict(root)

+  let contexts = reg.ok ? reg.value.contexts : []
+  const listed = contexts.find((c) => c.id === id)?.title

+async function finishSpace(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  e: SpaceEntry,

+): Promise<Finished<SpaceEntry>> {

+}
+
+async function finishContainer(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  e: ContainerEntry,
+): Promise<Finished<ContainerEntry>> {

+        links: [...((raw.links as StrippedLink[] | undefined) ?? []), ...gone.links],
+      }))
+    else if (e.park) await parkLinks(root, gone.links)
+  }
+  const stripped = !!gone && add(reach, gone.reach)
+  const viewed =
+    !!e.edit &&
+    !back &&
+    add(reach, await reachConfig(root, e.edit, e.within && join(root, e.within)))
+  return {
+    left: { ...e, strip: stripped ? e.strip : undefined, edit: viewed ? e.edit : undefined },
+    reach,
+  }
+}
```

```/Core/Nexus/governedRoot.ts diff
+export const governedWorld = (

+export async function pageWorldOf(root: string, absFile: string): Promise<GovernedWorld> {

+  return governedWorld(tree, containerSchema(tree, relative(root, absFile)))
+}
+
+/** The pages a frozen copy may still name: `holds` answers which still exist. */
+export interface Frozen {
+  holds: (title: string) => boolean
+}
+
+export function gonePageEntry(raw: unknown, frozen: Frozen): string | null {
+  const entry = linkEntry(raw, 2)
+  const link = entry === null ? null : readLinkText(entry)
+  const gone = link?.kind === 'page' && link.title !== '' && !frozen.holds(link.title)
+  return gone ? entry : null
+}
+
+/** `next` spelled as `raw` already spells it: a checked `true` takes `raw`'s checkbox word as `checkedSpelling` does, a number keeps `raw`'s spelling as `spelledNumber` does, a string keeps a `raw` of any other shape whose inline yaml reads as that string, a one-member list keeps a scalar or a whole unquoted wikilink `raw` that spells its member, and each member takes the one member of `raw` whose title is its own — a scalar of any shape, or an unquoted wikilink. A member `raw` names more than once keeps the spelling `next` gives it, the registered one. */
+export function writtenSpelling(next: unknown, raw: unknown): unknown {
+  if (next === true) return checkedSpelling(raw)
+  if (typeof next === 'number') return spelledNumber(next, raw)
+  if (typeof next === 'string')
+    return raw != null && typeof raw !== 'string' && asText(raw) === next ? raw : next
+  if (!Array.isArray(next)) return next
+  if (next.length === 1 && memberKey(linkEntry(raw, 2) ?? raw) === memberKey(next[0])) return raw
+  const held = listOf(raw)
+  return next.map((v) => {
+    const names = namesValue(v)
+    const named = held.filter((w) => names(linkEntry(w, 2) ?? w))
+    return named.length === 1 ? named[0] : v
+  })
+}
+
+/** `raw` read and written back through `def`, spelled as `raw` spells it, `next` undefined when it reads as nothing; a Multi-Select keeps its words no option names after its own. `listed` when the value is a list. */
+export function reencode(
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  raw: unknown,
+): { next: unknown; listed: boolean } {
+  const value = decodeValue(def, raw)
+  const listed = 'value' in value && Array.isArray(value.value)
+  if (isBlankValue(value)) return { next: undefined, listed }
+  const kept = keepingForeignWords(def, encodeValue(def, value), raw)
+  return { next: writtenSpelling(kept, raw), listed }
+}
+
+type Governor = { def: PropertyDefinition } | { group: ContextGroup }
+
+function governorOf(key: string, world: GovernedWorld): Governor | undefined {
+  const def = world.defs.get(key)
+  if (def) return { def }
+  const group = groupOf(key, world.contexts)
+  return group && { group }
+}
+
+const memberCount = (v: unknown): number => new Set(listOf(v).map(memberKey)).size

+/** Whether `next` holds `raw`'s members exactly, each once, in whatever order. */
+const sameMembers = (next: unknown, raw: unknown): boolean =>
+  Array.isArray(next) &&
+  Array.isArray(raw) &&
+  next.length === raw.length &&
+  [next, raw, [...next, ...raw]].every((v) => memberCount(v) === raw.length)
+
+/** What a live reconcile lands for `raw` read as `next`: `raw` as written where `next` would blank it, would only reorder it, or, `listed`, would drop a list member it can't resolve, for the user to settle; else `next`, undefined where `raw` reads blank. */
+export const liveLanding = (raw: unknown, { next, listed }: { next: unknown; listed: boolean }) =>
+  (next === undefined && !isBlankRaw(raw)) ||
+  (listed && memberCount(next) < memberCount(raw)) ||
+  sameMembers(next, raw)
+    ? raw
+    : next
+
+export function reconcileGovernedRoot(
+  root: Record<string, unknown>,
+  world: GovernedWorld,
+  skip?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}

+    const governor = key === skip ? undefined : governorOf(key, world)
+    if (!governor) {
+      out[key] = raw
+      continue
+    }
+    let next: unknown
+    let listed = true
+    if ('def' in governor) ({ next, listed } = reencode(governor.def, raw))
+    else {
+      const byTitle = world.contexts.spacesByTitle.get(governor.group.def.id)
+      const titles = contextTitles(raw).flatMap((title) => byTitle?.get(title)?.title ?? [])
+      if (titles.length) next = writtenSpelling([...new Set(titles)], raw)
+    }
+    next = liveLanding(raw, { next, listed })
+    if (next !== undefined) out[key] = next
+  }
+  return out
+}
+
+/** `root` with `value` under `key`, its members spelled as the root already spells them, after the reconcile repairs every other governed key; null when that changes nothing, so nothing is written. */
+export function writtenRoot(
+  root: Json,
+  key: string,
+  value: unknown,
+  world: GovernedWorld,
+): Json | null {
+  const reconciled = reconcileGovernedRoot(root, world, key)
+  const def = world.defs.get(key)
+  const kept = def ? keepingForeignWords(def, value, root[key]) : value
+  const next = landValue(reconciled, key, writtenSpelling(kept, root[key]))
+  return changedKeys(root, next).length ? next : null
+}
+
+/** The root a governed file holds: a page's frontmatter, or a Space sidecar's object. */
+export const governedRoot = (file: string, text: string): Json =>
+  isMarkdownFile(file) ? splitFrontmatter(text) : (parseJsonObject(text) ?? {})
+
+export const changedKeys = (root: Json, next: Json): string[] =>
+  [...new Set([...Object.keys(root), ...Object.keys(next)])].filter(
+    (k) => JSON.stringify(root[k]) !== JSON.stringify(next[k]),
+  )
+
+/** A page's next text with the keys `rewrite` changes merged in, a key it adds landing where `above` places it, and last without one; null when it changes none. A changed key the next root holds no value for is deleted. */
+export const rewriteRoot =
+  (rewrite: (root: Json) => Json | null, above?: Place) =>
+  (page: SweptPage): string | null => {
+    const next = rewrite(page.raw)
+    if (next === null) return null
+    const keys = changedKeys(page.raw, next)
+    if (!keys.length) return null
+    return page.merge(next, keys, above)
+  }
+
+/** Rewrites the page at `absFile` in one parse, writing the text `rewrite` answers for it, or nothing for null. Takes no lock: each caller holds the page's lock over a wider span, and a re-take is refused. */
+export async function rewriteRootAt(
+  absFile: string,
+  rewrite: (page: SweptPage) => string | null,
+): Promise<Result<null>> {
+  let content: string | null
+  try {
+    content = await machine().readText(absFile)
+  } catch {
+    return fault('That page could not be read.')
+  }
+  if (content === null) return fail('not-found', 'Page not found.')
+  const page = sweepParse(content)
+  if (!page) return fault(UNPARSED_FRONTMATTER)
+  const next = rewrite(page)
+  if (next !== null) await atomicWriteFile(absFile, next)
+  return ok(null)
+}
+
+/** Writes `value` under `key` in the page or Space sidecar at `abs`, answering what the key held before and, on a page, the key its line stood above, as `PutBack` spells them. Takes no lock: its caller holds the file's, as `rewriteRootAt`'s does. */
+export async function writeGovernedKey(
+  abs: string,
+  key: string,
+  value: unknown,
+  world: GovernedWorld,
+): Promise<Result<Pick<PutBack, 'before' | 'above'>>> {
+  const was: Pick<PutBack, 'before' | 'above'> = {}
+  const written = isMarkdownFile(abs)
+    ? await rewriteRootAt(abs, (page) => {
+        was.before = page.pair(key)
+        was.above = page.above(key)

+    : await patchHeldSidecar(abs, 'space', (root) => {

+        return writtenRoot(root, key, value, world)

+}
+
+/** The key a property or a Context is written under now. A Context resolves from the tree first, so a tag's undo never reads the property list, which a damaged file makes throw. */
+async function keyNow(root: string, id: string): Promise<string | undefined> {

+  if (group) return contextKey(group.def.title)
+  return (await readRegistry(root)).defs[id]?.key
+}

+/** Puts each entry's key back as its file held it before the write that recorded it, a page's own node verbatim and a blank one as no line, and a key the page no longer holds above the key it stood above, leaving every other key as it now stands and a file whose key already reads so unwritten; answers the entries it couldn't put back. */
+export async function putBackEntries(
+  root: string,
+  entries: readonly PutBack[],
+): Promise<PutBack[]> {
+  const missed: PutBack[] = []
+  for (const entry of entries) if (!(await landEntry(root, entry))) missed.push(entry)
+  return missed
+}
+
+// Each key is read inside its file's lock, as the write read it, so a key renamed since lands under its new name; a pair that no longer serializes, such as an alias whose anchor an outside edit removed, is missed.
+async function landEntry(
+  root: string,
+  { file, fieldId, before, above }: PutBack,
+): Promise<boolean> {

+    if (!at.ok) return false

+      const key = await keyNow(root, fieldId)
+      if (key === undefined) return false

+        const next = landValue(raw, key, before)
+        return changedKeys(raw, next).length ? next : null
+      })
+      return back.ok
+    })
+  }

+  })
```

```/Core/Nexus/governedSweep.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import {
+  atomicWriteFile,
+  jsonText,
+  parseJsonObject,
+  readTextOrNull,
+  rewritePreservingTimes,
+} from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { machine } from '../Platform/machine'
+import { damagedFolders } from './treePatch'
+import type { NexusTree } from './tree'
+import { isMarkdownFile, join, relative } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { isArchived } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { ID_KEY } from './identityMark'
+import { asString } from './coerce'
+import { addressable } from './heldPages'
+import type { EntityRecord } from './record'
+import { sweepParse } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import type { Json } from '../Files/stableJson'
+import { type Frozen, gonePageEntry, liveLanding, reencode, rewriteRoot } from './governedRoot'
+import type { Place } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import { type PropertyDefinition, PROPERTY_TYPES } from '../Properties/properties'
+import { isBlankRaw, landValue } from '../Files/rootValues'
+
+export interface SweepResult {
+  /** Each file the sweep wrote, or a dry run would write, with the text it held before and the text the write leaves. */
+  touched: Map<string, { before: string; after: string }>
+  /** Each file left as it was that the sweep should have reached: one it couldn't read, and one whose root can't round-trip. */
+  skipped: string[]
+  /** The files among `skipped` whose root can't round-trip, which only a fix by hand lets a sweep reach, so they're named once and let go (B-5). */
+  refused: string[]
+}
+
+export type Rewrite = (root: Json, file: string) => Json | null
+
+export type RewriteText = (content: string, file: string) => string | null
+
+/** `raw` rewrites a page's front matter or a Space sidecar's object; `text`, when given, rewrites a page's whole text in its place; `above`, when given, places each key a page's rewrite adds. */
+export type SweepPlan = {
+  raw: Rewrite
+  text?: RewriteText
+  above?: (root: Json, file: string) => Place
+}
+
+export const collectionFolders = (root: string, tree: NexusTree): string[] =>
+  [
+    ...tree.collections,
+    ...damagedFolders(tree.unreadable).filter((u) => u.kind === 'collection'),
+  ].map((c) => join(root, c.path))
+
+// A file whose lock or write throws costs only itself, so the files after it are still reached.
+const guarded = (file: string, missed: string[], body: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> =>
+  machine()
+    .lock(file, body)
+    .catch(() => void missed.push(file))
+/** A file's text after `plan`, by its kind: null when nothing changes, undefined when its root can't round-trip (an Unknown page, a sidecar nobody can parse), which won't read any better on a retry, so it's left byte-identical. */
+function rewritten(plan: SweepPlan, file: string, content: string): string | null | undefined {
+  if (!isMarkdownFile(file)) {
+    const raw = parseJsonObject(content)
+    if (!raw) return undefined
+    const next = plan.raw(raw, file)
+    return next === null ? null : jsonText(next)
+  }
+  const page = sweepParse(content)
+  if (!page) return undefined
+  if (plan.text) return plan.text(content, file)
+  return rewriteRoot((root) => plan.raw(root, file), plan.above?.(page.raw, file))(page)
+}
+
+/** Files are absolute, pages and Space sidecars alike. */
+export async function sweepGovernedRoots(
+  files: string[],
+  plan: SweepPlan,
+  dry = false,
+): Promise<SweepResult> {
+  const out: SweepResult = { touched: new Map(), skipped: [], refused: [] }
+
+  for (const file of files) {
+    await guarded(file, out.skipped, async () => {
+      const content = await readTextOrNull(file)
+      if (content === null) {
+        out.skipped.push(file)
+        return
+      }
+      const next = rewritten(plan, file, content)
+      if (next === undefined) {
+        out.skipped.push(file)
+        out.refused.push(file)
+        return
+      }
+      if (next === null) return
+      if (!dry)
+        await (isMarkdownFile(file)
+          ? rewritePreservingTimes(file, next)
+          : atomicWriteFile(file, next))
+      out.touched.set(file, { before: content, after: next })
+    })
+  }
+  return out
+}
+
+/** A file outside the Archive: the only kind a confirmation, a what-changed count, a rename's clash refusal, or a cascade's `pages` names, since nothing displays an archived path. */
+export const outsideArchive = (root: string, file: string): boolean =>
+  !isArchived(relative(root, file))
+
+/** The id a governed root carries: a page's `ID`, a Space sidecar's `id`. */
+export const rootId = (file: string, root: Json): string | undefined =>
+  asString(root[isMarkdownFile(file) ? ID_KEY : 'id'])
+
+export async function sweepCount(root: string, files: string[], plan: SweepPlan): Promise<number> {
+  const shown = files.filter((file) => outsideArchive(root, file))
+  return (await sweepGovernedRoots(shown, plan, true)).touched.size
+}
+
+/** What a by-id sweep reads of each root: where its file is and what kind it is, so a trashed copy joins the live tree's records. */
+export type RootsById = ReadonlyMap<string, Pick<EntityRecord, 'kind' | 'path'> | null>
+
+/** Rewrites each page or Space whose ID is in `values` — found where `roots` places it, matched by the ID it carries, and left alone where two files claim it — and answers the IDs whose root now holds what its rewrite asked for, and how many files it couldn't read or write; a null rewrite leaves its root as it is. A key a page's rewrite adds lands above the key `above` names for its ID, and last without one. */
+export async function sweepRootsById<T>(
+  root: string,
+  roots: RootsById,
+  values: Record<string, T>,
+  above: Record<string, string | undefined>,
+  rewrite: (root: Json, value: T) => Json | null,
+): Promise<{ taken: ReadonlySet<string>; skipped: number }> {
+  const asked = new Map<string, string>()
+  const files = Object.keys(values).flatMap((id) => {
+    const at = roots.get(id)
+    if (at?.kind === 'page') return [join(root, at.path)]
+    return at?.kind === 'space' ? [sidecarPath(join(root, at.path), 'space')] : []
+  })
+  const swept = await sweepGovernedRoots(files, {
+    raw: (raw, file) => {
+      const id = rootId(file, raw)
+      if (!addressable(roots, id) || !Object.hasOwn(values, id)) return null
+      const next = rewrite(raw, values[id])
+      if (next !== null) asked.set(file, id)
+      return next
+    },
+    above: (raw, file) => () => above[rootId(file, raw) ?? ''],
+  })
+  for (const file of swept.skipped) asked.delete(file)
+  return { taken: new Set(asked.values()), skipped: swept.skipped.length }
+}
+
+/** `value` landed under `def`'s key as a live reconcile lands it, where `root` reads blank; null where it doesn't land, or where it's a Link naming a page `frozen` no longer holds. */
+export const refillOf =
+  (def: PropertyDefinition, frozen: Frozen) =>
+  (root: Json, value: unknown): Json | null => {
+    const gone =
+      PROPERTY_TYPES[def.type].connections === 'value' && gonePageEntry(value, frozen) !== null
+    const next = liveLanding(value, reencode(def, value))
+    return gone || next === undefined || !isBlankRaw(root[def.key])
+      ? null
+      : landValue(root, def.key, next)
+  }
+
+/** Puts each value back as `refillOf` lands it, on the page or Space its ID names wherever that root holds none, above the key `above` names for that ID, and answers the IDs that took theirs. */
+export async function refillValues(
+  root: string,
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  roots: RootsById,
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  frozen: Frozen,
+  above: Record<string, string | undefined> = {},
+): Promise<{ taken: ReadonlySet<string>; skipped: number }> {
+  return sweepRootsById(root, roots, values, above, refillOf(def, frozen))
+}
```

##### Core/Nexus/owed.ts

```/Core/Nexus/owed.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// The notes file: one entry per item or many-file change that still owes work, keyed by its id or path, each holding the old names files may still carry. A change writes its entry before anything else and refuses when it can't; the entry clears once nothing is owed.
+
+import { fail, ok, type Result } from '../Contract/result'
+import { neverParsed, readAppFile, updateNexusFile } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { memberKey } from '../Files/rootValues'
+import { type Json, same } from '../Files/stableJson'
+import { normalizeTitle } from '../Paths/caseFold'
+import { contextDirRel, OWED_REL } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { basename, join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import type { CascadeReport } from './cascade'
+import { type ConfigEdit, type ConfigReach, reachReport, retries } from './configReach'
+import { pageKey } from '../Connections/pageIndex'
+
+/** Each name in `rename` becomes the current name wherever a file still holds it; each in `strip` leaves. `kept` marks an option part a Clear wrote: the option stays listed, so its own word in `strip` leaves the pages without the option leaving. */
+export type Owed = { rename?: string[]; strip?: string[]; kept?: true }
+export type PropertyEntry = Owed & {
+  kind: 'property'
+  options?: Record<string, Owed>
+  collections?: string[]
+}
+export type ContextEntry = Owed & { kind: 'context'; bundle?: string }
+export type SpaceEntry = Owed & { kind: 'space'; contextId: string; bundle?: string }
+/** A page, Collection, or Set delete, a Trash emptying, or a Set move: `strip` holds the gone pages' paths, whose links leave the files outside `at`, and `edit` the views it still owes, reached under `within`; the links a finish strips go into `bundle`'s record, or are parked where `park` says the Trash entry is gone. */
+export type ContainerEntry = Owed & {
+  kind: 'container'
+  at: string
+  edit?: ConfigEdit
+  within?: string
+  bundle?: string
+  park?: true
+}
+/** By file, each value a restore worked out and couldn't write: what the file read then and what it lands as, either absent where there was or will be none. */
+export type Worked = Record<string, Record<string, { from?: unknown; to?: unknown }>>
+/** Each value `to` holds other than `from`, as a note keeps it. */
+export const workedOut = (from: Json, to: Json): Worked[string] =>
+  Object.fromEntries(
+    [...new Set([...Object.keys(from), ...Object.keys(to)])].flatMap((k) =>
+      same(from[k], to[k]) ? [] : [[k, { from: from[k], to: to[k] }]],
+    ),
+  )
+/** A move's or a restore's re-spell, each old link key mapped to how it spells its page now; `files` scopes a restore's repair of its own landed files to them alone, `rekey` re-keys a Context restored under a new title in its own Spaces' sidecars among them, and `values` holds, by file, what the restore worked out and couldn't write. */
+export type RelinkEntry = Owed & {
+  kind: 'relink'
+  names: Record<string, string>
+  label: string
+  files?: string[]
+  rekey?: [from: string, to: string]
+  values?: Worked
+}
+export type Entry = PropertyEntry | ContextEntry | SpaceEntry | ContainerEntry | RelinkEntry
+export type Notes = Record<string, Entry>
+
+/** Where a name lives: a property's keys, a Context's titles, a Space's titles inside its Context, or one property's option words. */
+type Owner =
+  | { kind: 'property' }
+  | { kind: 'context' }
+  | { kind: 'space'; contextId: string }
+  | { kind: 'option'; propertyId: string }
+/** A name a create or rename lands on, and the item landing there, whose own owed names never refuse it. */
+type Landing = { owner: Owner; name: string; except?: string }
+
+const OWED_LINE = 'An earlier change hasn’t reached every file yet.'
+export const OWED = fail('owed', OWED_LINE)
+const LOST_LINE = 'Unfinished work from an earlier session couldn’t be read and was lost.'
+
+/** Roots whose damaged notes file a write set aside, its work lost; the next report says so once. */
+const lost = new Set<string>()
+
+const notesFile = (root: string): string => join(root, OWED_REL)
+
+// Only this module writes the file and it never syncs, so it reads as written; a corrupt one is set aside by `updateNexusFile`.
+export const readNotes = async (root: string): Promise<Notes> =>
+  ((await readAppFile(notesFile(root))) as Notes | null) ?? {}
+
+/** Every name in `parts` once, or nothing when there are none, as an entry stores a part. */
+export const distinct = (...parts: (readonly string[] | undefined)[]): string[] | undefined => {
+  const all = parts.flatMap((p) => p ?? [])
+  return all.length ? [...new Set(all)] : undefined
+}
+
+const owes = (o: Owed | undefined): boolean => !!(o?.rename?.length || o?.strip?.length)
+
+const owesAnything = (e: Entry): boolean =>
+  owes(e) ||
+  (e.kind === 'property' &&
+    (!!e.collections?.length || Object.values(e.options ?? {}).some(owes))) ||
+  (e.kind === 'container' && !!e.edit) ||
+  (e.kind === 'relink' && (Object.keys(e.names).length > 0 || !!e.rekey || !!e.values))
+
+/** `e`'s re-spell with `names` laid over it: an old key that spelled a page `names` moves follows it to where `names` leaves it, and a restore's repair, scoped by `files`, follows without taking `names`' keys, so its landed files keep their own targets; its files, and what it worked out for them, follow to where `paths` moves them, and its re-key to the title its Context's folder moves to. */
+export const relinkNote = (
+  e: Entry | undefined,
+  names: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
+  label?: string,
+  paths: (file: string) => string = (f) => f,
+): RelinkEntry => {
+  const held = e?.kind === 'relink' ? e : undefined
+  const followed = Object.entries(held?.names ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [
+    k,
+    names.get(pageKey(v)) ?? v,
+  ])
+  const worked =
+    held?.values && Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(held.values).map(([f, v]) => [paths(f), v]))
+  const rekey: RelinkEntry['rekey'] = held?.rekey && [
+    held.rekey[0],
+    basename(paths(contextDirRel(held.rekey[1]))),
+  ]
+  return {
+    kind: 'relink',
+    label: label ?? held?.label ?? '',
+    names: { ...Object.fromEntries(followed), ...(held?.files ? {} : Object.fromEntries(names)) },
+    ...(held?.files ? { files: held.files.map(paths), rekey, values: worked } : {}),
+  }
+}
+
+/** Lays `names` and `paths` over every relink entry but `except`'s, so a file an earlier change missed lands where this one leaves it. */
+export async function followRelinks(
+  root: string,
+  names: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
+  paths?: (file: string) => string,
+  except?: string,
+): Promise<void> {
+  for (const [id, e] of Object.entries(await readNotes(root)))
+    if (e.kind === 'relink' && id !== except)
+      await editNote(root, id, (x) => x && relinkNote(x, names, undefined, paths))
+}
+
+/** Whether `e` still owes a rename. Pages under its old name weren't candidates for any sweep since, so an option part, a Remove's Collection, or a Space under it settles only once the rename lands (H-1). */
+export const owesRename = (e: Entry | undefined): boolean => !!e?.rename?.length
+
+/** Edits `id`'s entry under the file's own lock, dropping one that owes nothing and the file once no entry is left; answers the entry as it stood, or the refusal naming the file. */
+export async function editNote(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  edit: (e: Entry | undefined) => Entry | undefined,
+): Promise<Result<Entry | undefined>> {
+  let prior: Entry | undefined
+  const damaged = await neverParsed(notesFile(root))
+  const written = await updateNexusFile(
+    notesFile(root),
+    (cur) => {
+      const { [id]: held, ...rest } = cur as Notes
+      prior = held
+      const next = edit(held)
+      if (same(next ?? null, held ?? null)) return null
+      return next && owesAnything(next) ? { ...rest, [id]: next } : rest
+    },
+    true,
+    true,
+  )
+  if (written.ok && damaged) lost.add(root)
+  return written.ok ? ok(prior) : written
+}
+
+export const propertyNote = (e: Entry | undefined): PropertyEntry =>
+  e?.kind === 'property' ? e : { kind: 'property' }
+
+export const owedRename = <O extends Owed>(o: O, from: string, to: string): O => ({
+  ...o,
+  rename: distinct([...(o.rename ?? []), from].filter((n) => n !== to)),
+})
+/** Every owed name and the current one move into `strip`, for a delete and a Clear alike (H-2, H-3). */
+export const owedDelete = (o: Owed, current: string): Owed => ({
+  rename: undefined,
+  strip: distinct(o.strip, o.rename, [current]),
+})
+/** `o` once a sweep that missed nothing has reached `swept`. */
+export const owedSwept = <O extends Owed>(o: O, swept: readonly string[]): O => ({
+  ...o,
+  rename: distinct(o.rename?.filter((n) => !swept.includes(n))),
+  strip: distinct(o.strip?.filter((n) => !swept.includes(n))),
+})
+
+export function withOption(
+  e: PropertyEntry,
+  optionId: string,
+  edit: (o: Owed) => Owed,
+): PropertyEntry {
+  const { [optionId]: part, ...rest } = e.options ?? {}
+  const next = edit(part ?? {})
+  const options = owes(next) ? { ...rest, [optionId]: next } : rest
+  return { ...e, options: Object.keys(options).length ? options : undefined }
+}
+
+/** Whether an item other than `except` still owes `name` within its owner, so no create or rename may land on it: the work still due would land there too. Option words compare as written; every other name folds case. */
+export function owedName(notes: Notes, { owner, name, except }: Landing): boolean {
+  const fold = owner.kind === 'option' ? memberKey : normalizeTitle
+  const scope: [string, Owed][] =
+    owner.kind === 'option'
+      ? Object.entries(propertyNote(notes[owner.propertyId]).options ?? {})
+      : Object.entries(notes).filter(
+          ([, e]) =>
+            e.kind === owner.kind &&
+            (e.kind !== 'space' || (owner.kind === 'space' && e.contextId === owner.contextId)),
+        )
+  return scope.some(
+    ([id, o]) =>
+      id !== except &&
+      [...(o.rename ?? []), ...(o.strip ?? [])].some((n) => fold(n) === fold(name)),
+  )
+}
+
+/** A restore turns what its delete never reached back into renames to the restored name, so those files keep their values (H-4); an item that owes no strip writes nothing. */
+export async function restoreNote(root: string, id: string): Promise<Result<unknown>> {
+  if (!(await readNotes(root))[id]?.strip) return ok(undefined)
+  return editNote(
+    root,
+    id,
+    (e) => e && { ...e, rename: distinct(e.rename, e.strip), strip: undefined, bundle: undefined },
+  )
+}
+
+/** A many-file change's report, marked owed while an entry still owes work, which Try Again finishes; a pass's total is owed while it missed a file. The lost-work line joins it once, after a write set a damaged notes file aside. */
+export function owedReport(root: string, reach: ConfigReach, owed = retries(reach) > 0) {
+  const report = reachReport(reach)
+  if (owed) {
+    report.warning ??= OWED_LINE
+    report.owed = true
+  }
+  if (lost.delete(root)) report.warning = [report.warning, LOST_LINE].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
+  return report
+}
+
+/** What a restore worked out for the files it couldn't write joins the relink entry its landed path `at` keys, so Try Again lands it where a file still reads what the restore found. A note that can't be written owes nothing. */
+export async function oweWorked(
+  root: string,
+  at: string,
+  label: string,
+  values: Worked,
+): Promise<CascadeReport | undefined> {
+  const reach = { skipped: Object.keys(values).length, hosts: [] }
+  if (!reach.skipped) return undefined
+  const noted = await editNote(root, at, (e) => {
+    const held: RelinkEntry =
+      e?.kind === 'relink' ? e : { kind: 'relink', names: {}, label, files: [] }
+    return { ...held, values: { ...held.values, ...values } }
+  })
+  return noted.ok ? owedReport(root, reach) : reachReport(reach)
+}
+
+/** A many-file change on `id`, in its one order: refused while another item owes a name it lands on, then its note, its list step, and its sweep. A refused note or list step changes nothing, the entry put back as it stood; a sweep that missed nothing settles the entry, unless the entry `under` names still owes a rename (H-1), and a sweep that is the finish's own arm writes back its entry itself. The report is owed while the entry still stands, whatever left it owing. */
+export async function runNoted<T>(
+  root: string,
+  id: string,
+  change: {
+    lands?: readonly Landing[]
+    note: (e: Entry | undefined) => Entry
+    list: () => Promise<Result<T>>
+    sweep: (listed: T, prior: Entry | undefined) => Promise<ConfigReach>
+    settle?: (e: Entry, listed: T) => Entry | undefined
+    under?: string
+  },
+): Promise<Result<{ cascade: CascadeReport }>> {
+  const notes = await readNotes(root)
+  if (change.lands?.some((l) => owedName(notes, l))) return OWED
+  const prior = await editNote(root, id, change.note)
+  if (!prior.ok) return prior
+  const listed = await change.list()
+  if (!listed.ok) {
+    await editNote(root, id, () => prior.value)
+    return listed
+  }
+  const reach = await change.sweep(listed.value, prior.value)
+  const { settle } = change
+  const held = change.under === undefined ? undefined : notes[change.under]
+  if (settle && !retries(reach) && !owesRename(held))
+    await editNote(root, id, (e) => e && settle(e, listed.value))
+  return ok({ cascade: owedReport(root, reach, id in (await readNotes(root))) })
+}
```

```/Core/Properties/columnDisplay.ts diff
+import { FILEDATA_BY_ID } from './properties'
+import { propertyIcon, propertyTypeIconName } from './typeDisplay'
+import type { ContextIdentity } from '../Contexts/contextIdentity'
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../Views/viewRow'
+
+export function columnLabel(
+  { id, def }: ResolvedColumn,
+  contexts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContextIdentity>,
+): string {
+  const title = contexts.get(id)?.title
+  if (title) return title
+  return FILEDATA_BY_ID.get(id)?.label ?? def?.label ?? id
+}
+
+export const columnIcon = (
+  { id, def, type }: ResolvedColumn,
+  contexts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContextIdentity>,
+): string => contexts.get(id)?.icon ?? (def ? propertyIcon(def) : propertyTypeIconName(type))
```

##### Core/Properties/fieldValue.ts

```/Core/Properties/fieldValue.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// A column's type is its own (`ResolvedColumn.type`); its value is decoded definition-first, never inferred from the value's shape, so a Link column always reads as a link.
+
+import type { ResolvedColumn, ViewRow } from '../Views/viewRow'
+import type { PageFrontmatter } from '../Nexus/schemas'
+import type { PropertyDefinition } from './properties'
+import { decodeValue, NULL_VALUE, type PropertyValue } from './propertyValue'
+
+const stampValue = (iso: string | null): PropertyValue =>
+  iso === null ? NULL_VALUE : { kind: 'dateTime', value: iso }
+
+/** A value a pending write picked stands in until a read retires it. Title, the stamps, and a Context read the row, not the front matter the memo is keyed on; a Context's ids resolve at walk assembly onto the row's own `contextValues`. */
+export function resolveFieldValue(row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn): PropertyValue {
+  const picked = row.picked?.[column.id]
+  if (picked) return picked
+  switch (column.kind) {
+    case 'title':
+      return { kind: 'text', value: row.title }
+    case 'stamp':
+      return stampValue(column.type === 'createdTime' ? row.createdAt : row.modifiedAt)
+    case 'context': {
+      const ids = row.contextValues?.[column.id]
+      return ids?.length ? { kind: 'context', value: ids } : NULL_VALUE
+    }
+    case 'property': {
+      const { def } = column
+      let m = resolvedByFm.get(row.frontmatter)
+      if (!m) {
+        m = new WeakMap()
+        resolvedByFm.set(row.frontmatter, m)
+      }
+      let v = m.get(def)
+      if (!v) {
+        v = decodeValue(def, (row.frontmatter as Record<string, unknown>)[def.key])
+        m.set(def, v)
+      }
+      return v
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+// MEMOIZED per frontmatter object and definition: the decode was the measured grouped-view hot spot. A value write swaps the frontmatter and a definition edit mints a new definition, so entries self-expire.
+const resolvedByFm = new WeakMap<PageFrontmatter, WeakMap<PropertyDefinition, PropertyValue>>()
```

```/Core/Properties/optionOps.ts diff
+/** An option's delete or Clear on the runner: its word and every old name it still owes leave the pages holding them. A delete drops the option as its list step; a Clear's option stays listed, so its part is marked kept and no finish drops the option. */
+function stripOption(
+  root: string,
+  { def, option }: { def: PropertyDefinition; option: SelectOption },
+  kept: boolean,
+): Promise<MutateReply> {
+  const part = (e: Entry | undefined): Owed => ({
+    ...owedDelete(propertyNote(e).options?.[option.id] ?? {}, option.key),
+    ...(kept ? { kept: true as const } : {}),
+  })
+  return runNoted(root, def.id, {
+    note: (e) => withOption(propertyNote(e), option.id, () => part(e)),
+    list: () => (kept ? Promise.resolve(ok(null)) : dropOptionFromDef(root, def.id, option.id)),
+    sweep: (_, prior) =>
+      optionCascade(
+        root,
+        def,
+        new Map((part(prior).strip ?? []).map((w) => [w, null])),
+        kept ? undefined : option.id,
+      ),
+    settle: (e) => withOption(propertyNote(e), option.id, () => ({})),
+    under: def.id,
   })
 }
```

##### Core/Properties/propertyStash.ts

```/Core/Properties/propertyStash.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// A Collection sidecar's `property_stash`: per property, the values a Remove set aside, keyed by page id, and when it set them aside.
+
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import { isPlainObject } from '../Contract/validators'
+import { join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { patchSidecar } from '../Files/sidecar'
+import { heldTreeOf } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import { readFileHistoryConfig } from '../Settings/settings'
+import type { CollectionNode } from '../Nexus/tree'
+
+/** One property's stashed values by page id, when they were removed, and, per page, the key its line stood above; a malformed `above` reads as none. */
+export const stashBlock = z.object({
+  removed_at: z.string(),
+  values: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
+  above: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).optional().catch(undefined),
+})
+export type StashBlock = z.infer<typeof stashBlock>
+
+export function stashedBlock(
+  sidecar: Record<string, unknown> | null,
+  propertyId: string,
+): StashBlock | null {
+  const block = isPlainObject(sidecar?.property_stash) ? sidecar.property_stash[propertyId] : null
+  const read = stashBlock.safeParse(block)
+  return read.success ? read.data : null
+}
+
+// The one writer of a sidecar's `property_stash` block — a block absent or holding no values removes the entry, an `above` stays only for a value the block holds, and an emptied stash leaves no key behind.
+export function patchStashBlock(
+  sidecar: Record<string, unknown>,
+  propertyId: string,
+  block?: StashBlock,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const stash = { ...(isPlainObject(sidecar.property_stash) ? sidecar.property_stash : {}) }
+  if (block && Object.keys(block.values).length) {
+    const above = Object.entries(block.above ?? {}).filter(([id]) =>
+      Object.hasOwn(block.values, id),
+    )
+    stash[propertyId] = { ...block, above: above.length ? Object.fromEntries(above) : undefined }
+  } else delete stash[propertyId]
+  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...sidecar }
+  if (Object.keys(stash).length) next.property_stash = stash
+  else delete next.property_stash
+  return next
+}
+
+/** Edits the values each Collection the tree lists as stashing one of `propertyIds` holds, through `edit`, which reads a block's values, its property's id, and its stamp, and answers its next values or null to leave it; answers how many it couldn't edit. */
+export async function editStashes(
+  root: string,
+  collections: readonly CollectionNode[],
+  propertyIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
+  edit: (
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    id: string,
+    removedAt: string,
+  ) => Record<string, unknown> | null,
+): Promise<number> {
+  let skipped = 0
+  for (const node of collections) {
+    const ids = (node.stashed ?? []).filter((id) => propertyIds.has(id))
+    if (!ids.length) continue
+    // Each block the edit changes keeps its stamp, and one it empties leaves.
+    const written = await patchSidecar(join(root, node.path), 'collection', (cur) => {
+      let next: Record<string, unknown> | null = null
+      for (const id of ids) {
+        const block = stashedBlock(next ?? cur, id)
+        const edited = block && edit(block.values, id, block.removed_at)
+        if (edited) next = patchStashBlock(next ?? cur, id, { ...block, values: edited })
+      }
+      return next
+    }).catch(() => null)
+    if (!written?.ok) skipped++
+  }
+  return skipped
+}
+
+/** Drops every block a Remove last stamped before the History Timeframe, in the Collections the held tree lists as stashing one; with none listed, it reads nothing. */
+export async function sweepStashes(root: string): Promise<void> {
+  const collections = heldTreeOf(root)?.collections ?? []
+  const ids = new Set(collections.flatMap((c) => c.stashed ?? []))
+  if (!ids.size) return
+  const cutoff = Date.now() - (await readFileHistoryConfig(root)).keepMs
+  await editStashes(root, collections, ids, (_values, _id, removedAt) =>
+    Date.parse(removedAt) < cutoff ? {} : null,
+  )
+}
```

```/Core/Properties/propertyValue.ts diff
+export const currencySymbol = (currency: string): string =>

+const NUMBER_SHAPE = new RegExp(`^([+-]?)((?:${SYMBOL})\\s*)?(.*?)(\\s*(?:%|${SYMBOL}))?$`)
+const GROUPED = /^[+-]?\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?$/

+interface NumberShape {
+  value: number
+  lead: string
+  tail: string
+  grouped: boolean
+  places: number

+/** The number a string spells, the inverse of a cell's own formatting: digits as `numberFrom` reads them, commas only as thousands, and a currency symbol before, or a `%` or a symbol after, never both. */
+function numberShape(raw: unknown): NumberShape | null {
+  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return null
+  const m = NUMBER_SHAPE.exec(raw.trim())
+  if (!m || (m[2] && m[4])) return null
+  const [, sign, lead = '', body, tail = ''] = m
+  const grouped = GROUPED.test(body)
+  const value = numberFrom(sign + (grouped ? body.replaceAll(',', '') : body))
+  const places = /\.(\d+)$/.exec(body)?.[1].length ?? 0
+  return value === undefined ? null : { value, lead, tail, grouped, places }
```

```/Core/Properties/typeDisplay.ts diff
+export const propertyTypeIconName = (type: ColumnType): IconName => TYPE_META[type].icon
+
+export const propertyIcon = (def: PropertyDefinition): string =>
+  asRenderableIcon(def.icon) ?? propertyTypeIconName(def.type)
+
+/** How an option of this type draws as a chip; a type declaring none draws as a Select's. */
+export const chipOf = (type: ColumnType): Chip => TYPE_META[type].chip ?? TAG
+
+/** A look menu's name: Format where it sets how a value is written (Link and the dates), Style where it sets how it's drawn. */
+export const styleLabel = (type: ColumnType): string => TYPE_META[type].styleLabel ?? 'Style'
```

##### Core/Properties/unassignProperty.ts

```/Core/Properties/unassignProperty.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { assignedIds } from '../Nexus/containerFields'
+import { stashedBlock, patchStashBlock } from './propertyStash'
+import { findHolders, heldAbove, heldValues, unaddressed } from '../Index/keyHolders'
+import { patchSidecar } from '../Files/sidecar'
+import { sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { readJsonObject } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { sweepGovernedRoots } from '../Nexus/governedSweep'
+import { stripKeys } from '../Files/rootValues'
+import { readRegistry, serializeSchemaOp } from './propertiesRegistry'
+import { ok } from '../Contract/result'
+import { mapViews } from '../Views/views'
+import { type ConfigReach, propertyClear, reachConfig, sweptReach } from '../Nexus/configReach'
+import type { MutateReply } from '../Nexus/mutateRequest'
+import { distinct, propertyNote, runNoted } from '../Nexus/owed'
+import { containerAt } from '../Nexus/treePatch'
+import { liveTreeOf } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import { relative } from '../Paths/posix'
+import type { PropertyDefinition } from './properties'
+
+export function unassignProperty(
+  root: string,
+  collectionFolder: string,
+  propertyId: string,
+): Promise<MutateReply> {
+  return serializeSchemaOp(root, () => unassignInner(root, collectionFolder, propertyId))
+}
+
+async function unassignInner(
+  root: string,
+  collectionFolder: string,
+  propertyId: string,
+): Promise<MutateReply> {
+  const collection = containerAt(await liveTreeOf(root), relative(root, collectionFolder))
+  const sidecar = await readJsonObject(sidecarPath(collectionFolder, 'collection'))
+  if (!collection || !assignedIds(sidecar).includes(propertyId)) return ok({})
+
+  const def = (await readRegistry(root)).defs[propertyId]
+  if (!def) return ok({})
+  const clear = propertyClear(propertyId)
+  // The note names the Collection by id, since its folder can move or be renamed before a finish.
+  return runNoted(root, propertyId, {
+    note: (e) => ({
+      ...propertyNote(e),
+      collections: distinct(propertyNote(e).collections, [collection.id]),
+    }),
+    // The views and the assignment change in one write under the sidecar's own lock, so no concurrent icon, banner, or view write is reverted; the stash follows in `stashAndStrip`.
+    list: () =>
+      patchSidecar(collectionFolder, 'collection', (cur) => ({
+        ...(mapViews(cur, clear) ?? cur),
+        properties: assignedIds(cur).filter((id) => id !== propertyId),
+      })),
+    sweep: async () => {
+      const reach = await reachConfig(root, { kind: 'property', propertyId }, collectionFolder)
+      const stripped = await stashAndStrip(root, collectionFolder, def)
+      return { ...stripped, skipped: reach.skipped + stripped.skipped, hosts: reach.hosts }
+    },
+    settle: (e) => ({
+      ...propertyNote(e),
+      collections: distinct(propertyNote(e).collections?.filter((id) => id !== collection.id)),
+    }),
+    under: propertyId,
+  })
+}
+
+/** Moves the values the Collection's holders hold for `def` into its stash, then strips the key, answering what it couldn't reach: a file it can't read or rewrite, and a holder with no id to stash under, which keeps its value. The stash keeps what it already holds, which a refill cut short left for pages it never reached. */
+export async function stashAndStrip(
+  root: string,
+  folder: string,
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+): Promise<ConfigReach> {
+  const { files, held } = await findHolders(
+    root,
+    { keys: [def.key], reach: { collection: folder } },
+    'values',
+  )
+  const values = heldValues(held, def.key)
+  const above = heldAbove(held, def.key)
+  if (Object.keys(values).length) {
+    const stashed = await patchSidecar(folder, 'collection', (cur) =>
+      patchStashBlock(cur, def.id, {
+        removed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
+        values: { ...stashedBlock(cur, def.id)?.values, ...values },
+        above: { ...stashedBlock(cur, def.id)?.above, ...above },
+      }),
+    )
+    if (!stashed.ok) return { skipped: held.length, hosts: [] }
+  }
+  const swept = await sweepGovernedRoots(files, { raw: (r) => stripKeys(r, [def.key]) })
+  return { ...sweptReach(swept), skipped: swept.skipped.length + unaddressed(held) }
+}
```
