##### Core/Properties/Cells/ValueSeat.tsx

```/Core/Properties/Cells/ValueSeat.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react'
+import { isSecondaryClick } from '@pommora/uix/Interactions/chords'
+import { useHeld } from '@pommora/uix/Animations/useExitPresence'
+import { useLatest } from '@pommora/uix/Utilities/stableApi'
+import type { ResolvedColumn, ViewRow } from '../../Views/viewRow'
+import { propertyColumn } from '../../Views/Pipeline/columns'
+import type { ConnPage } from '../../Connections/pageIndex'
+import type { ConnectionsApi } from '../../MarkdownPM/Links/connectionsApi'
+import { readLinkText, resolveLink } from '../../Connections/linkValue'
+import {
+  type CellMenuAction,
+  cellMenuContextFor,
+  cellMenuModel,
+  type HideFrom,
+} from '../../Actions/cellMenu'
+import { parseStyleAction } from '../../Actions/columnMenu'
+import { type ConnEditAction, type LinkAction, linkMenuTarget } from '../../Actions/connectionMenu'
+import { popMenu } from '../../Actions/menuActions'
+import { showConnectionMenu } from '../../Interface/Menus/connectionMenuActions'
+import { contextOptionsFor } from '../../Contexts/contextOptions'
+import { previewConnections } from '../../Session/pageConnections'
+import { useSession } from '../../Session/store'
+import type { ColumnStyle } from '../columnStyles'
+import { numberBarCapable } from '../formatValue'
+import { resolveFieldValue } from '../fieldValue'
+import { pickKindOf } from '../properties'
+import { isBlankValue, type PropertyValue } from '../propertyValue'
+import { fileChipIndex, pickFileInto, runFileMenuAction } from '../Pickers/filePick'
+import { type PickEntry, PropertyPicker, type PickTarget } from '../Pickers/PropertyPicker'
+import { PropertyValueInput } from '../Pickers/PropertyValueInput'
+import { type ValueIntent, valueClickIntent, valueMenuIntent } from '../Pickers/valueClick'
+
+/** What a surface hands the seat: how it reads and writes a row, where a pane anchors, and the few things it does differently from the others. */
+export type SeatHost = {
+  rowOf: (id: string) => ViewRow | undefined
+  /** The open value's column, read fresh each render so the picker lists an option created while it's open. */
+  columnOf: (id: string) => ResolvedColumn | undefined
+  commit: (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn, value: PropertyValue | null) => void
+  /** The element a pane opened from `el` anchors to. */
+  anchor: (el: HTMLElement, column: ResolvedColumn) => HTMLElement
+  holder: (row: ViewRow) => ConnPage | undefined
+  connections?: () => ConnectionsApi | undefined
+  /** Null where a surface holds no column look: the panel, whose menu offers no Style and whose calendar reads the Nexus's forms. */
+  style: (column: ResolvedColumn) => ColumnStyle | null
+  /** A surface that styles its columns: its picker edits option looks. */
+  setStyle?: (column: ResolvedColumn, key: keyof ColumnStyle & string, value: string) => void
+  /** Cards center an option picker on the click. */
+  centered?: true
+  /** Keeps the surface's hover ghost down while a value's menu is open. */
+  hold?: <T>(menu: () => Promise<T>) => Promise<T>
+  /** Present where a value's menu offers Remove, naming what Remove takes the value out of. */
+  hide?: { from: HideFrom; run: (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn) => void }
+  /** The panel's Clear, which keeps its row shown. */
+  clear?: (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn) => void
+  onClose?: () => void
+}
+
+type Mode = 'picker' | 'editor' | 'popover'
+
+/** React events cross portals along the component tree, so a gesture inside a pane a value's field opened, such as its link suggestions, reaches the seat too. */
+const fromPane = (e: React.MouseEvent): boolean => !e.currentTarget.contains(e.target as Node)
+
+type SeatOpen = {
+  rowId: string
+  columnId: string
+  mode: Mode
+  seat?: ConnEditAction
+  x?: number
+  /** Counts every open, so opening the same value again mounts a fresh popover. */
+  nonce: number
+}
+
+export type ValueSeatApi = ReturnType<typeof useValueSeat>
+
+/** One value's click, right-click, and editing, shared by the table, cards, the Properties panel, and the menus that open away from a value. */
+export function useValueSeat(host: SeatHost) {
+  const tree = useSession((s) => s.tree)
+  // A menu resolves after its await, by when a view save may have handed the seat a new host.
+  const live = useLatest(host)
+  const [open, setOpen] = useState<SeatOpen | null>(null)
+  const anchor = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)
+  const opens = useRef(0)
+  const close = (): void => {
+    setOpen(null)
+    host.onClose?.()
+  }
+  // A pane whose anchor left the page closes: its row is gone, or a compact card dropped the value it just cleared. So does one whose column no longer resolves.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (open && (!anchor.current?.isConnected || !host.columnOf(open.columnId))) close()
+  })
+
+  const intentOf = (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn): ValueIntent | null =>
+    valueClickIntent(
+      column.type,
+      resolveFieldValue(row, column),
+      host.style(column)?.look,
+      column.def,
+    )
+
+  /** True when a handler ran. `from` is the element the gesture landed on, which picks a File chip; `x` centers an option picker. */
+  const run = (
+    row: ViewRow,
+    column: ResolvedColumn,
+    intent: ValueIntent | null,
+    el: HTMLElement | null,
+    from: EventTarget | null = null,
+    x?: number,
+  ): boolean => {
+    const float = (mode: Mode, seat?: ConnEditAction, at?: number): true => {
+      anchor.current = el
+      opens.current += 1
+      setOpen({ rowId: row.id, columnId: column.id, mode, seat, x: at, nonce: opens.current })
+      return true
+    }
+    const { commit, clear, hide } = live.current
+    if (!intent) return false
+    switch (intent.kind) {
+      case 'commit':
+        if (intent.value === null && clear) clear(row, column)
+        else commit(row, column, intent.value)
+        return true
+      case 'file':
+        if (column.def)
+          pickFileInto(column.def, resolveFieldValue(row, column), fileChipIndex(from), (value) =>
+            commit(row, column, value),
+          )
+        return true
+      case 'picker':
+        return float('picker', undefined, x)
+      case 'dateTime':
+        return float('picker')
+      case 'edit':
+        return float('editor', intent.seat)
+      case 'popover':
+        return float('popover', intent.seat)
+      case 'hide':
+        hide?.run(row, column)
+        return hide !== undefined
+    }
+  }
+
+  const click = (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn, e: React.MouseEvent): void => {
+    // A secondary click fires `click` beside `contextmenu`, and the menu takes it.
+    if (isSecondaryClick(e)) return
+    const el = host.anchor(e.currentTarget as HTMLElement, column)
+    const x = host.centered ? e.clientX : undefined
+    if (fromPane(e) || run(row, column, intentOf(row, column), el, e.target, x)) e.stopPropagation()
+  }
+
+  const pane = (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn, at: HTMLElement): void => {
+    run(row, column, { kind: 'popover' }, host.anchor(at, column))
+  }
+
+  /** `label` is the panel row's name, which offers the row menu even over a link the connection menu could open. */
+  const menu = async (
+    row: ViewRow,
+    column: ResolvedColumn,
+    e: React.MouseEvent,
+    { label }: { label?: true } = {},
+  ): Promise<void> => {
+    e.preventDefault()
+    e.stopPropagation()
+    if (fromPane(e)) return
+    // Read before the await, since React recycles the event once the menu resolves.
+    const el = host.anchor(e.currentTarget as HTMLElement, column)
+    const chip = fileChipIndex(e.target)
+    const value = resolveFieldValue(row, column)
+    const hold: NonNullable<SeatHost['hold']> = host.hold ?? ((show) => show())
+    const act = (action: CellMenuAction | LinkAction): boolean =>
+      run(row, column, valueMenuIntent(action), el)
+    const link =
+      !label && value.kind === 'link'
+        ? linkMenuTarget(
+            resolveLink(readLinkText(value.value), host.connections?.()?.index, host.holder(row)),
+            true,
+            { hideable: host.hide?.from },
+          )
+        : null
+    if (link) {
+      const action = await hold(() => showConnectionMenu(link))
+      if (action) act(action)
+      return
+    }
+    const filled = !isBlankValue(value)
+    const context = cellMenuContextFor(column.type, host.style(column), filled, {
+      hideable: host.hide?.from,
+      barCapable: numberBarCapable(column.def),
+      onChip: chip !== null,
+    })
+    if (!context) return
+    const action = await hold(() => popMenu(cellMenuModel(context)))
+    const commit = (next: PropertyValue | null): void => live.current.commit(row, column, next)
+    if (!action || runFileMenuAction(action, column.def, value, chip, commit) || act(action)) return
+    const style = parseStyleAction(action)
+    if (style) live.current.setStyle?.(column, style.key, style.value)
+  }
+
+  /** A typed value's field, inline or, with `popover`, floating; a popover mounts fresh for every open. */
+  const input = (row: ViewRow, at: SeatOpen, popover = false): React.ReactNode => {
+    const column = host.columnOf(at.columnId)
+    return column?.def ? (
+      <PropertyValueInput
+        key={popover ? at.nonce : undefined}
+        popover={popover ? { open: open?.mode === 'popover', triggerRef: anchor } : undefined}
+        def={column.def}
+        current={resolveFieldValue(row, column)}
+        holder={host.holder(row)}
+        connections={host.connections}
+        seat={at.seat}
+        onCommit={(next) => host.commit(row, column, next)}
+        onClose={close}
+      />
+    ) : null
+  }
+
+  const editor = (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn): React.ReactNode =>
+    open?.mode === 'editor' && open.rowId === row.id && open.columnId === column.id
+      ? input(row, open)
+      : null
+
+  /** A row never lists itself among a Context's Spaces; a page row's id names no Space, so it excludes nothing. */
+  const target = (row: ViewRow, column: ResolvedColumn): PickTarget | null => {
+    const current = resolveFieldValue(row, column)
+    const style = host.style(column)
+    if (column.type === 'dateTime')
+      return {
+        kind: 'dateTime',
+        current,
+        dateFormat: style?.date_format,
+        timeFormat: style?.time_format,
+      }
+    const pick = pickKindOf(column.type)
+    if (!pick) return null
+    const { setStyle } = host
+    return {
+      kind: 'options',
+      column,
+      pick,
+      current,
+      style:
+        setStyle && style
+          ? { current: style, set: (key, value) => setStyle(column, key, value) }
+          : undefined,
+      contextOptions: contextOptionsFor(column, tree, row.id),
+    }
+  }
+
+  return { open, anchor, host, close, intentOf, run, click, pane, menu, input, editor, target }
+}
+
+/** A surface's add chooser on `row`, shown in the seat's picker so a drilled-in value opens in the same pane. */
+type SeatChooser = {
+  row: ViewRow
+  entries: PickEntry[]
+  onReveal: (entry: PickEntry) => void
+  onDismiss: () => void
+}
+
+/** The seat's floating panes: one picker, which a surface's add chooser shares, and one typed-value popover. Each holds the value it last opened on through its exit; the picker mounts fresh for another value and the popover for every open. */
+export function ValueSeat({
+  seat,
+  chooser,
+}: {
+  seat: ValueSeatApi
+  chooser?: SeatChooser | null
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  const { open, host } = seat
+  const last = useRef<{ picker?: SeatOpen; popover?: SeatOpen }>({})
+  if (open?.mode === 'picker' || open?.mode === 'popover') last.current[open.mode] = open
+  const picked = last.current.picker
+  const pickRow = picked && host.rowOf(picked.rowId)
+  const pickColumn = picked && host.columnOf(picked.columnId)
+  const typed = last.current.popover
+  const typedRow = typed && host.rowOf(typed.rowId)
+  return (
+    <>
+      <PropertyPicker
+        key={picked ? `${picked.rowId}:${picked.columnId}` : 'none'}
+        target={
+          !chooser && open?.mode === 'picker' && pickRow && pickColumn
+            ? seat.target(pickRow, pickColumn)
+            : null
+        }
+        chooser={chooser?.entries}
+        resolveTarget={
+          chooser
+            ? (entry) => {
+                const column = host.columnOf(entry.id)
+                return column ? seat.target(chooser.row, column) : null
+              }
+            : undefined
+        }
+        open={open?.mode === 'picker' || chooser != null}
+        triggerRef={seat.anchor}
+        anchorX={open?.mode === 'picker' ? open.x : undefined}
+        onCommit={(value, entry) => {
+          const column = entry ? host.columnOf(entry.id) : pickColumn
+          const row = entry ? chooser?.row : pickRow
+          if (row && column) host.commit(row, column, value)
+        }}
+        onReveal={chooser?.onReveal}
+        onDismiss={() => {
+          seat.close()
+          chooser?.onDismiss()
+        }}
+      />
+      {typed && typedRow && seat.input(typedRow, typed, true)}
+    </>
+  )
+}
+
+/** The seat for a value picked from a menu away from it: what a click would do, anchored at the menu's trigger, with a typed value in a popover since no value sits there to edit in place. */
+export function MenuSeat(): React.JSX.Element {
+  const pending = useSession((s) => s.pendingPick)
+  const dismiss = useSession((s) => s.dismissPick)
+  const registry = useSession((s) => s.tree?.config.registry)
+  const held = useHeld(pending, pending !== null)
+  // The request's row lives in its writer, so the seat reads it again after each commit.
+  const [, reread] = useReducer((n: number) => n + 1, 0)
+  const seat = useValueSeat({
+    rowOf: () => held?.rowOf(),
+    // A definition can change under its open picker, so a property's column resolves from the live registry.
+    columnOf: (id) => {
+      if (held?.column.kind !== 'property') return held?.column
+      const def = registry?.find((d) => d.id === id)
+      return def && propertyColumn(def)
+    },
+    commit: (_, column, value) => {
+      held?.commit(column, value)
+      reread()
+    },
+    anchor: (el) => el,
+    holder: () => held?.holder,
+    connections: previewConnections,
+    style: () => held?.style ?? null,
+    onClose: dismiss,
+  })
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!pending) return
+    const row = pending.rowOf()
+    if (!row) return dismiss()
+    const intent = seat.intentOf(row, pending.column)
+    seat.run(
+      row,
+      pending.column,
+      intent?.kind === 'edit' ? { kind: 'popover' } : intent,
+      pending.trigger,
+    )
+    // The file dialog opens no pane, so nothing is left to hold the menu's anchor.
+    if (intent?.kind === 'file') dismiss()
+  }, [pending])
+  return <ValueSeat seat={seat} />
+}
```

##### Core/Properties/Pickers/pickModel.ts

```/Core/Properties/Pickers/pickModel.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { groupOptions, optionGroupsOf, type OptionPickKind, type PickOption } from '../properties'
+import { type PropertyValue, selectedValues } from '../propertyValue'
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../../Views/viewRow'
+
+export type PickGroup = { id: string; options: PickOption[] }
+export type PickCommit = { index: number; next: PropertyValue | null }
+
+export const pickGroups = (column: ResolvedColumn, contextOptions?: PickOption[]): PickGroup[] =>
+  contextOptions
+    ? [{ id: column.id, options: contextOptions }]
+    : column.def
+      ? optionGroupsOf(column.def)
+          .map((g) => ({ id: g.id, options: groupOptions(g).map((o) => ({ ...o, value: o.id })) }))
+          .filter((g) => g.options.length > 0)
+      : []
+
+export const toggleValue = (selected: string[], value: string): string[] =>
+  selected.includes(value) ? selected.filter((v) => v !== value) : [...selected, value]
+
+// A value every row holds leaves them all; otherwise it lands on each row lacking it, a Select replacing what the row held and a list joining it.
+function pickCommits(kind: OptionPickKind, rows: string[][], value: string): PickCommit[] {
+  const all = rows.every((own) => own.includes(value))
+  return rows.flatMap<PickCommit>((own, index) => {
+    if (own.includes(value) !== all) return []
+    if (kind !== 'select') return [{ index, next: { kind, value: toggleValue(own, value) } }]
+    return [{ index, next: all ? null : { kind, value } }]
+  })
+}
+
+/** One pick over one row or many: what every row holds reads as picked, and a Select's picker closes once picked, since a Select holds one value. */
+export function pickOver(
+  kind: OptionPickKind,
+  currents: readonly (PropertyValue | null)[],
+  onCommit: (commits: PickCommit[]) => void,
+  onClose: () => void,
+): { selected: string[]; pick: (value: string) => void } {
+  const rows = currents.map(selectedValues)
+  return {
+    selected: rows[0].filter((v) => rows.every((own) => own.includes(v))),
+    pick: (value) => {
+      onCommit(pickCommits(kind, rows, value))
+      if (kind === 'select') onClose()
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+export const pickedValue = (
+  kind: OptionPickKind,
+  current: PropertyValue | null,
+  value: string,
+): PropertyValue | null => pickCommits(kind, [selectedValues(current)], value)[0].next
```

##### Core/Properties/Schema/OptionSlot.tsx

```/Core/Properties/Schema/OptionSlot.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { Reveal } from '@pommora/uix/Animations/Reveal'
+import { LineRow, useLineEl } from '@pommora/uix/Interactions/drag'
+import { Button } from '@pommora/uix/Buttons/Button'
+import { RenamableLabel } from '@pommora/uix/Fields/RenamableLabel'
+import { base } from '@pommora/uix/Fields/fields.css'
+import { Label } from '@pommora/uix/Labels/Label'
+import { colorNameFor } from '@pommora/uix/Theme/ramp'
+import type { ColumnLook } from '../columnStyles'
+import type { PropertyDefinition, PropertyType, SelectOption } from '../properties'
+import { OptionChip } from '../Cells/OptionChip'
+import { chipOf } from '../typeDisplay'
+import { ghostAnchorProps, type GhostAnchor } from '@pommora/uix/Interactions/ghostCreate'
+import * as s from '@pommora/uix/Menus/frames.css'
+
+export function OptionSlot({
+  option,
+  look,
+  def,
+  editing,
+  ghost,
+  onToggleEditing,
+  onOpenMenu,
+}: {
+  option: SelectOption
+  look: ColumnLook | undefined
+  def: Pick<PropertyDefinition, 'type' | 'status_groups'>
+  editing: boolean
+  ghost: GhostAnchor
+  onToggleEditing: (anchor: HTMLElement | undefined) => void
+  onOpenMenu: (row: HTMLElement) => void
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  const rowEl = useLineEl()
+  return (
+    <LineRow
+      id={option.id}
+      {...ghostAnchorProps(ghost, option.id)}
+      className={s.optionRow}
+      data-reveal-host=""
+      onContextMenu={(e) => {
+        e.preventDefault()
+        onOpenMenu(e.currentTarget)
+      }}
+    >
+      <span className={s.optionLead}>
+        <OptionChip type={def.type} look={look} option={option} def={def} />
+        {look === 'compact' && <span className={s.compactTitle}>{option.label}</span>}
+      </span>
+      <Button
+        size="button-inline"
+        paddingX="0"
+        icon="square-pen"
+        iconSize={s.ICON.optionEdit}
+        className={s.optionEditButton}
+        data-reveal-held={editing || undefined}
+        aria-label="Edit Option"
+        onClick={() => onToggleEditing(rowEl(option.id))}
+      />
+    </LineRow>
+  )
+}
+
+/** The chip a new option is named in, in its group's color. */
+export function OptionDraft({
+  edit,
+  type,
+  color,
+}: {
+  edit: { commitDraft: (label: string) => void; cancelDraft: () => void }
+  type: PropertyType
+  color?: string
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  return (
+    <Reveal open enterOnMount fill>
+      <Label shape={chipOf(type).shape} color={colorNameFor(color)}>
+        <RenamableLabel
+          renames="title"
+          editing
+          value=""
+          className={base}
+          autoSize
+          onCommit={edit.commitDraft}
+          onCancel={edit.cancelDraft}
+        />
+      </Label>
+    </Reveal>
+  )
+}
```

```/Core/Properties/Schema/formatRows.ts diff
+import type { PickerOption } from '@pommora/uix/Pickers/PickerControl'
+import type { IconName } from '@pommora/uix/Symbols'
+import { DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT, type FormatChange, type KeyFormat, keyFormat } from '../keyFormat'
+import { type PropertyDefinition, PROPERTY_TYPES } from '../properties'
+
+const FORMAT_OPTIONS: PickerOption<KeyFormat>[] = keyFormat.options.map((value) => ({
+  value,
+  label: value,
+}))
+
+export function formatRows(
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  onPick: (change: FormatChange) => void,
+): MenuRow[] {
+  const row = (
+    glyph: IconName,
+    label: string,
+    value: KeyFormat | undefined,
+    change: (format: KeyFormat) => FormatChange,
+  ): MenuRow =>
+    pickerRow(
+      glyph,
+      label,
+      value ?? DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT,
+      FORMAT_OPTIONS,
+      (v: KeyFormat) => onPick(change(v)),
+      { inert: true },
+    )
+  const label = row('metadata-label', 'Label Format', def.key_format, (key_format) => ({
+    key_format,
+  }))
+  return PROPERTY_TYPES[def.type].options
+    ? [
+        label,
+        row('layout-list', 'Value Format', def.value_format, (value_format) => ({ value_format })),
+      ]
+    : [label]
+}
```

##### Core/Properties/Schema/typeRows.tsx

```/Core/Properties/Schema/typeRows.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { PathField } from '@pommora/uix/Fields/PathField'
+import { type MenuRow, pickerRow, type Trailing } from '@pommora/uix/Menus'
+import { type PickerOption, pickerOptions } from '@pommora/uix/Pickers/PickerControl'
+import { resolveColor } from '@pommora/uix/Theme/ramp'
+import { numberFrom } from '@pommora/uix/Utilities/numberUnit'
+import { DEFAULT_LINK_DISPLAY, type LinkDisplay } from '../../Connections/linkValue'
+import { reportRefusal } from '../../Interface/Notifications/notifications'
+import { dialer } from '../../Platform/dialer'
+import {
+  type ColumnStyle,
+  LOOKS,
+  lookIn,
+  showsWeekday,
+  TIME_FORMATS,
+  WEEKDAY_FORMATS,
+} from '../columnStyles'
+import {
+  DATE_FORMAT_OPTIONS,
+  LINK_DISPLAY_OPTIONS,
+  lookOptions,
+  TIME_FORMAT_LABELS,
+  WEEKDAY_FORMAT_LABELS,
+} from '../displayLabels'
+import { numberBarCapable } from '../formatValue'
+import {
+  CURRENCY_CODES,
+  DEFAULT_CURRENCY,
+  type NumberConfig,
+  type NumberFamily,
+  type PropertyConfig,
+  type PropertyDefinition,
+  type PropertyType,
+} from '../properties'
+import { styleLabel } from '../typeDisplay'
+
+/** A type's settings write one of two scopes: `configure` the definition, wherever it's held; `setStyle` this view's column alone. */
+type RowContext = {
+  style: ColumnStyle
+  setStyle: (patch: Partial<ColumnStyle>) => void
+  configure: (patch: PropertyConfig) => void
+  assetRoot: string
+}
+
+const FAMILY_OPTIONS: PickerOption<NumberFamily>[] = [
+  { value: 'number', label: 'Number' },
+  { value: 'percent', label: 'Percent' },
+  { value: 'currency', label: 'Currency' },
+]
+const CURRENCY_OPTIONS: PickerOption<string>[] = CURRENCY_CODES.map((code) => ({
+  value: code,
+  label: code,
+}))
+const DECIMAL_OPTIONS: PickerOption<string>[] = [
+  { value: 'hidden', label: 'Hidden' },
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({ value: String(i + 1), label: String(i + 1) })),
+]
+const NUMBER_STYLE_OPTIONS = lookOptions(LOOKS.number)
+const CHECKBOX_STYLE_OPTIONS = lookOptions(LOOKS.checkbox)
+const WEEKDAY_OPTIONS = pickerOptions(WEEKDAY_FORMATS, WEEKDAY_FORMAT_LABELS)
+const TIME_OPTIONS = pickerOptions(TIME_FORMATS, TIME_FORMAT_LABELS)
+
+const decimalsToPicker = (d: NumberConfig['number_decimals']): string =>
+  typeof d === 'number' ? String(d) : 'hidden'
+const pickerToDecimals = (v: string): 'hidden' | number => (v === 'hidden' ? 'hidden' : Number(v))
+
+const ROW = { inert: true } as const
+const DATE_ROW = { ...ROW, iconSize: 'headline' } as const
+
+const item = (label: string, trailing: Trailing, reveal?: boolean): MenuRow => ({
+  kind: 'item',
+  label,
+  trailing,
+  reveal,
+  ...ROW,
+})
+
+const colorItem = (
+  value: string | undefined,
+  fallback: string,
+  onPick: (next: string | undefined) => void,
+): MenuRow => {
+  const { name, css } = resolveColor(value, fallback)
+  return item('Color', { kind: 'color', label: 'Color', selected: name, css, onPick })
+}
+
+function numberRows(
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  { style, setStyle, configure }: RowContext,
+): MenuRow[] {
+  const family: NumberFamily = def.number_family ?? 'number'
+  const percent = family === 'percent'
+  const fraction = def.number_fraction ?? false
+  return [
+    pickerRow(undefined, 'Format', family, FAMILY_OPTIONS, (v) => configure({ number_family: v }), {
+      ...ROW,
+      ariaLabel: 'Number format',
+    }),
+    pickerRow(
+      undefined,
+      'Currency',
+      def.number_currency ?? DEFAULT_CURRENCY,
+      CURRENCY_OPTIONS,
+      (v) => configure({ number_currency: v }),
+      { ...ROW, ariaLabel: 'Currency', reveal: family === 'currency' },
+    ),
+    item(
+      'Separators',
+      {
+        kind: 'switch',
+        checked: def.number_separators ?? true,
+        onChange: (next) => configure({ number_separators: next }),
+        ariaLabel: 'Separators',
+      },
+      !percent,
+    ),
+    pickerRow(
+      undefined,
+      'Decimals',
+      decimalsToPicker(def.number_decimals),
+      DECIMAL_OPTIONS,
+      (v) => configure({ number_decimals: pickerToDecimals(v) }),
+      { ...ROW, ariaLabel: 'Decimal places' },
+    ),
+    item(
+      'Fraction',
+      {
+        kind: 'switch',
+        checked: fraction,
+        onChange: (next) => configure({ number_fraction: next }),
+        ariaLabel: 'Fraction',
+      },
+      !percent,
+    ),
+    pickerRow(undefined, 'Value', '', [], () => {}, {
+      ...ROW,
+      ariaLabel: 'Fraction value',
+      reveal: !percent && fraction,
+      typeable: {
+        text: String(def.number_denominator ?? ''),
+        onCommit: (typed) => {
+          const n = numberFrom(typed)
+          if (typed === '' || (n !== undefined && n > 0)) configure({ number_denominator: n })
+        },
+      },
+    }),
+    pickerRow(
+      undefined,
+      styleLabel(def.type),
+      lookIn(LOOKS.number, style.look),
+      NUMBER_STYLE_OPTIONS,
+      (look) => setStyle({ look }),
+      { ...ROW, ariaLabel: 'Number style', reveal: numberBarCapable(def) },
+    ),
+  ]
+}
+
+/** Time stays visible under Relative — it still gates the "at <clock>" rendering. */
+const dateRows = (def: PropertyDefinition, { style, setStyle }: RowContext): MenuRow[] => [
+  { kind: 'heading', label: styleLabel(def.type) },
+  pickerRow(
+    'calendar-days',
+    'Date',
+    style.date_format,
+    DATE_FORMAT_OPTIONS,
+    (v) => setStyle({ date_format: v }),
+    { ...DATE_ROW, ariaLabel: 'Date format' },
+  ),
+  pickerRow('calendar', 'Day', style.weekday, WEEKDAY_OPTIONS, (v) => setStyle({ weekday: v }), {
+    ...DATE_ROW,
+    ariaLabel: 'Weekday format',
+    reveal: showsWeekday(style.date_format),
+  }),
+  pickerRow('clock', 'Time', style.time_format, TIME_OPTIONS, (v) => setStyle({ time_format: v }), {
+    ...DATE_ROW,
+    ariaLabel: 'Time format',
+  }),
+]
+
+const linkRows = (def: PropertyDefinition, { configure }: RowContext): MenuRow[] => [
+  item('Underline', {
+    kind: 'switch',
+    checked: def.link_underline ?? false,
+    onChange: (v) => configure({ link_underline: v }),
+    ariaLabel: 'Underline links',
+  }),
+  colorItem(def.link_color, 'var(--link)', (next) => configure({ link_color: next })),
+  pickerRow(
+    undefined,
+    styleLabel(def.type),
+    def.link_display ?? DEFAULT_LINK_DISPLAY,
+    LINK_DISPLAY_OPTIONS,
+    (v: LinkDisplay) => configure({ link_display: v }),
+    { ...ROW, ariaLabel: 'Link format' },
+  ),
+]
+
+const checkboxRows = (
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  { style, setStyle, configure }: RowContext,
+): MenuRow[] => [
+  colorItem(def.checkbox_color, 'var(--checkbox-base)', (next) =>
+    configure({ checkbox_color: next }),
+  ),
+  pickerRow(
+    undefined,
+    styleLabel(def.type),
+    lookIn(LOOKS.checkbox, style.look),
+    CHECKBOX_STYLE_OPTIONS,
+    (look) => setStyle({ look }),
+    { ...ROW, ariaLabel: 'Checkbox style' },
+  ),
+]
+
+/** Relative to the asset root rather than to the nexus, so re-pointing the root carries it along; a refused choice offers the folder picker again. */
+const fileRows = (def: PropertyDefinition, { configure, assetRoot }: RowContext): MenuRow[] => {
+  const browse = (): void =>
+    void dialer()
+      .ask('assets:chooseDir', 'property', def.file_directory)
+      .then((picked) => {
+        if (reportRefusal(picked, browse) && picked.value !== null)
+          configure({ file_directory: picked.value })
+      })
+  return [
+    item('Directory', {
+      kind: 'field',
+      children: (
+        <PathField
+          label="Directory"
+          value={def.file_directory ?? ''}
+          empty={assetRoot}
+          onCommit={(dir) => configure({ file_directory: dir })}
+          onBrowse={browse}
+        />
+      ),
+    }),
+  ]
+}
+
+const NONE = (): MenuRow[] => []
+
+// One arm per property type, so a type added is a compile error here rather than a blank pane: the option types edit in the option list, and Text and a registry Context carry no settings.
+const TYPE_ROWS: Record<PropertyType, (def: PropertyDefinition, ctx: RowContext) => MenuRow[]> = {
+  number: numberRows,
+  dateTime: dateRows,
+  link: linkRows,
+  checkbox: checkboxRows,
+  file: fileRows,
+  select: NONE,
+  multiSelect: NONE,
+  status: NONE,
+  text: NONE,
+  context: NONE,
+}
+
+export const rowsFor = (def: PropertyDefinition, ctx: RowContext): MenuRow[] =>
+  TYPE_ROWS[def.type](def, ctx)
```

```/Core/Testing/hostFs.ts diff
+/** A Space the tree holds: its sidecar, and its Context in the Context list when the list doesn't name it. */
 export const seedSpaceSidecar = async (
   root: string,
   contextTitle: string,
   spaceName: string,
   raw: Record<string, unknown>,
 ): Promise<string> => {
+  const registry = join(root, CONTEXTS_REGISTRY_REL)
+  const { contexts } = await readJsonAt<{ contexts: { title: string }[] }>(registry).catch(() => ({
+    contexts: [],
+  }))
+  if (!contexts.some((c) => c.title === contextTitle))
+    await putJson(registry, {
+      contexts: [...contexts, { id: `ctx_${contextTitle}`, title: contextTitle }],
+    })
   const file = join(contextsDir(root), contextTitle, spaceName, SPACE_SIDECAR)
   await putJson(file, raw)
   return file
 }
+
+/** `assigned` maps a Collection folder, root-relative, to the property ids it assigns; its sidecar's id is the folder's own name. */
+export async function seedNexus(
+  root: string,
+  opts: { defs?: PropertyDefinition[]; assigned?: Record<string, string[]> } = {},
+): Promise<void> {
+  if (opts.defs)
+    await putJson(nexusConfig(root, NEXUS_CONFIG_FILES.properties), {
+      order: opts.defs.map((d) => d.id),
+      defs: Object.fromEntries(opts.defs.map((d) => [d.id, d])),
+    })
+  for (const [folder, properties] of Object.entries(opts.assigned ?? {}))
+    await putJson(sidecarPath(join(root, folder), 'collection'), {
+      id: basename(folder),
+      properties,
+    })
+}
```

##### Core/Trash/trashedCopies.ts

```/Core/Trash/trashedCopies.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// The Link values the Trash keeps for what it holds: a stripped value parked with the trashed page it names, so that page's restore writes it back, and a returning value refilled into a trashed copy it can't reach live.
+
+import { join, relative } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { SPACE_SIDECAR } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { readLinkText } from '../Connections/linkValue'
+import { buildPageIndex, type PageIndex, pageKey } from '../Connections/pageIndex'
+import type { StrippedLink } from '../Nexus/cascade'
+import type { Frozen } from '../Nexus/governedRoot'
+import type { Json } from '../Files/stableJson'
+import { type Worked, workedOut } from '../Nexus/owed'
+import { spaceIdsIn } from '../Contexts/spaceSidecar'
+import { stampedIdOf } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import { refillOf, rootId, sweepGovernedRoots } from '../Nexus/governedSweep'
+import type { PropertyDefinition } from '../Properties/properties'
+import { contentPages, listBundles, originPagesIn } from '../Bundles/bundle'
+import { collectionOf, originOf, patchRecord } from '../Bundles/record'
+
+const appendLinks = (bundleDir: string, links: StrippedLink[]): Promise<void> =>
+  patchRecord(bundleDir, (raw) => ({
+    links: [...(Array.isArray(raw.links) ? raw.links : []), ...links],
+  }))
+/** A world a value is read against: a key `targets` recorded at the delete answers by whether the page it named is there under any name, any other key by the name. */
+export function frozenWorld(
+  index: PageIndex,
+  targets: ReadonlyMap<string, { id: string }> = new Map(),
+): Frozen {
+  return {
+    holds: (title) => {
+      const id = targets.get(pageKey(title))?.id
+      return id === undefined ? index.holders(title).length > 0 : index.byId.has(id)
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+/** A Link value dropped for naming a page the Trash holds joins that page's bundle, so its restore writes it back; a key two trashed pages answer names neither. */
+export async function parkLinks(root: string, links: StrippedLink[]): Promise<void> {
+  if (!links.length) return
+  const index = buildPageIndex(await originPagesIn(root, { kind: 'trash' }))
+  const parked = new Map<string, StrippedLink[]>()
+  for (const link of links) {
+    const page = readLinkText(link.value)
+    const bundle = page?.kind === 'page' ? index.resolve(page.title).page?.id : undefined
+    if (bundle) parked.set(bundle, [...(parked.get(bundle) ?? []), link])
+  }
+  for (const [bundle, rows] of parked) await appendLinks(bundle, rows)
+}
+
+/** Where the Trash holds each page or Space `ids` names: the file its values live in; with `from`, only the pages trashed from that Collection. */
+export async function trashedHolders(
+  root: string,
+  ids: ReadonlySet<string>,
+  from?: string,
+): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
+  const found = new Map<string, string>()
+  for (const { bundlePath, record, artifactName } of await listBundles(root, { kind: 'trash' })) {
+    if (!artifactName) continue
+    const origin = from === undefined ? null : originOf(record)
+    if (from !== undefined && (!origin || collectionOf(origin) !== from)) continue
+    const artifact = join(root, bundlePath, artifactName)
+    switch (record.entity) {
+      case 'page':
+        if (record.id && ids.has(record.id)) found.set(record.id, artifact)
+        break
+      case 'set':
+      case 'collection':
+        for (const page of await contentPages(record.entity, artifact)) {
+          const id = await stampedIdOf(page)
+          if (id && ids.has(id)) found.set(id, page)
+        }
+        break
+      case 'space':
+        if (ids.has(record.id)) found.set(record.id, join(artifact, SPACE_SIDECAR))
+        break
+      case 'context':
+        for (const [name, id] of (await spaceIdsIn(artifact)).ids)
+          if (ids.has(id)) found.set(id, join(artifact, name, SPACE_SIDECAR))
+        break
+    }
+  }
+  return found
+}
+
+/** A Link value whose page or Space sits in the Trash goes back into its trashed copy as a live refill would land it, so it returns with it. Answers what it worked out for each copy it couldn't write, by the copy's path: what the copy read and what it would become, or for a copy it couldn't read, every value its page is owed, landing where the copy still reads blank. */
+export async function refillTrashed(
+  root: string,
+  links: StrippedLink[],
+  defs: readonly PropertyDefinition[],
+  frozen: Frozen,
+): Promise<Worked> {
+  if (!links.length) return {}
+  const holders = await trashedHolders(root, new Set(links.map((l) => l.page)))
+  const refills = new Map(defs.map((d) => [d.id, refillOf(d, frozen)]))
+  const refilled = (raw: Json, id: string | undefined): Json => {
+    let next = raw
+    for (const { page, property, value } of links)
+      if (page === id) next = refills.get(property)?.(next, value) ?? next
+    return next
+  }
+  const keyOf = new Map(defs.map((d) => [d.id, d.key]))
+  const seen = new Map<string, [Json, Json]>()
+  const swept = await sweepGovernedRoots([...holders.values()], {
+    raw: (raw, file) => {
+      const next = refilled(raw, rootId(file, raw))
+      if (next === raw) return null
+      seen.set(file, [raw, next])
+      return next
+    },
+    above: (raw, file) => (key) =>
+      links.find((l) => l.page === rootId(file, raw) && keyOf.get(l.property) === key)?.above,
+  })
+  // A copy read and not written is owed what its read became, as the scrub's are; one it couldn't read is owed what lands where it reads blank.
+  const owed = [...holders].flatMap(([id, file]) => {
+    const worked = workedOut(...(seen.get(file) ?? [{}, refilled({}, id)]))
+    return swept.skipped.includes(file) && Object.keys(worked).length
+      ? [[relative(root, file), worked] as const]
+      : []
+  })
+  return Object.fromEntries(owed)
+}
```

```/Core/Views/paneTargets.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { FILEDATA, type Filedata, type PropertyDefinition } from '../Properties/properties'
+import type { NexusTree } from '../Nexus/tree'
+import { contextsByIdOf } from '../Contexts/contextIdentity'
+import type { PickerOption } from '@pommora/uix/Pickers/PickerControl'
+import { propertyIcon, propertyTypeIconName } from '../Properties/typeDisplay'
+
+export interface PaneTarget {
+  id: string
+  label: string
+  icon: string
+}
+
+// Location has no column type, so its glyph is named here.
+const filedataTarget = ({ id, label, type }: Filedata): PaneTarget => ({
+  id,
+  label,
+  icon: type ? propertyTypeIconName(type) : 'folder',
+})
+export const FILEDATA_TARGETS = {
+  title: filedataTarget(FILEDATA.title),
+  createdAt: filedataTarget(FILEDATA.createdAt),
+  modifiedAt: filedataTarget(FILEDATA.modifiedAt),
+  location: filedataTarget(FILEDATA.location),
+}
+
+export const contextPaneTargets = (tree: NexusTree | null): PaneTarget[] =>
+  [...contextsByIdOf(tree)].map(([id, c]) => ({ id, label: c.title, icon: c.icon }))
+
+export const schemaTargets = (
+  schema: PropertyDefinition[],
+  qualifies: (def: PropertyDefinition) => boolean,
+): (PaneTarget & { def: PropertyDefinition })[] =>
+  schema.filter(qualifies).map((d) => ({
+    id: d.id,
+    label: d.label,
+    icon: propertyIcon(d),
+    def: d,
+  }))
+
+export const targetOption = (t: PaneTarget): PickerOption<string> => ({
+  value: t.id,
+  label: t.label,
+  icon: t.icon,
+})
```

```/Core/Views/valueKinds.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// What each value kind does in a view: the operators the filter pane offers, how a rule tests a value, the key a sort compares, the band a grouping files a value under, and the value a new page takes from a rule, a band, or a sort neighbor.
+
+import { localDayKey, pad } from '@pommora/uix/Utilities/pad'
+import { foldKey } from '../Paths/caseFold'
+import {
+  type ColumnType,
+  optionIds,
+  type PropertyDefinition,
+  specOf,
+} from '../Properties/properties'
+import {
+  checkboxValue,
+  checkboxWord,
+  isBlankValue,
+  type PropertyValue,
+  readNumber,
+  selectedValues,
+  type ValueKind,
+} from '../Properties/propertyValue'
+import { dayMs, type LocalDate, readDate, shownText } from '../Properties/formatValue'
+import { FILTER_OPS } from './filterRules'
+import type { DateGranularity } from './views'
+
+type ValueSlot = 'none' | 'text' | 'number' | 'date' | 'chips' | 'set'
+
+export interface OperatorChoice {
+  op: string
+  label: string
+  slot: ValueSlot
+  impliedValue?: string
+  /** A typed folder name is an operand as well as a picked folder. */
+  names?: true
+}
+
+type ValueTest = (v: PropertyValue) => boolean
+export type SortDirections = 'option' | 'text' | 'value'
+
+type ValueKindSpec = Readonly<{
+  /** The operators the filter pane offers, in its menu's order; a hand-written rule may hold others the kind still answers. */
+  ops: readonly OperatorChoice[]
+  /** Is Empty matches a value this reads as unfilled, and Isn't Empty one it reads as filled. */
+  filled: ValueTest
+  /** A rule's test, its operands read once; undefined, so the rule abstains, for an op the kind doesn't answer or an operand that doesn't read. */
+  prepare(
+    op: string,
+    want: readonly string[],
+    def?: PropertyDefinition,
+    held?: readonly string[],
+  ): ValueTest | undefined
+  /** A criterion's key reader, built once per sort; a null key sorts last in either direction, and a kind with no reader doesn't sort. */
+  sortKey?(
+    def?: PropertyDefinition,
+    order?: readonly string[],
+  ): (v: PropertyValue) => string | number | null
+  /** Which pair of words a Sort or Group pane names an order's directions with; an option kind's order alone takes Custom. */
+  directions: SortDirections
+  /** A view can group by the kind; Checkbox's band serves the sort-run reassign alone. */
+  groups?: true
+  /** The band a grouping files a value under; null files it with the value-less rows. */
+  bucket?(v: PropertyValue, granularity: DateGranularity): string | null
+  /** The value a new page takes from a rule naming one operand, null when the rule's op names none; a band's key seeds the value an Is rule naming it would. */
+  seed?(op: string, operand: string): PropertyValue | null
+  /** A page created beside another under a sort on this kind takes the other's value. */
+  sortSeeds?: true
+}>
+
+const EMPTIES: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.isEmpty, label: 'Is Empty', slot: 'none' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.isNotEmpty, label: "Isn't Empty", slot: 'none' },
+]
+
+const TEXT_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: 'Is', slot: 'text' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.isNot, label: "Isn't", slot: 'text' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.startsWith, label: 'Starts With', slot: 'text' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.contains, label: 'Contains', slot: 'text' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.doesNotContain, label: "Doesn't Contain", slot: 'text' },
+  ...EMPTIES,
+]
+
+/** The Starts and Ends ops are inclusive — the strict variants stay registered for hand-authored files, but the frame doesn't offer a second near-identical set. */
+const DATE_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: 'Is', slot: 'date' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.onOrBefore, label: 'Starts Before', slot: 'date' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.onOrAfter, label: 'Starts After', slot: 'date' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.endsOnOrBefore, label: 'Ends Before', slot: 'date' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.endsOnOrAfter, label: 'Ends After', slot: 'date' },
+  ...EMPTIES,
+]
+
+const SET_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.containsAny, label: 'Is Any', slot: 'chips' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.containsAll, label: 'Is All', slot: 'chips' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.doesNotContain, label: "Isn't", slot: 'chips' },
+  ...EMPTIES,
+]
+
+const NUMBER_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: 'Is', slot: 'number' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.isNot, label: "Isn't", slot: 'number' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.greaterThan, label: 'Greater Than', slot: 'number' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.greaterOrEqual, label: 'At Least', slot: 'number' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.lessThan, label: 'Less Than', slot: 'number' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.lessOrEqual, label: 'At Most', slot: 'number' },
+  ...EMPTIES,
+]
+
+/** Is/Isn't are chip pickers whose multi-chips mean any-of/none-of — never Is All, which is unsatisfiable on a one-value property. */
+const OPTION_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: 'Is', slot: 'chips' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.isNot, label: "Isn't", slot: 'chips' },
+  ...EMPTIES,
+]
+
+const CHECKBOX_OPS: OperatorChoice[] = [
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: 'Is Checked', slot: 'none', impliedValue: 'true' },
+  { op: FILTER_OPS.is, label: "Isn't Checked", slot: 'none', impliedValue: 'false' },
+]
+
+const LIST_OPS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([FILTER_OPS.containsAny, FILTER_OPS.containsAll])
+
+const notBlank: ValueTest = (v) => !isBlankValue(v)
+const showsText: ValueTest = (v) => !!shownText(v)
+
+/** Is and Isn't compare a value's whole shown text, and the others search within it, folded on both sides. */
+function prepareText(
+  op: string,
+  want: readonly string[],
+  def?: PropertyDefinition,
+): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const w = want.map(foldKey)
+  const shown = (v: PropertyValue): string | null => {
+    const s = shownText(v, def)
+    return s === null ? null : foldKey(s)
+  }
+  const is: ValueTest = (v) => {
+    const f = shown(v)
+    return f !== null && w.includes(f)
+  }
+  const contains: ValueTest = (v) => shown(v)?.includes(w[0]) ?? false
+  switch (op) {
+    case FILTER_OPS.is:
+      return is
+    case FILTER_OPS.isNot:
+      return (v) => !is(v)
+    case FILTER_OPS.contains:
+      return contains
+    case FILTER_OPS.doesNotContain:
+      return (v) => !contains(v)
+    case FILTER_OPS.startsWith:
+      return (v) => shown(v)?.startsWith(w[0]) ?? false
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+/** Is and the containing ops match a value holding any operand, Is All one holding every operand, and the two negations a value holding none. */
+function prepareMembers(op: string, want: readonly string[]): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const any: ValueTest = (v) => selectedValues(v).some((x) => want.includes(x))
+  switch (op) {
+    case FILTER_OPS.containsAll:
+      return (v) => {
+        const xs = selectedValues(v)
+        return want.every((w) => xs.includes(w))
+      }
+    case FILTER_OPS.is:
+    case FILTER_OPS.contains:
+    case FILTER_OPS.containsAny:
+      return any
+    case FILTER_OPS.isNot:
+    case FILTER_OPS.doesNotContain:
+      return (v) => !any(v)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+/** An option list's operands, kept only where they name an option it holds (a Select's or Multi-Select's listed options, a Context's Spaces); a rule naming none sits out, as an unreadable Number or Date operand does. */
+function prepareOptions(
+  op: string,
+  want: readonly string[],
+  def?: PropertyDefinition,
+  held: readonly string[] = def ? optionIds(def) : [],
+): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const listed = new Set(held)
+  const live = want.filter((id) => listed.has(id))
+  return live.length ? prepareMembers(op, live) : undefined
+}
+
+function prepareNumber(op: string, want: readonly string[]): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const e = readNumber(want[0])
+  if (e === undefined) return undefined
+  const holds =
+    (test: (n: number) => boolean): ValueTest =>
+    (v) =>
+      v.kind === 'number' && test(v.value)
+  const is = holds((n) => n === e)
+  switch (op) {
+    case FILTER_OPS.is:
+      return is
+    case FILTER_OPS.isNot:
+      return (v) => !is(v)
+    case FILTER_OPS.greaterThan:
+      return holds((n) => n > e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.lessThan:
+      return holds((n) => n < e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.greaterOrEqual:
+      return holds((n) => n >= e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.lessOrEqual:
+      return holds((n) => n <= e)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+/** Days are the local days the cells show. `is` matches a day the value spans; a bare-day operand orders by day, and one carrying a time orders by instant. The Starts ops and the strict pair read a span's start, the Ends ops its end. */
+function prepareDate(op: string, want: readonly string[]): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const target = readDate(want[0])
+  if (target === null) return undefined
+  const ms = (x: Date): number => (target.timed ? x.getTime() : dayMs(x))
+  const e = ms(target.at)
+  const day = dayMs(target.at)
+  // A clockless end holds its whole day, so a timed operand meets it at the day's last instant.
+  const endMs = (d: LocalDate): number => {
+    const last = d.end ?? d.at
+    return d.timed || !target.timed
+      ? ms(last)
+      : new Date(last.getFullYear(), last.getMonth(), last.getDate() + 1).getTime() - 1
+  }
+  const dated =
+    (test: (d: LocalDate) => boolean): ValueTest =>
+    (v) => {
+      const d = v.kind === 'dateTime' ? readDate(v.value) : null
+      return d !== null && test(d)
+    }
+  switch (op) {
+    case FILTER_OPS.is:
+      return dated((d) => dayMs(d.at) <= day && day <= dayMs(d.end ?? d.at))
+    case FILTER_OPS.isBefore:
+      return dated((d) => ms(d.at) < e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.isAfter:
+      return dated((d) => ms(d.at) > e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.onOrAfter:
+      return dated((d) => ms(d.at) >= e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.onOrBefore:
+      return dated((d) => ms(d.at) <= e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.endsOnOrAfter:
+      return dated((d) => endMs(d) >= e)
+    case FILTER_OPS.endsOnOrBefore:
+      return dated((d) => endMs(d) <= e)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+function prepareCheckbox(op: string, want: readonly string[]): ValueTest | undefined {
+  const checked = checkboxWord(want[0])
+  if (checked === null) return undefined
+  const is: ValueTest = (v) => (v.kind === 'checkbox') === checked
+  switch (op) {
+    case FILTER_OPS.is:
+      return is
+    case FILTER_OPS.isNot:
+      return (v) => !is(v)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+const textKey =
+  (def?: PropertyDefinition) =>
+  (v: PropertyValue): string | null =>
+    shownText(v, def) || null
+
+/** A Custom order leads with its saved options and appends the ones it predates; a value no option holds sorts with the value-less rows. */
+function optionKey(def?: PropertyDefinition, order: readonly string[] = []) {
+  const listed = new Set(order)
+  const ids = [...order, ...(def ? optionIds(def) : []).filter((id) => !listed.has(id))]
+  const rank = new Map(ids.map((id, i) => [id, i]))
+  return (v: PropertyValue): number | null =>
+    v.kind === 'select' ? (rank.get(v.value) ?? null) : null
+}
+
+/** UTC arithmetic, so adding days never crosses a DST boundary. A week belongs to the year of its Thursday; weeks start Monday. */
+function isoWeek(year: number, month: number, day: number): [year: number, week: number] {
+  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, day))
+  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - (d.getUTCDay() || 7))
+  const yearStart = Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1)
+  const week = Math.ceil(((d.getTime() - yearStart) / 86400000 + 1) / 7)
+  return [d.getUTCFullYear(), week]
+}
+
+/** Zero-padded so lexicographic order IS chronological. Buckets by the local day the cell shows, so a date-only value keeps the day the user picked. */
+function dateBucketKey(iso: string, granularity: DateGranularity): string | null {
+  const d = readDate(iso)?.at
+  if (!d) return null
+  const year = d.getFullYear()
+  const month = d.getMonth()
+  const day = d.getDate()
+  switch (granularity) {
+    case 'year':
+      return pad(year, 4)
+    case 'month':
+      return `${pad(year, 4)}-${pad(month + 1, 2)}`
+    case 'day':
+      return localDayKey(d)
+    case 'week': {
+      const [wy, w] = isoWeek(year, month, day)
+      return `${pad(wy, 4)}-W${pad(w, 2)}`
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const PROSE: ValueKindSpec = {
+  ops: TEXT_OPS,
+  filled: showsText,
+  prepare: prepareText,
+  sortKey: textKey,
+  directions: 'text',
+}
+
+export const VALUE_KINDS: Readonly<Record<ValueKind, ValueKindSpec>> = {
+  text: PROSE,
+  link: PROSE,
+  number: {
+    ops: NUMBER_OPS,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: prepareNumber,
+    sortKey: () => (v) => (v.kind === 'number' ? v.value : null),
+    directions: 'value',
+    sortSeeds: true,
+  },
+  dateTime: {
+    ops: DATE_OPS,
+    filled: (v) => v.kind === 'dateTime' && readDate(v.value) !== null,
+    prepare: prepareDate,
+    sortKey: () => (v) =>
+      v.kind === 'dateTime' ? (readDate(v.value)?.at.getTime() ?? null) : null,
+    directions: 'value',
+    groups: true,
+    bucket: (v, granularity) =>
+      v.kind === 'dateTime' ? dateBucketKey(v.value, granularity) : null,
+    sortSeeds: true,
+  },
+  // An unchecked box is stored as no value: Is Empty matches it, and it sorts after the checked ones ascending, as an empty value does, while holding a key so descending puts it first.
+  checkbox: {
+    ops: CHECKBOX_OPS,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: prepareCheckbox,
+    sortKey: () => (v) => (v.kind === 'checkbox' ? 0 : 1),
+    directions: 'value',
+    bucket: (v) => (v.kind === 'checkbox' ? 'true' : null),
+    seed: (op, operand) =>
+      op === FILTER_OPS.is ? checkboxValue(checkboxWord(operand) === true) : null,
+    sortSeeds: true,
+  },
+  // Is and Isn't name whole options; the text ops a hand-written rule may hold search the option's label.
+  select: {
+    ops: OPTION_OPS,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: (op, want, def) =>
+      op === FILTER_OPS.is || op === FILTER_OPS.isNot
+        ? prepareOptions(op, want, def)
+        : prepareText(op, want, def),
+    sortKey: optionKey,
+    directions: 'option',
+    groups: true,
+    bucket: (v) => (v.kind === 'select' ? v.value : null),
+    seed: (op, operand) => (op === FILTER_OPS.is ? { kind: 'select', value: operand } : null),
+    sortSeeds: true,
+  },
+  multiSelect: {
+    ops: SET_OPS,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: prepareOptions,
+    sortKey: textKey,
+    directions: 'text',
+    seed: (op, operand) => (LIST_OPS.has(op) ? { kind: 'multiSelect', value: [operand] } : null),
+  },
+  context: {
+    ops: SET_OPS,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: prepareOptions,
+    directions: 'value',
+    seed: (op, operand) => (LIST_OPS.has(op) ? { kind: 'context', value: [operand] } : null),
+  },
+  file: {
+    ops: EMPTIES,
+    filled: notBlank,
+    prepare: () => undefined,
+    sortKey: textKey,
+    directions: 'text',
+  },
+}
+
+/** A column type's entry in the record; none for a property that's gone. */
+export const viewSpecOf = (type: ColumnType | undefined): ValueKindSpec | undefined => {
+  const spec = specOf(type)
+  return spec && VALUE_KINDS[spec.kind]
+}
+
+export const groupable = (t: PropertyDefinition['type']): boolean => viewSpecOf(t)?.groups === true
```

##### Core/Views/Cards/cardColumns.ts

```/Core/Views/Cards/cardColumns.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { type ColumnType, PROPERTY_TYPES } from '../../Properties/properties'
+import { isBlankValue } from '../../Properties/propertyValue'
+import type { NexusTree } from '../../Nexus/tree'
+import type { ResolvedColumn, ViewRow } from '../viewRow'
+import { isCompact, type SavedView } from '../views'
+import { hiddenListIds } from '../visibilityModel'
+import { contextIdsOf, contextsByIdOf } from '../../Contexts/contextIdentity'
+import { resolveFieldValue } from '../../Properties/fieldValue'
+import { resolveColumn } from '../Pipeline/columns'
+import { columnLabel } from '../../Properties/columnDisplay'
+import type { ValueContext } from '../../Properties/valueContext'
+
+/** A blank value of this type fills in place, unless the type is Filedata, which has no fill path. */
+export const fillsBlank = (type: ColumnType): boolean => PROPERTY_TYPES[type].origin !== 'filedata'
+
+/** Compact's label-less flow can't render an empty value, so it drops blanks, except a type whose blank draws, such as a checkbox's unchecked box, the on-card toggle. */
+export function shownColumnsFor(
+  row: ViewRow,
+  columns: ResolvedColumn[],
+  compactLayout: boolean,
+): ResolvedColumn[] {
+  return columns.filter(
+    (c) =>
+      c.kind !== 'title' &&
+      (!compactLayout ||
+        !isBlankValue(resolveFieldValue(row, c)) ||
+        PROPERTY_TYPES[c.type].blankDraws === true),
+  )
+}
+
+export function addEntriesFor(
+  row: ViewRow,
+  view: SavedView,
+  ctx: ValueContext,
+  columns: ResolvedColumn[],
+  tree: NexusTree | null = null,
+): AddEntry[] {
+  const contextIds = contextIdsOf(tree)
+  const shownIds = new Set(shownColumnsFor(row, columns, isCompact(view)).map((c) => c.id))
+  const ids = [
+    ...new Set([
+      ...hiddenListIds(view, ctx.schema, contextIds),
+      ...ctx.schema.map((d) => d.id),
+      ...columns.filter((c) => c.kind === 'context').map((c) => c.id),
+    ]),
+  ]
+  return ids.flatMap((id) => {
+    const column = shownIds.has(id) ? undefined : resolveColumn(id, ctx.schema, contextIds)
+    if (!column) return []
+    const blank = isBlankValue(resolveFieldValue(row, column))
+    return [
+      {
+        column,
+        name: columnLabel(column, contextsByIdOf(tree)),
+        revealOnly: !fillsBlank(column.type) || !blank,
+      },
+    ]
+  })
+}
+
+export type AddEntry = {
+  column: ResolvedColumn
+  name: string
+  revealOnly: boolean
+}
+
+export function orderAddableEntries(entries: AddEntry[]): AddEntry[] {
+  return [...entries.filter((e) => !e.revealOnly), ...entries.filter((e) => e.revealOnly)]
+}
```

##### Core/Views/Settings/paneRows.tsx

```/Core/Views/Settings/paneRows.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { EyeToggle } from '@pommora/uix/Elements/EyeToggle'
+import type { PickerRowLook } from '@pommora/uix/Menus'
+import { side } from '@pommora/uix/Menus/menu-row.css'
+import type { PickerOption } from '@pommora/uix/Pickers/PickerControl'
+import { type SortDirections, viewSpecOf } from '../valueKinds'
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../viewRow'
+import * as oo from './option-order.css'
+
+export const SUB_LOOK: PickerRowLook = {
+  className: oo.subOrderRow,
+  labelClassName: oo.orderLabel,
+}
+
+// Each family's words for an order's two directions; a column that's gone reads a value's.
+const ORDER_WORDS: Record<SortDirections, readonly [string, string]> = {
+  option: ['Default', 'Reversed'],
+  text: ['A → Z', 'Z → A'],
+  value: ['Ascending', 'Descending'],
+}
+
+/** A column's Order list under the values its pane stores, closed by Custom where the pane offers one and the kind takes it. */
+export function orderOptions<V extends string>(
+  column: ResolvedColumn | undefined,
+  [up, down, custom]: readonly [V, V, V?],
+): PickerOption<V>[] {
+  const kind = viewSpecOf(column?.type)?.directions ?? 'value'
+  const [upWord, downWord] = ORDER_WORDS[kind]
+  return [
+    { value: up, label: upWord },
+    { value: down, label: downWord },
+    ...(kind === 'option' && custom ? [{ value: custom, label: 'Custom' }] : []),
+  ]
+}
+
+export interface HideControls {
+  isHidden?: (key: string) => boolean
+  onToggleHidden?: (key: string) => void
+}
+
+export function rowEye(
+  label: string,
+  hideKey: string,
+  { isHidden, onToggleHidden }: HideControls,
+): React.JSX.Element | null {
+  if (!onToggleHidden) return null
+  return (
+    <span className={side}>
+      <EyeToggle
+        hidden={isHidden?.(hideKey) ?? false}
+        name={label}
+        onToggle={() => onToggleHidden(hideKey)}
+      />
+    </span>
+  )
+}
```

##### UIX/Menus/paneDrop.tsx

```/UIX/Menus/paneDrop.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// Slot indexes are in the persisted arrays' without-dragged coordinates.
+
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
+import { LineGroup, type LineSpec, useLineSlot } from '../Interactions/drag'
+import {
+  buildLanes,
+  laneAt,
+  type LaneSlot,
+  type Lanes,
+  rowSlot,
+} from '../Interactions/reorderModel'
+import { cx } from '../Utilities/cx'
+import { restHighlight } from './frames.css'
+import { menuDropLine } from './MenuRows'
+
+// Two lanes: the members, ordered, and the rest, which a pane may order (`ordersRest`) or not.
+export type PaneDrop =
+  | { kind: 'reorder-members'; id: string; toIndex: number }
+  | { kind: 'reorder-rest'; id: string; toIndex: number }
+  | { kind: 'join'; id: string; toIndex: number }
+  | { kind: 'leave'; id: string }
+
+type PaneSlot = LaneSlot | 'leave'
+type PaneSnap = Lanes & { bottom: number }
+
+function paneSlot(
+  s: PaneSnap,
+  y: number,
+  id: string,
+  ordersRest: boolean,
+  pinned?: string,
+): PaneSlot | null {
+  if (y < 0 || y > s.bottom) return null
+  const lane = laneAt(s, y)
+  if (lane?.key === 'rest' && s.home?.key === 'members') return id === pinned ? null : 'leave'
+  if (lane?.key === 'rest' && !ordersRest) return null
+  return rowSlot(lane, y)
+}
+
+const dropOf = (id: string, slot: PaneSlot, from: string | undefined): PaneDrop =>
+  slot === 'leave'
+    ? { kind: 'leave', id }
+    : {
+        kind:
+          slot.lane === 'rest' ? 'reorder-rest' : from === 'members' ? 'reorder-members' : 'join',
+        id,
+        toIndex: slot.index,
+      }
+
+export function paneSpec({
+  members,
+  ordersRest,
+  pinned,
+  titles,
+  label,
+  glyph,
+  onDrop,
+  watch,
+}: {
+  members: readonly string[]
+  ordersRest: boolean
+  pinned?: string
+  titles: { members: string; rest: string }
+  label: (id: string) => string
+  glyph: (id: string) => ReactNode
+  onDrop: (drop: PaneDrop) => void
+  watch: readonly unknown[]
+}): LineSpec<PaneSlot, PaneSnap> {
+  return {
+    snap: (id, g) => {
+      const upper = new Set(members)
+      const lanes = buildLanes(g.rows, id, (x) => (upper.has(x) ? 'members' : 'rest'), g.groups)
+      return { ...lanes, bottom: g.bottom }
+    },
+    resolve: (id, point, s) => paneSlot(s, point.y, id, ordersRest, pinned),
+    commit: (id, slot, s) => onDrop(dropOf(id, slot, s.home?.key)),
+    line: (slot) => (slot === 'leave' ? null : menuDropLine(slot)),
+    step: (slot) => (slot === 'leave' ? { part: 'into', id: 'rest' } : null),
+    label: (id) => (id === 'members' || id === 'rest' ? titles[id] : label(id)),
+    glyph,
+    watch,
+  }
+}
+
+export function PaneRestGroup({
+  className,
+  children,
+}: {
+  className?: string
+  children: ReactNode
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  const into = useLineSlot<PaneSlot>() === 'leave'
+  return (
+    <LineGroup id="rest" className={cx(className, into && restHighlight)}>
+      {children}
+    </LineGroup>
+  )
+}
```

##### UIX/Utilities/moveItem.ts

```/UIX/Utilities/moveItem.ts diff
@@ -36 +36 @@ export function nextOrder(
   const at = found === -1 ? without.length : found
   return [...without.slice(0, at), draggedId, ...without.slice(at)]
 }
+
+/** A slot in a filtered view of the full order, as an index in the full order: it still holds every hidden id, so a raw visible index would land the drop among hidden rows. */
+export function fullOrderIndex(
+  orderedIds: readonly string[],
+  visibleIds: readonly string[],
+  draggedId: string,
+  visibleToIndex: number,
+): number {
+  const full = orderedIds.filter((id) => id !== draggedId)
+  const visible = visibleIds.filter((id) => id !== draggedId)
+  const successor = visible[visibleToIndex]
+  if (successor !== undefined) return full.indexOf(successor)
+  const last = visible[visible.length - 1]
+  return last !== undefined ? full.indexOf(last) + 1 : full.length
+}
+
+export function resolveRowOrder<T>(
+  items: readonly T[],
+  keyOf: (item: T) => string,
+  listed: readonly string[] = [],
+): T[] {
+  const byKey = new Map(items.map((i) => [keyOf(i), i]))
+  const first = listed.flatMap((k) => {
+    const hit = byKey.get(k)
+    if (hit) byKey.delete(k)
+    return hit ? [hit] : []
+  })
+  return [...first, ...byKey.values()]
+}
```

```/Core/Actions/cellMenu.test.ts diff
+  })
```

```/Core/Files/pageFile.test.ts diff
+    )
+    expect(swept(held).withPair('Other', undefined)).toBe(`---\n${ID}Status: Done\n---\nbody\n`)

+      `---\n${ID}A: &x foo\nB: *x\n---\nbody\n`,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('a new pair lands above the key it stood above, last when that key is gone, and a held one stays in place', () => {
+    const held = `---\n${ID}Status: Done\nOther: 1\n---\nbody\n`
+    expect(swept(held).withPair('Total', 'Total: 5\n', 'Other')).toBe(
+      `---\n${ID}Status: Done\nTotal: 5\nOther: 1\n---\nbody\n`,
+    )
+    expect(swept(held).withPair('Total', 'Total: 5\n', 'Gone')).toBe(
+      `---\n${ID}Status: Done\nOther: 1\nTotal: 5\n---\nbody\n`,
+    )
+    expect(swept(held).withPair('Status', 'Status: Doing\n', 'ID')).toBe(
+      `---\n${ID}Status: Doing\nOther: 1\n---\nbody\n`,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('a pair the key already holds lands nothing', () => {
+    expect(swept(SPELLED).withPair('Tags', 'Tags: [a, "b"] # c\n')).toBeNull()
+    expect(swept(SPELLED).withPair('Due', undefined)).toBeNull()

+  })
+
+  it('a string that isn’t one key’s pair lands nothing', () => {
```

```/Core/Nexus/entities.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { countPhrase, unsweptLine } from './entities'
+import { bundleRow as row } from '../Testing/fixtures'
+
+describe('countPhrase', () => {
+  it('names the kind when every row shares one', () => {
+    expect(countPhrase([row({}), row({})])).toBe('2 Pages')
+    expect(countPhrase([row({ kind: 'set' }), row({ kind: 'set' })])).toBe('2 Sets')
+    expect(countPhrase([row({ kind: 'context' }), row({ kind: 'context' })])).toBe('2 Contexts')
+  })
+
+  it('generalizes when they do not', () => {
+    expect(countPhrase([row({}), row({ kind: 'space' })])).toBe('2 Items')
+  })
+
+  it('stays singular for one', () => {
+    expect(countPhrase([row({})])).toBe('1 Page')
+    expect(countPhrase([row({ kind: 'space' })])).toBe('1 Space')
+  })
+
+  it('reports none honestly', () => {
+    expect(countPhrase([])).toBe('0 Items')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('unsweptLine', () => {
+  it('names a sweep’s misses in Items, singular for one', () => {
+    expect(unsweptLine(1)).toBe('Couldn’t update 1 Item.')
+    expect(unsweptLine(2, 'links in ')).toBe('Couldn’t update links in 2 Items.')
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Nexus/finishOwed.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// The crash-window suite: each window is the exact on-disk state a killed op leaves with its note, and the finish must land the same disk an uninterrupted op lands.
+
+import { describe, it, expect, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { chmod, mkdir, readdir, readFile, rename, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { tempRoot, noModeBits, putJson, seedSpaceSidecar, readJsonAt } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import { seedPropertyBundle } from '../Testing/fixtures'
+import { STASHED_AT } from '../Testing/definitions'
+import { closeSession, openSession } from './session'
+import { installStores, NO_STORES } from '../Platform/stores'
+import { memoryStores } from '../Testing/memoryStores'
+import { dropLiveTree, refreshTree } from './liveTree'
+import { indexWrittenPage, seedContentIndex } from '../Index/indexSeed'
+import { readRecord } from '../Bundles/record'
+import { listBundles } from '../Bundles/bundle'
+import { mutateRegistry, readRegistry } from '../Properties/propertiesRegistry'
+import { renameFrontmatterKey } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import { contextsDir, contextsRegistryFile, nexusConfig, sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { NEXUS_CONFIG_FILES, OWED_REL } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { readJsonObject } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import * as registryModule from '../Properties/registryProperty'
+import { createProperty, renameProperty } from '../Properties/registryProperty'
+import { mutateRegistryFile } from '../Contexts/contextsRegistry'
+import { splitFrontmatter } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import { deleteProperty } from '../Properties/deleteProperty'
+import { deleteOption, renameOption } from '../Properties/optionOps'
+import { unsweptLine } from './entities'
+import { ensureContextsRegistry } from '../Contexts/contextsRegistry'
+import { seedConfigSurfaces, viewOn } from '../Testing/configSurfaces'
+import type { TrashDeps } from '../Trash/discard'
+import { finishOwed } from './finishOwed'
+import { handleMutate } from './mutate'
+import { readNotes, type Notes } from './owed'
+import { setPanelContextOrder } from './reorder'
+import { ok } from '../Contract/result'
+
+vi.mock('../Properties/registryProperty', async (importOriginal) => {
+  const mod = await importOriginal<typeof import('../Properties/registryProperty')>()
+  return { ...mod, removeFromRegistry: vi.fn(mod.removeFromRegistry) }
+})
+
+const DEPS: TrashDeps = { trashMode: 'nexus', trashToSystem: (p) => rm(p, { force: true }) }
+
+const roots: string[] = []
+afterEach(async () => {
+  dropLiveTree()
+  installStores(NO_STORES)
+  closeSession()
+  for (const r of roots.splice(0)) {
+    await chmod(join(r, 'Col'), 0o755).catch(() => {})
+    await rm(r, { recursive: true, force: true })
+  }
+})
+
+const PAGE_IDS = ['01ARZ3NDEKPSV4RRFFQ69G5FAA', '01ARZ3NDEKPSV4RRFFQ69G5FAB']
+const TASK_PAGE = '01ARZ3NDEKPSV4RRFFQ69G5FAC'
+
+async function seededRoot(): Promise<string> {
+  const root = tempRoot('pom-finish-')
+  roots.push(root)
+  await mkdir(join(root, '.nexus'), { recursive: true })
+  await writeFile(join(root, '.nexus', 'nexus.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'nx', createdAt: 'x' }))
+  await writeFile(join(root, '.nexus', 'settings.json'), '{}')
+  await mkdir(join(root, 'Col'), { recursive: true })
+  await createProperty(root, {
+    id: 'prop_s',
+    label: 'Stage',
+    type: 'select',
+    select_options: [
+      { id: 'opt_Draft', key: 'Draft', label: 'Draft' },
+      { id: 'opt_Done', key: 'Done', label: 'Done' },
+    ],
+  })
+  await writeFile(
+    join(root, 'Col', '_pagecollection.json'),
+    JSON.stringify({ id: 'c1', properties: ['prop_s'] }),
+  )
+  await writeFile(join(root, 'Col', 'A.md'), `---\nID: ${PAGE_IDS[0]}\nStage: Draft\n---\nbody\n`)
+  await writeFile(join(root, 'Col', 'B.md'), `---\nID: ${PAGE_IDS[1]}\nStage: Draft\n---\nbody\n`)
+  return root
+}
+
+const page = (root: string, name: string): Promise<string> =>
+  readFile(join(root, 'Col', `${name}.md`), 'utf8')
+
+const seedSpace = (root: string, raw: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> =>
+  seedSpaceSidecar(root, 'Projects', 'Pommora', raw)
+
+const seedNotes = (root: string, notes: Notes): Promise<void> =>
+  putJson(join(root, OWED_REL), notes)
+
+const RENAMED: Notes = { prop_s: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Stage'] } }
+const DELETED: Notes = { prop_s: { kind: 'property', strip: ['Stage'] } }
+const optionNote = (part: Record<string, unknown>): Notes =>
+  ({ prop_s: { kind: 'property', options: part } }) as Notes
+
+const relistOptions = (root: string, options: unknown[]) =>
+  mutateRegistry(root, (registry) => ({
+    next: {
+      ...registry,
+      defs: {
+        ...registry.defs,
+        prop_s: { ...registry.defs.prop_s, select_options: options },
+      } as typeof registry.defs,
+    },
+    result: ok(null),
+  }))
+
+const relabel = (root: string, label: string, key = label, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
+  mutateRegistry(root, (registry) => ({
+    next: {
+      ...registry,
+      defs: { ...registry.defs, prop_s: { ...registry.defs.prop_s, label, key, ...over } },
+    },
+    result: ok(null),
+  }))
+
+async function renameCrashState(root: string): Promise<void> {
+  await seedNotes(root, RENAMED)
+  await relabel(root, 'Phase')
+  const half = renameFrontmatterKey(await page(root, 'A'), 'Stage', 'Phase', 'prefer-new')
+  if (half === null) throw new Error('fixture: half-fold produced nothing')
+  await writeFile(join(root, 'Col', 'A.md'), half)
+}
+
+describe('the rename arm', () => {
```

##### Core/Nexus/move.test.ts

```/Core/Nexus/move.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { chmod, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { noModeBits, putJson, readJsonAt, tempRoot } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import { nexusConfig, sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { NEXUS_CONFIG_FILES } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { createFolderEntity } from './folderEntity'
+import { newId } from './ids'
+import { closeSession, openSession } from './session'
+import { dropLiveTree, refreshTree } from './liveTree'
+import { handleMutate } from './mutate'
+import { finishOwed } from './finishOwed'
+import { readNotes } from './owed'
+import type { TrashDeps } from '../Trash/discard'
+
+const deps: TrashDeps = { trashMode: 'nexus', trashToSystem: async () => {} }
+
+let root: string
+
+const entity = async (parent: string, kind: 'collection' | 'set', name: string) => {
+  const id = newId()
+  const made = await createFolderEntity(parent, kind, name, id)
+  if (!made.ok) throw new Error(`${name} failed`)
+  return { id, path: made.value.path }
+}
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  root = tempRoot('pom-move-')
+  await putJson(nexusConfig(root, NEXUS_CONFIG_FILES.identity), { id: 'nx', createdAt: '2026' })
+  await openSession(root)
+})
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  dropLiveTree()
+  closeSession()
+  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+describe('moveSetOp', () => {
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('a Set move that misses a view settings file owes it', async () => {
+    const notes = await entity(root, 'collection', 'Notes')
+    await entity(root, 'collection', 'Other')
+    const deep = await entity(notes.path, 'set', 'Deep')
+    const keep = await entity(notes.path, 'set', 'Keep')
+    const file = sidecarPath(keep.path, 'set')
+    const rules = [{ property_id: '_location', op: 'is', values: [deep.id] }]
+    await putJson(file, {
+      ...(await readJsonAt(file)),
+      views: [{ id: 'v', name: 'V', type: 'table', filter: { match: 'all', rules } }],
+    })
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    await chmod(file, 0o000)
+    try {
+      const r = await handleMutate(
+        root,
+        { op: 'moveSet', path: 'Notes/Deep', newParentPath: 'Other', order: [deep.id] },
+        deps,
+      )
+      expect(r.ok && r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+      expect(await readNotes(root)).toMatchObject({
+        [deep.id]: { kind: 'container', at: 'Notes/Deep', within: 'Notes' },
+      })
+    } finally {
+      await chmod(file, 0o644)
+    }
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(JSON.stringify(await readJsonAt(file))).not.toContain(deep.id)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+})
```
