```/Core/Nexus/owed.test.ts diff
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { chmod, mkdir, readdir, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { fail, ok } from '../Contract/result'
+import { manifestAdmits } from '../Paths/exclusion'
+import { ASSETS_DIR_REL, OWED_REL } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { dirname, join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { noModeBits, putJson, tempRoot } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import {
+  editNote,
+  type Notes,
+  owedDelete,
+  owedName,
+  owedRename,
+  owedSwept,
+  readNotes,
+  relinkNote,
+  restoreNote,
+  runNoted,
+  withOption,
+} from './owed'
+
+let root: string
+let file: string
+beforeEach(() => {
+  root = tempRoot('pom-owed-')
+  file = join(root, OWED_REL)
+})
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await chmod(file, 0o644).catch(() => {})
+  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+const clean = { skipped: 0, hosts: [] }
+
+describe('the compose rules', () => {
+  it('a rename appends the old name and drops the new one', () => {
+    expect(owedRename({}, 'a', 'b')).toEqual({ rename: ['a'] })
+    expect(owedRename({ rename: ['a'] }, 'b', 'c')).toEqual({ rename: ['a', 'b'] })
+  })
+
+  it('renaming back composes to the name the second rename left', () => {
+    const back = owedRename(owedRename({}, 'a', 'b'), 'b', 'a')
+    expect(back).toEqual({ rename: ['b'] })
+    expect(owedSwept(back, ['b'])).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a delete moves every owed old name and the current one into strip', () => {
+    expect(owedDelete({ rename: ['a'] }, 'b')).toEqual({ strip: ['a', 'b'] })
+  })
+
+  it('a clean sweep keeps a Clear’s mark', () => {
+    expect(owedSwept({ strip: ['a', 'High'], kept: true }, ['a'])).toEqual({
+      strip: ['High'],
+      kept: true,
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('an option part emptied by an edit leaves the entry', () => {
+    expect(
+      withOption({ kind: 'property', options: { o1: { rename: ['a'] } } }, 'o1', (o) =>
+        owedSwept(o, ['a']),
+      ),
+    ).toEqual({ kind: 'property' })
+  })
+
+  it('a relink composes onto the move before it', () => {
+    expect(
+      relinkNote(relinkNote(undefined, new Map([['a', 'B']]), 'B'), new Map([['b', 'C']])),
+    ).toEqual({ kind: 'relink', label: 'B', names: { a: 'C', b: 'C' } })
+  })
+
+  it('a restore’s repair follows a later move without taking its keys', () => {
+    expect(
+      relinkNote(
+        { kind: 'relink', label: 'A', names: { a: 'B' }, files: ['X/A.md'] },
+        new Map([['b', 'C']]),
+      ),
+    ).toEqual({ kind: 'relink', label: 'A', names: { a: 'C' }, files: ['X/A.md'] })
+  })
+})
+
+describe('the notes file', () => {
+  const seed = { P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } }
+
+  it('an edit that leaves nothing owed removes the entry', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, seed)
+    await editNote(root, 'P', (e) => e && { ...e, ...owedSwept(e, ['a']) })
+    await expect(stat(file)).rejects.toThrow()
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('an edit answers the entry as it stood', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, seed)
+    expect(await editNote(root, 'P', (e) => e && { ...e, ...owedSwept(e, ['a']) })).toEqual(
+      ok({ kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] }),
+    )
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('an unreadable notes file refuses the edit', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, seed)
+    const bytes = await readFile(file, 'utf8')
+    await chmod(file, 0o000)
+    expect((await editNote(root, 'P', () => undefined)).ok).toBe(false)
+    await chmod(file, 0o644)
+    expect(await readFile(file, 'utf8')).toBe(bytes)
+  })
+
+  it('a corrupt notes file is set aside and rebuilt', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, seed)
+    await writeFile(file, '{')
+    expect((await editNote(root, 'P', () => ({ kind: 'property', rename: ['b'] }))).ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['b'] } })
+    expect((await readdir(dirname(file))).some((f) => f.includes('.owed.json.bad-'))).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('a notes file damaged before the session read it says once that its work was lost', async () => {
+    await mkdir(dirname(file), { recursive: true })
+    await writeFile(file, '{')
+    const change = {
+      note: () => ({ kind: 'property' as const, rename: ['a'] }),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => clean,
+      settle: () => undefined,
+    }
+    const first = await runNoted(root, 'P', change)
+    expect(first.ok && first.value.cascade.warning).toMatch(
+      /Unfinished work from an earlier session couldn’t be read and was lost\.$/,
+    )
+    const second = await runNoted(root, 'P', change)
+    expect(second.ok && second.value.cascade.warning).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('the notes file is neither watched nor synced', () => {
+    expect(manifestAdmits({ excluded: [], assetDir: ASSETS_DIR_REL })(OWED_REL)).toBe(false)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('owedName', () => {
+  it('a name another item owes is refused within its owner, folding case', () => {
+    const notes: Notes = {
+      P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Priority'] },
+      Q: { kind: 'property', strip: ['Stage'] },
+      S: { kind: 'space', contextId: 'C1', rename: ['Gym'] },
+    }
+    const property = { kind: 'property' } as const
+    expect(owedName(notes, { owner: property, name: 'stage', except: 'P' })).toBe(true)
+    expect(owedName(notes, { owner: property, name: 'Priority', except: 'P' })).toBe(false)
+    expect(owedName(notes, { owner: { kind: 'space', contextId: 'C1' }, name: 'Gym' })).toBe(true)
+    expect(owedName(notes, { owner: { kind: 'space', contextId: 'C2' }, name: 'Gym' })).toBe(false)
+    const options: Notes = { P: { kind: 'property', options: { o1: { rename: ['High'] } } } }
+    const option = { kind: 'option', propertyId: 'P' } as const
+    expect(owedName(options, { owner: option, name: 'High', except: 'o2' })).toBe(true)
+    expect(owedName(options, { owner: option, name: 'high', except: 'o2' })).toBe(false)
+    expect(owedName(options, { owner: option, name: 'High', except: 'o1' })).toBe(false)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('restoreNote', () => {
+  it('a restore converts only an entry that owes a strip, moving it into rename', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'], strip: ['b'] } })
+    expect((await restoreNote(root, 'P')).ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a', 'b'] } })
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('an item that owes no strip writes nothing', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { Q: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+    const bytes = await readFile(file, 'utf8')
+    await chmod(file, 0o000)
+    expect((await restoreNote(root, 'P')).ok).toBe(true)
+    await chmod(file, 0o644)
+    expect(await readFile(file, 'utf8')).toBe(bytes)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('runNoted', () => {
+  const renaming = (from: string, to: string) => ({
+    note: (e: Notes[string] | undefined) => ({
+      kind: 'property' as const,
+      ...owedRename(e ?? {}, from, to),
+    }),
+    settle: (e: Notes[string]) => ({ ...e, ...owedSwept(e, [from]) }),
+  })
+
+  it('a landing on a name another item owes refuses with nothing written', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { Q: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Priority'] } })
+    const list = vi.fn(async () => ok(null))
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      ...renaming('Status', 'priority'),
+      lands: [{ owner: { kind: 'property' }, name: 'priority', except: 'P' }],
+      list,
+      sweep: async () => clean,
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok || ran.error.code).toBe('owed')
+    expect(list).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ Q: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Priority'] } })
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('a refused note refuses before the list step runs', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { Q: { kind: 'property', rename: ['x'] } })
+    await chmod(file, 0o000)
+    const list = vi.fn(async () => ok(null))
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', { ...renaming('a', 'b'), list, sweep: async () => clean })
+    expect(ran.ok).toBe(false)
+    expect(list).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('a refused list step puts the entry back as it stood', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+    const sweep = vi.fn(async () => clean)
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      ...renaming('b', 'c'),
+      list: async () => fail('operation-failed', 'no'),
+      sweep,
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok).toBe(false)
+    expect(sweep).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+  })
+
+  it('a sweep that missed nothing settles the entry', async () => {
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      ...renaming('a', 'b'),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => clean,
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok && ran.value.cascade.owed).toBeFalsy()
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a sweep that missed a file keeps the entry and marks the report owed', async () => {
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      ...renaming('a', 'b'),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => ({ skipped: 1, hosts: [] }),
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok && ran.value.cascade).toMatchObject({
+      owed: true,
+      warning: 'Couldn’t update 1 Item.',
+    })
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+  })
+
+  it('an entry under an owed rename stays whole after a clean sweep, and its report is owed', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { C: { kind: 'context', rename: ['x'] } })
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'S', {
+      note: (e) => ({ kind: 'space', contextId: 'C', ...owedRename(e ?? {}, 'Gym', 'Pool') }),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => clean,
+      settle: (e) => ({ ...e, ...owedSwept(e, ['Gym']) }),
+      under: 'C',
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok && ran.value.cascade).toMatchObject({
+      owed: true,
+      warning: 'An earlier change hasn’t reached every file yet.',
+    })
+    expect((await readNotes(root)).S).toEqual({ kind: 'space', contextId: 'C', rename: ['Gym'] })
+  })
+
+  it('a clean sweep that leaves an older name owed marks the report owed', async () => {
+    await putJson(file, { P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      ...renaming('b', 'c'),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => clean,
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok && ran.value.cascade.owed).toBe(true)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', rename: ['a'] } })
+  })
+
+  it('a sweep that is the finish’s own arm keeps what it wrote back', async () => {
+    const ran = await runNoted(root, 'P', {
+      note: () => ({ kind: 'property', strip: ['x', 'y'] }),
+      list: async () => ok(null),
+      sweep: async () => {
+        await editNote(root, 'P', () => ({ kind: 'property', strip: ['x'] }))
+        return clean
+      },
+    })
+    expect(ran.ok && ran.value.cascade.owed).toBe(true)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({ P: { kind: 'property', strip: ['x'] } })
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Nexus/settle.test.ts diff
+describe('a re-spell on the notes', () => {
+  const deps: TrashDeps = { trashMode: 'nexus', trashToSystem: async () => {} }
+  const failing: string[] = []
+  const linker = (): string => abs('Notes', 'L.md')
+  const bundleOf = (r: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof settledMutate>>): string => {
+    if (!r.ok || !r.value.bundled) throw new Error('the delete did not trash')
+    return r.value.bundled.bundlePath
+  }
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    const refusing =
+      (real: (file: string, data: string) => Promise<void>) =>
+      (file: string, data: string): Promise<void> =>
+        failing.some((f) => file.endsWith(f))
+          ? Promise.reject(new Error('refused'))
+          : real(file, data)
+    const { atomicWriteFile: wrote, rewritePreservingTimes: rewrote } = atomicWrite
+    vi.spyOn(atomicWrite, 'atomicWriteFile').mockImplementation(refusing(wrote))
+    vi.spyOn(atomicWrite, 'rewritePreservingTimes').mockImplementation(refusing(rewrote))
+  })
+  afterEach(() => {
+    failing.length = 0
+  })
+
+  const renamed = async (from: string, to: string) =>
+    settledMutate(root, { op: 'rename', path: `Notes/${from}.md`, kind: 'page', newName: to }, deps)
+
+  const seedLinked = async (): Promise<void> => {
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'B.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_B}\n---\n\nbeta\n`)
+    await writeFile(linker(), `---\nID: ${ULID_C}\n---\n\nSee [[B]].\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    failing.push('Notes/L.md')
+  }
+
+  it('a page move that misses a linker owes the re-spell', async () => {
+    await seedLinked()
+    const r = await renamed('B', 'C')
+    expect(r.ok && r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+    expect((await readNotes(root))[ULID_B]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'relink' })
+    failing.length = 0
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await readFile(linker(), 'utf8')).toContain('See [[C]].')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a page move names a linker it can’t safely rewrite once and owes nothing', async () => {
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'B.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_B}\n---\n\nbeta\n`)
+    await writeFile(linker(), `---\nID: ${ULID_C}\nPhase:\n\t- Draft\n---\n\nSee [[B]].\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    const r = await renamed('B', 'C')
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+    expect(r.value.cascade?.warning).toBe('Couldn’t safely rewrite “L”.')
+    expect(r.value.cascade).not.toHaveProperty('owed')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a second move carries what the first missed', async () => {
+    await seedLinked()
+    await renamed('B', 'C')
+    await renamed('C', 'D')
+    failing.length = 0
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await readFile(linker(), 'utf8')).toContain('See [[D]].')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a restore’s re-spell owes what it missed', async () => {
+    await mkdir(abs('Notes', 'Deep'))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', '_pageset.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'set_deep' }))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', 'X.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_D}\n---\n\nx\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    const bundle = bundleOf(
+      await settledMutate(root, { op: 'delete', path: 'Notes/Deep/X.md', kind: 'page' }, deps),
+    )
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'X.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_B}\n---\n\nx\n`)
+    await writeFile(linker(), `---\nID: ${ULID_C}\n---\n\nSee [[X]].\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    failing.push('Notes/L.md')
+    const r = await settledMutate(root, { op: 'restore', bundlePath: bundle }, deps)
+    expect(r.ok && r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+    failing.length = 0
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await readFile(linker(), 'utf8')).not.toContain('See [[X]].')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  // A Set whose page links its sibling by path, trashed and restored beside a new Set under its name.
+  const repairMissed = async (): Promise<{ landed: string; p: string }> => {
+    await mkdir(abs('Notes', 'Deep'))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', '_pageset.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'set_deep' }))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', 'P.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_B}\n---\n\nSee [[Deep/Q]].\n`)
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', 'Q.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_C}\n---\n\nq\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    const bundle = bundleOf(
+      await settledMutate(root, { op: 'delete', path: 'Notes/Deep', kind: 'set' }, deps),
+    )
+    await mkdir(abs('Notes', 'Deep'))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', '_pageset.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'set_new' }))
+    await writeFile(abs('Notes', 'Deep', 'Q.md'), `---\nID: ${ULID_D}\n---\n\nq\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    failing.push('/P.md')
+    const r = await settledMutate(root, { op: 'restore', bundlePath: bundle }, deps)
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+    expect(r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+    const [landed = '', entry] =
+      Object.entries(await readNotes(root)).find(([, e]) => e.kind === 'relink' && e.files) ?? []
+    expect(entry).toMatchObject({ kind: 'relink', files: [`${landed}/P.md`, `${landed}/Q.md`] })
+    return { landed, p: abs(landed, 'P.md') }
+  }
+
+  it('a restore’s repair of its own files owes what it missed', async () => {

+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a restore’s owed repair follows its files through a rename', async () => {
+    const { landed } = await repairMissed()
+    const moved = await settledMutate(
+      root,
+      { op: 'rename', path: landed, kind: 'set', newName: 'Moved' },
+      deps,
+    )
+    if (!moved.ok) throw new Error(moved.error.message)
+    failing.length = 0
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await readFile(abs('Notes', 'Moved', 'P.md'), 'utf8')).toContain('See [[Moved/Q|Q]].')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a landed file gone before the finish leaves the repair’s entry', async () => {
+    const { p } = await repairMissed()
+    await rm(p)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  // A Context whose Space links its sibling, trashed and restored as “Areas (2)” beside a new Context under its title, its Space’s re-key missed.
+  const rekeyMissed = async (): Promise<void> => {

+    await putJson(abs('.nexus', 'contexts', 'contexts.json'), {
+      contexts: [{ id: 'ctx_areas', title: 'Areas' }],
+    })
+    await putJson(work, { id: 'sp_w', '<Areas>': ['Home'] })
+    await putJson(abs('.nexus', 'contexts', 'Areas', 'Home', '_space.json'), { id: 'sp_h' })
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    const bundle = bundleOf(
+      await settledMutate(
+        root,
+        { op: 'delete', path: '.nexus/contexts/Areas', kind: 'context' },
+        deps,
+      ),
+    )
+    await putJson(abs('.nexus', 'contexts', 'contexts.json'), {
+      contexts: [{ id: 'ctx_new', title: 'Areas' }],
+    })
+    await mkdir(abs('.nexus', 'contexts', 'Areas'))
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    failing.push('Areas (2)/Work/_space.json')
+    const r = await settledMutate(root, { op: 'restore', bundlePath: bundle }, deps)
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+    expect(r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+    expect(Object.values(await readNotes(root))).toContainEqual(
+      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'relink', rekey: ['Areas', 'Areas (2)'] }),
+    )
+  }
+
+  it('a Context restored under a new title owes the re-key a Space sidecar missed', async () => {
```

##### Core/Properties/columnDisplay.test.ts

```/Core/Properties/columnDisplay.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
+import { columnIcon, columnLabel } from './columnDisplay'
+import { contextsByIdOf } from '../Contexts/contextIdentity'
+import { FILEDATA, type PropertyDefinition } from './properties'
+import { contextColumn, propertyColumn, resolveColumn } from '../Views/Pipeline/columns'
+
+const schema: PropertyDefinition[] = [
+  { id: 'prop_status', label: 'Status', key: 'Status', type: 'status' },
+  { id: 'prop_due', label: 'Due Date', key: 'due_date', type: 'dateTime' },
+]
+
+const NO_CONTEXTS = new Map()
+const filedata = (id: string) => resolveColumn(id, schema, [])!
+
+describe('columnLabel', () => {
+  it('names each Filedata column', () => {
+    expect(columnLabel(filedata(FILEDATA.title.id), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('Title')
+    expect(columnLabel(filedata(FILEDATA.createdAt.id), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('Creation Time')
+    expect(columnLabel(filedata(FILEDATA.modifiedAt.id), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('Last Modified')
+  })
+
+  it('resolves a Context column through the registry, and an unregistered one falls to its id', () => {
+    const tree = {
+      contexts: [{ def: { id: 'ctx_areas', title: 'Areas', singular: 'Area' }, spaces: [] }],
+      config: { personalization: {} },
+    } as unknown as import('../Nexus/tree').NexusTree
+    const contexts = contextsByIdOf(tree)
+    expect(columnLabel(contextColumn('ctx_areas'), contexts)).toBe('Areas')
+    expect(columnLabel(contextColumn('ctx_topics'), contexts)).toBe('ctx_topics')
+  })
+
+  // The header bug this guards: a caller that can't resolve Contexts renders their raw ids.
+  it('falls back to the raw id when handed no contexts at all', () => {
+    expect(columnLabel(contextColumn('ctx_areas'), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('ctx_areas')
+  })
+
+  it('resolves a user property through its label', () => {
+    expect(columnLabel(propertyColumn(schema[0]), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('Status')
+    expect(columnLabel(propertyColumn(schema[1]), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('Due Date')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('columnIcon', () => {
+  it('draws a Context column with its own icon, a property with its icon, and Filedata with its type’s', () => {
+    const tree = {
+      contexts: [{ def: { id: 'ctx_areas', title: 'Areas', icon: 'hash' }, spaces: [] }],
+      config: { personalization: {} },
+    } as unknown as import('../Nexus/tree').NexusTree
+    expect(columnIcon(contextColumn('ctx_areas'), contextsByIdOf(tree))).toBe('hash')
+    expect(columnIcon(propertyColumn({ ...schema[0], icon: 'flag' }), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('flag')
+    expect(columnIcon(filedata(FILEDATA.title.id), NO_CONTEXTS)).toBe('text-align-justify')
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Properties/optionOps.test.ts diff
+// A page in a Set whose folder refuses writes, so a sweep misses it; answers the page and the Set.
+async function lockedPage(
+  col: string,
+  id: string,
+  word: string,
+): Promise<{ page: string; set: string }> {
+  const set = await createFolderEntity(col, 'set', 'Locked', newId())
+  if (!set.ok) throw new Error('set failed')
+  const p = await createTestPage(set.value.path, 'Held', { body: 'b' })
+  if (!p.ok) throw new Error('page failed')
+  const key = (await readRegistry(root)).defs[id].key
+  await rewriteRootAt(
+    p.value.path,
+    rewriteRoot((raw) => landValue(raw, key, [word])),
+  )
+  await chmod(set.value.path, 0o555)
+  return { page: p.value.path, set: set.value.path }
+}

+    expect(unregisteredMembers(multiSelectOf('red', 'blue'), ['green', 'Red', 'PURPLE'])).toEqual([
+      'green',
+      'PURPLE',
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('unregisteredMembers subtracts every word whose fold an option’s label or key holds', () => {
+    expect(unregisteredMembers(keyedMulti, ['IN-PROGRESS', 'done', 'DONE', 'new'])).toEqual(['new'])
+  })
+
+  it('unregisteredMembers answers only the words the Value Format could have written', () => {
+    const under = (value_format: KeyFormat, ...values: string[]): PropertyDefinition => ({
+      ...multiSelectOf(...values),
+      value_format,
+    })
+    expect(
+      unregisteredMembers(under('lowercase', 'red', 'blue'), ['green', 'PURPLE', 'Red']),
+    ).toEqual(['green'])
+    expect(unregisteredMembers(under('kebab-case'), ['due_date', 'in-progress'])).toEqual([
+      'in-progress',
+    ])
+    expect(unregisteredMembers(under('PascalCase'), ['AB', 'J.Crew', 'Red'])).toEqual(['Red'])
+    expect(unregisteredMembers(under('lowercase'), ['Green', 'green'])).toEqual(['green'])
+    expect(unregisteredMembers(under('lowercase'), [' green '])).toEqual([' green '])
+  })
+})
+
+const defOf = (key: string) => ({ key, type: key === 'M' ? 'multiSelect' : 'select' }) as const
+
+const strip = (raw: Json, key: string, value: string): Json | null =>
+  valueEditRewrite(defOf(key), new Map([[value, null]]))(raw, 'p.md')
+
+const replace = (raw: Json, key: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string): Json | null =>
+  valueEditRewrite(defOf(key), new Map([[oldValue, newValue]]))(raw, 'p.md')
+
+describe('valueEditRewrite — strip', () => {
+  it('select: deletes the key iff the value matches', () => {
+    const hit = strip({ id: 'p1', S: 'Urgent' }, 'S', 'Urgent')
+    expect(hit).toEqual({ id: 'p1' })
+    expect(strip({ id: 'p1', S: 'Other' }, 'S', 'Urgent')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('multiSelect: filters the array, deletes the key only when empty', () => {
+    expect(strip({ M: ['a', 'x', 'b'] }, 'M', 'x')).toEqual({ M: ['a', 'b'] })
+    expect(strip({ M: ['x'] }, 'M', 'x')).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('multiSelect: preserves foreign (non-string) array elements it never targeted', () => {
+    expect(strip({ M: ['x', 5, 'keep'] }, 'M', 'x')).toEqual({ M: [5, 'keep'] })
+  })
+})
+
+describe('the option list is the one shape', () => {
+  it('a list-shaped Select or Status value is renamed and stripped in place', () => {
+    expect(replace({ Status: ['Active'] }, 'Status', 'Active', 'Live')).toEqual({
+      Status: ['Live'],
+    })
+    expect(strip({ Status: ['Active'] }, 'Status', 'Active')).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a YAML number names the option it spells, and the rewrite spells it back as a string', () => {
+    expect(replace({ Year: [2024] }, 'Year', '2024', 'FY2024')).toEqual({ Year: ['FY2024'] })
+    expect(strip({ Year: 2024 }, 'Year', '2024')).toEqual({})
+    expect(strip({ Year: 2025 }, 'Year', '2024')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('a scalar written from outside rewrites to a list of one', () => {
+    expect(replace({ Status: 'Active' }, 'Status', 'Active', 'Live')).toEqual({ Status: ['Live'] })
+  })
+})
+
+describe('valueEditRewrite — replace (rename cascade)', () => {
+  it('select: swaps the matching value', () => {
+    expect(replace({ S: 'Urgent' }, 'S', 'Urgent', 'Critical')).toEqual({ S: ['Critical'] })
+  })
+
+  it('multiSelect: swaps one element in place', () => {
+    expect(replace({ M: ['a', 'x'] }, 'M', 'x', 'y')).toEqual({ M: ['a', 'y'] })
+  })
+
+  it('multiSelect: preserves foreign elements when swapping', () => {
+    expect(replace({ M: ['x', 5] }, 'M', 'x', 'y')).toEqual({ M: ['y', 5] })
+  })
+
+  it('multiSelect: renaming into a value already present merges, never duplicates', () => {
+    expect(replace({ M: ['x', 'y'] }, 'M', 'x', 'y')).toEqual({ M: ['y'] })
+  })
+
+  it('returns null when the holder does not hold the value', () => {
+    expect(replace({ S: 'Other' }, 'S', 'Urgent', 'Critical')).toBeNull()
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Properties/propertyStash.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { mkdir, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { readJsonAt, tempRoot } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import { STASHED_AT } from '../Testing/definitions'
+import { createFolderEntity } from '../Nexus/folderEntity'
+import { newId } from '../Nexus/ids'
+import { dropLiveTree, patchLiveTree, seedLiveTree } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import { readNexus } from '../Nexus/readNexus'
+import { sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { patchStashBlock, stashedBlock, sweepStashes } from './propertyStash'
+
+describe('the stash block', () => {
+  it('reads a stamped block, and none without a stamp', () => {
+    const sidecar = {
+      id: 'c',
+      property_stash: {
+        p: { removed_at: STASHED_AT, values: { a: 1 } },
+        q: { values: { b: 2 } },
+        r: { removed_at: STASHED_AT, values: 'x' },
+      },
+    }
+    expect(stashedBlock(sidecar, 'p')).toEqual({ removed_at: STASHED_AT, values: { a: 1 } })
+    expect(stashedBlock(sidecar, 'q')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stashedBlock(sidecar, 'r')).toBeNull()
+    expect(stashedBlock(sidecar, 'absent')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it("writes the block it's given, and a block with no values, or none, leaves no key", () => {
+    const block = { removed_at: '2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z', values: { a: 2 } }
+    expect(patchStashBlock({ id: 'c' }, 'p', block)).toEqual({
+      id: 'c',
+      property_stash: { p: block },
+    })
+    const held = { id: 'c', property_stash: { p: { removed_at: STASHED_AT, values: { a: 1 } } } }
+    expect(patchStashBlock(held, 'p', { removed_at: STASHED_AT, values: {} })).toEqual({ id: 'c' })
+    expect(patchStashBlock(held, 'p')).toEqual({ id: 'c' })
+  })
+
+  it('an `above` leaves with its value', () => {
+    const written = patchStashBlock({ id: 'c' }, 'p', {
+      removed_at: STASHED_AT,
+      values: { a: 1 },
+      above: { a: 'Zed', b: 'Note' },
+    })
+    expect(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(written)).property_stash.p).toEqual({
+      removed_at: STASHED_AT,
+      values: { a: 1 },
+      above: { a: 'Zed' },
+    })
+    const placeless = patchStashBlock({ id: 'c' }, 'p', {
+      removed_at: STASHED_AT,
+      values: { a: 1 },
+      above: { b: 'Note' },
+    })
+    expect(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(placeless)).property_stash.p).not.toHaveProperty('above')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('sweepStashes', () => {
+  let root: string
+  let notes: string
+  let tasks: string
+  const stamped = (removed_at: string) => ({ removed_at, values: { a: 1 } })
+  const seed = async (folder: string, stash: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> => {
+    const file = sidecarPath(folder, 'collection')
+    await writeFile(file, JSON.stringify({ ...(await readJsonAt(file)), property_stash: stash }))
+  }
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-22T09:00:00.000Z'))
+    root = tempRoot('pom-stash-sweep-')
+    await mkdir(join(root, '.nexus'), { recursive: true })
+    await writeFile(
+      join(root, '.nexus', 'settings.json'),
+      JSON.stringify({ personalization: { historyDays: 7 } }),
+    )
+    const n = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Notes', newId())
+    const t = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Tasks', newId())
+    if (!n.ok || !t.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+    notes = n.value.path
+    tasks = t.value.path
+    await seed(notes, {
+      p: stamped('2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z'),
+      q: stamped('2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z'),
+    })
+    await seed(tasks, { p: stamped('2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z') })
+    seedLiveTree(await readNexus(root))
+  })
+  afterEach(async () => {
+    vi.useRealTimers()
+    dropLiveTree()
+    await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+  })
+
+  it('drops a block removed before the History Timeframe and keeps one inside it', async () => {
+    await sweepStashes(root)
+    expect((await readJsonAt(sidecarPath(notes, 'collection'))).property_stash).toEqual({
+      q: stamped('2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z'),
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('opens no sidecar the tree doesn’t list as stashing', async () => {
+    const file = sidecarPath(tasks, 'collection')
+    const before = [await readFile(file, 'utf8'), (await stat(file)).mtimeMs]
+    patchLiveTree((tree) => ({
+      ...tree,
+      collections: tree.collections.map((c) =>
+        c.path === 'Tasks' ? { ...c, stashed: undefined } : c,
+      ),
+    }))
+    await sweepStashes(root)
+    expect([await readFile(file, 'utf8'), (await stat(file)).mtimeMs]).toEqual(before)
+  })
+
+  it('reads nothing with no tree held', async () => {
+    dropLiveTree()
+    await sweepStashes(root)
+    expect((await readJsonAt(sidecarPath(tasks, 'collection'))).property_stash).toEqual({
+      p: stamped('2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z'),
+    })
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Properties/putBack.test.ts diff
+afterEach(async () => {

+interface Target {

+  held: (key: string) => Promise<string | undefined>
+}

+const pageFile = () => join(root, pagePath)
+const sidecarFile = () => join(root, spacePath, '_space.json')
+const sidecar = () => readJsonAt(sidecarFile())
+
+// A page's key as its frontmatter lines spell it; a Space's as its JSON value.
+const page: Target = {
+  path: () => pagePath,

+  held: async (key) => {
+    const lines = (await readFile(pageFile(), 'utf8')).split('\n')
+    const at = lines.findIndex((l) => l.startsWith(`${key}:`))
+    if (at < 0) return undefined
+    const end = lines.findIndex((l, i) => i > at && !l.startsWith('  '))
+    return lines.slice(at, end).join('\n')
+  },
+}
```

```/Core/Properties/typeDisplay.test.ts diff
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { chipOf, propertyTypeLabel } from './typeDisplay'

+  it("draws a Status option as a pill, a Select or Multi-Select option as a tag, and a Context option as a Select's", () => {

+  })
+})
```

##### Core/Properties/unassignProperty.test.ts

```/Core/Properties/unassignProperty.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { rewriteRoot, rewriteRootAt } from '../Nexus/governedRoot'
+import { landValue } from '../Files/rootValues'
+import { ID_KEY } from '../Nexus/identityMark'
+import { chmod, mkdir, rename, rm, readFile, stat, utimes, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { dirname, join, relative } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { noModeBits, tempRoot, readJsonAt } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import { ok } from '../Contract/result'
+import { editJsonStrict, readJsonObject } from '../Files/atomicWrite'
+import { seedConfigSurfaces, viewOn } from '../Testing/configSurfaces'
+import { sidecarPath } from '../Paths/paths'
+import { settleNow } from '../Nexus/settle'
+import type { ValueChange } from '../Nexus/tree'
+import type { Pushes } from '../Contract/bridge'
+import { unassignProperty } from './unassignProperty'
+import { unsweptLine } from '../Nexus/entities'
+import { assignProperty } from './assignment'
+import { assignedIds } from '../Nexus/containerFields'
+import { createProperty } from './registryProperty'
+import { createFolderEntity } from '../Nexus/folderEntity'
+import { newContentId, newId } from '../Nexus/ids'
+import { createTestPage } from '../Testing/createTestPage'
+import { patchSidecar } from '../Files/sidecar'
+import { mutateRegistry, readRegistry } from './propertiesRegistry'
+import { splitFrontmatter } from '../Files/pageFile'
+import { closeSession, openSession } from '../Nexus/session'
+import { heldTreeOf, refreshTree } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import type { PropertyDefinition } from './properties'
+import type { StashBlock } from './propertyStash'
+import { readNotes } from '../Nexus/owed'
+import { finishOwed } from '../Nexus/finishOwed'
+import { OWED_REL } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { putJson } from '../Testing/hostFs'
+import { settledMutate } from '../Testing/settledMutate'
+import { listBundles } from '../Bundles/bundle'
+import { deleteProperty } from './deleteProperty'
+import type { TrashDeps } from '../Trash/discard'
+
+vi.mock('../Files/atomicWrite', async (importOriginal) => {
+  const mod = await importOriginal<typeof import('../Files/atomicWrite')>()
+  return { ...mod, editJsonStrict: vi.fn(mod.editJsonStrict) }
+})
+
+let root: string
+let folder: string
+let liveDef: PropertyDefinition
+let propId: string
+let pageA: string
+let pageB: string
+
+const stageDef = {
+  label: 'Stage',
+  key: 'Stage',
+  type: 'status',
+  status_groups: [
+    {
+      id: 'upcoming',
+      label: 'To-do',
+      color: 'gray',
+      options: [{ key: 'active', label: 'active' }],
+    },
+    {
+      id: 'done',
+      label: 'Done',
+      color: 'green',
+      options: [{ key: 'done', label: 'done' }],
+    },
+  ],
+} as PropertyDefinition
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  root = tempRoot('pom-remove-')
+  const c = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Notes', newId())
+  const p = await createProperty(root, stageDef)
+  if (!c.ok || !p.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+  folder = c.value.path
+  propId = p.value.id
+  liveDef = { ...stageDef, id: propId } as PropertyDefinition
+  await assignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+  const a = await createTestPage(folder, 'A', { body: 'b' })
+  const b = await createTestPage(folder, 'B', { body: 'b' })
+  if (!a.ok || !b.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+  pageA = a.value.path
+  pageB = b.value.path
+  await rewriteRootAt(
+    pageA,
+    rewriteRoot((raw) => landValue(raw, liveDef.key, ['active'])),
+  )
+  await rewriteRootAt(
+    pageB,
+    rewriteRoot((raw) => landValue(raw, liveDef.key, ['done'])),
+  )
+})
+afterEach(async () => {
+  closeSession()
+  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+const deps: TrashDeps = { trashMode: 'nexus', trashToSystem: async () => {} }
+const collectionId = async (): Promise<string> => (await sidecar())?.id as string
+const pageValue = async (path: string): Promise<unknown> =>
+  splitFrontmatter(await readFile(path, 'utf8'))[liveDef.key]
+const sidecar = (): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> =>
+  readJsonObject(sidecarPath(folder, 'collection'))
+const stashBlock = async (): Promise<StashBlock | undefined> =>
+  ((await sidecar())?.property_stash as Record<string, StashBlock> | undefined)?.[propId]
+
+const idOf = async (path: string): Promise<string> =>
+  splitFrontmatter(await readFile(path, 'utf8'))[ID_KEY] as string
+const tasksCollection = async (): Promise<void> => {
+  const made = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Tasks', newId())
+  if (!made.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+  await refreshTree(root)
+}
+
+describe('unassignProperty — strip + stash', () => {
+  it('strips the value from every member page, stashes {pageId: raw}, and unassigns — one transaction', async () => {
+    await openSession(root)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    const r = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    const rels: string[] = []
+    const push = (channel: keyof Pushes, value: unknown): void => {
+      if (channel === 'values:changed') rels.push(...(value as ValueChange[]).map((c) => c.rel))
+    }
+    await settleNow({ push, watch: async () => {} }, root)
+    expect(rels).toEqual(['Notes'])
+    expect(r.ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await pageValue(pageA)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(await pageValue(pageB)).toBeUndefined()
+    const sc = await sidecar()
+    expect((sc?.properties as string[] | undefined) ?? []).not.toContain(propId)
+    expect('modified_at' in (sc ?? {})).toBe(false)
+    const block = await stashBlock()
+    expect(Object.keys(block ?? {})).toEqual(['removed_at', 'values'])
+    const vals = Object.values(block?.values ?? {})
+    expect(vals).toHaveLength(2)
+    expect(vals).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([['active'], ['done']]))
+  })
+
+  it('a holder with no id keeps the Collection owed', async () => {
+    const raw = await readFile(pageA, 'utf8')
+    const bare = raw.replace(new RegExp(`^${ID_KEY}:.*\\n`, 'm'), '')
+    await writeFile(pageA, bare)
+    await openSession(root)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    expect(heldTreeOf(root)?.unreadable).toContainEqual({
+      path: relative(root, pageA),
+      kind: 'page',
+      reason: 'missing',
+    })
+
+    const r = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+    expect(r.value.cascade).toMatchObject({ warning: unsweptLine(1), owed: true })
+    expect(await readFile(pageA, 'utf8')).toBe(bare)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({
+      [propId]: { kind: 'property', collections: [await collectionId()] },
+    })
+    const id = newContentId('page')
+    await writeFile(pageA, bare.replace('---\n', `---\n${ID_KEY}: ${id}\n`))
+    await refreshTree(root)
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await pageValue(pageA)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect((await stashBlock())?.values[id]).toEqual(['active'])
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+    closeSession()
+  })
+
+  it('a page and its copy sharing one id both keep their values through Remove, so re-assigning has nothing to fill', async () => {
+    const copy = join(folder, 'A copy.md')
+    const raw = await readFile(pageA, 'utf8')
+    await writeFile(copy, raw.replace('- active', '- done'))
+    await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    expect([await pageValue(pageA), await pageValue(copy)]).toEqual([['active'], ['done']])
+    await assignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    expect([await pageValue(pageA), await pageValue(copy)]).toEqual([['active'], ['done']])
+    expect(await stashBlock()).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('a Remove strips its own Collection’s archived holder and stashes its value, and leaves another Collection’s', async () => {
+    const other = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Other', newId())
+    if (!other.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+    const archivedUnder = async (collection: string): Promise<{ file: string; id: string }> => {
+      const cid = (await readJsonObject(sidecarPath(collection, 'collection')))?.id as string
+      const file = join(
+        root,
+        '.nexus/archive',
+        cid,
+        'Notes/2026-10-20T12-00-00-000Z__Old.md.archived/Old.md',
+      )
+      const id = newContentId('page')
+      await mkdir(dirname(file), { recursive: true })
+      await writeFile(file, `---\n${ID_KEY}: ${id}\nStage:\n  - done\n---\nb\n`)
+      return { file, id }
+    }
+    const own = await archivedUnder(folder)
+    const theirs = await archivedUnder(other.value.path)
+    expect((await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)).ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await pageValue(own.file)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect((await stashBlock())?.values[own.id]).toEqual(['done'])
+    expect(await pageValue(theirs.file)).toEqual(['done'])
+  })
+
+  it('is a no-op when the property is not assigned — never overwrites a stash with emptiness', async () => {
+    await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    const before = await stashBlock()
+    const again = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    expect(again.ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await stashBlock()).toEqual(before)
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)(
+    'a holder it can’t write is answered as a skip its cascade warns of',
+    async () => {
+      const set = await createFolderEntity(folder, 'set', 'Locked', newId())
+      if (!set.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+      const held = await createTestPage(set.value.path, 'C', { body: 'b' })
+      if (!held.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+      await rewriteRootAt(
+        held.value.path,
+        rewriteRoot((raw) => landValue(raw, liveDef.key, ['done'])),
+      )
+      await chmod(set.value.path, 0o555)
+      try {
+        expect(await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)).toEqual(
+          ok({ cascade: { pages: [], hosts: [], warning: unsweptLine(1), owed: true } }),

+  )
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('a holder it can’t read is answered as a skip, not left out', async () => {
+    const held = await createTestPage(folder, 'C', { body: 'b' })
+    if (!held.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+    await rewriteRootAt(
+      held.value.path,
+      rewriteRoot((raw) => landValue(raw, liveDef.key, ['done'])),
+    )
+    await chmod(held.value.path, 0o000)

+      expect(await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)).toEqual(
+        ok({ cascade: { pages: [], hosts: [], warning: unsweptLine(1), owed: true } }),
+      )
+    } finally {

+    }
+  })
+})

+describe('a Remove on the notes', () => {
+  const shut = async <T>(file: string, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
+    await chmod(file, 0o000)
+    try {
+      return await run()
+    } finally {
+      await chmod(file, 0o644)
+    }
+  }
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)(
+    'a Remove that missed a page notes the Collection and offers Try Again',
+    async () => {
+      const r = await shut(pageB, () => unassignProperty(root, folder, propId))
+      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+      expect(r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+      expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({
+        [propId]: { kind: 'property', collections: [await collectionId()] },
+      })
+      await finishOwed(root, deps)
+      expect(await pageValue(pageB)).toBeUndefined()
+      expect(Object.values((await stashBlock())?.values ?? {})).toContainEqual(['done'])
+      expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+    },
+  )
+
+  it('a page the sweep refuses is named once and let go', async () => {
+    const odd = join(folder, 'Odd.md')
+    const text = `---\n${ID_KEY}: ${newContentId('page')}\nStage:\n\t- done\n---\nb\n`
+    await writeFile(odd, text)
+    const r = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message)
+    expect(r.value.cascade?.warning).toBe('Couldn’t safely rewrite “Odd”.')
+    expect(r.value.cascade).not.toHaveProperty('owed')
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+    expect(await readFile(odd, 'utf8')).toBe(text)
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('re-adding the property cancels what its Remove owed there', async () => {
+    await shut(pageB, () => unassignProperty(root, folder, propId))
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).not.toEqual({})
+    await assignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    await finishOwed(root, deps)
+    expect(await pageValue(pageB)).toEqual(['done'])
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('a Remove under an owed rename keeps its Collection owed', async () => {
+    await putJson(join(root, OWED_REL), { [propId]: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Priority'] } })
+    const r = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)
+    expect(r.ok && r.value.cascade?.owed).toBe(true)
+    expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({
+      [propId]: { kind: 'property', rename: ['Priority'], collections: [await collectionId()] },
+    })
+  })
+
+  it.skipIf(noModeBits)('a delete subsumes an owed Remove', async () => {

+

+        await readFile(pageA, 'utf8'),

+      await chmod(notes, 0o000)
+      const r = await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId).finally(() => chmod(notes, 0o644))
+      expect(r.ok).toBe(false)

+describe('unassignProperty reaches saved views', () => {
+  const cleared = {

+    hidden_properties: [],

+    collapsed_groups: [],
+  }
+
+  it('clears its own views in the one sidecar write, then its Set and the tile sourcing it, and leaves another source and the Matrix', async () => {
+    const held = viewOn(propId, 'done')
+    const surfaces = await seedConfigSurfaces(root, folder, held)
+    const otherId = newId()
+    const other = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Other', otherId)
+    if (!other.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+    type TileDoc = {
+      tiles: { id: string; type: string; views: { source_id: string; config: unknown }[] }[]
+    }
+    const doc = await readJsonAt<TileDoc>(surfaces.tiles)
+    doc.tiles.push({ id: 'u', type: 'view', views: [{ source_id: otherId, config: held }] })

+    vi.mocked(editJsonStrict).mockClear()
+
+    expect(await unassignProperty(root, folder, propId)).toEqual(

+    const { calls, results } = vi.mocked(editJsonStrict).mock
+    const own = calls.flatMap(([path], i) =>
```

```/Core/Properties/validation.test.ts diff
+      expect(admissible({ id, type: 'text' })).toBe(false)
+    expect(admissible({ id: 'prop_01H', type: 'text' })).toBe(true)
+    expect(admissible({ id: 'stage', type: 'text' })).toBe(true)
+  })
+})
```

##### Core/Properties/Cells/ValueSeat.test.tsx

```/Core/Properties/Cells/ValueSeat.test.tsx diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+// @vitest-environment jsdom
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { act } from 'react'
+import { EditorView } from '@codemirror/view'
+import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
+import type { Root } from 'react-dom/client'
+import { ok } from '../../Contract/result'
+import { stubDialer } from '../../vitest.setup'
+import { mountEachTest, settle } from '../../Testing/viewHarness'
+import { makeTree } from '../../Testing/testTree'
+import { useSession } from '../../Session/store'
+import { FILEDATA, type PropertyDefinition } from '../properties'
+import { dateDefaults } from '../columnStyles'
+import type { ResolvedColumn, ViewRow } from '../../Views/viewRow'
+import { propertyColumn } from '../../Views/Pipeline/columns'
+import { MenuSeat, type SeatHost, useValueSeat, ValueSeat, type ValueSeatApi } from './ValueSeat'
+
+let root: Root
+mountEachTest((_, r) => {
+  root = r
+})
+
+const def = (id: string, type: PropertyDefinition['type'], extra = {}): PropertyDefinition => ({
+  id,
+  label: id,
+  key: id,
+  type,
+  ...extra,
+})
+const SELECT = def('prop_s', 'select', {
+  select_options: [{ id: 'opt_alpha', key: 'alpha', label: 'Alpha' }],
+})
+const DATE = def('prop_d', 'dateTime')
+const TEXT = def('prop_t', 'text')
+const CHECK = def('prop_c', 'checkbox')
+const NUMBER = def('prop_n', 'number', { number_family: 'percent' })
+const columnOf = propertyColumn
+const STYLE = dateDefaults('full')
+const row: ViewRow = {
+  id: 'page_1',
+  title: 'One',
+  path: 'Col/One.md',
+  frontmatter: { prop_t: 'words' } as never,
+  createdAt: null,
+  modifiedAt: null,
+}
+
+let commit: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn<SeatHost['commit']>>
+let menu: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
+let seat: ValueSeatApi
+const answer = (action: string | null): void => {
+  menu = vi.fn(async () => ok(action))
+  ;(window as unknown as { nexus: unknown }).nexus = stubDialer({ menu })
+}
+beforeEach(() => {
+  commit = vi.fn()
+  answer(null)
+  useSession.setState({ tree: makeTree() })
+})
+
+function Surface({
+  column,
+  over,
+  pane,
+}: {
+  column: ResolvedColumn
+  over?: Partial<SeatHost>
+  pane?: React.ReactNode
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  seat = useValueSeat({
+    rowOf: () => row,
+    commit,
+    anchor: (el) => el,
+    holder: () => row,
+    columnOf: (id) => (id === column.id ? column : undefined),
+    style: () => STYLE,
+    ...over,
+  })
+  return (
+    <>
+      {/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents lint/a11y/noStaticElementInteractions: a test seat */}
+      <span
+        data-seat=""
+        onClick={(e) => seat.click(row, column, e)}
+        onContextMenu={(e) => void seat.menu(row, column, e)}
+      >
+        {seat.editor(row, column) ?? 'value'}
+        {pane}
+      </span>
+      <ValueSeat seat={seat} />
+    </>
+  )
+}
+const mount = (column: ResolvedColumn, over?: Partial<SeatHost>, pane?: React.ReactNode): void =>
+  act(() => root.render(<Surface column={column} over={over} pane={pane} />))
+const el = (): HTMLElement => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-seat]')!
+const portalText = (): string =>
+  [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-picker-portal]')].map((e) => e.textContent).join('')
+const rightClick = async (): Promise<void> => {
+  await act(async () => {
+    el().dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true }))
+  })
+}
+const menuActions = (): (string | undefined)[] =>
+  (menu.mock.calls[0][0].items as { action?: string }[]).map((i) => i.action)
+
+describe('a value seat’s click', () => {
+  it.each([
+    ['an option kind opens its picker', SELECT, 'picker'],
+    ['a Date opens the calendar in the picker', DATE, 'picker'],
+    ['a Text value opens its editor in place', TEXT, 'editor'],
+  ])('%s', (_, d, mode) => {
+    mount(columnOf(d))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(seat.open?.mode).toBe(mode)
+    expect(commit).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('a Select’s picker lists its options', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(portalText()).toContain('Alpha')
+  })
+
+  it('an option created while the picker is open joins its list', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    const beta = { id: 'opt_beta', key: 'beta', label: 'Beta' }
+    mount(columnOf({ ...SELECT, select_options: [...(SELECT.select_options ?? []), beta] }))
+    expect(portalText()).toContain('Beta')
+  })
+
+  it('a Checkbox commits checked, opening nothing', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(CHECK))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(commit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(row, columnOf(CHECK), { kind: 'checkbox', value: true })
+    expect(seat.open).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('a Number drawn as a bar opens its popover', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(NUMBER), { style: () => ({ ...STYLE, look: 'bar' }) })
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(seat.open?.mode).toBe('popover')
+  })
+
+  it('a stamp opens nothing', () => {
+    mount({ id: FILEDATA.createdAt.id, kind: 'stamp', type: 'createdTime' })
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(seat.open).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('a centered host carries the click’s x to the picker, and a plain one carries none', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { centered: true })
+    act(() => el().dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, clientX: 40 })))
+    expect(seat.open?.x).toBe(40)
+    act(() => seat.close())
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT))
+    act(() => el().dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, clientX: 40 })))
+    expect(seat.open?.x).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('a value seat’s right-click', () => {
+  it('pops the column’s cell menu and runs its Edit', async () => {
+    answer('cell:edit')
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT))
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(menuActions()).toContain('cell:edit')
+    expect(seat.open?.mode).toBe('editor')
+  })
+
+  it('runs its Clear as a commit, or as the host’s own clear', async () => {
+    answer('cell:clear')
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT))
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(commit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(row, columnOf(TEXT), null)
+    const clear = vi.fn()
+    commit.mockClear()
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT), { clear })
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(clear).toHaveBeenCalledWith(row, columnOf(TEXT))
+    expect(commit).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('offers Remove only to a host that hides, and runs it there', async () => {
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT))
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(menuActions()).not.toContain('cell:hide')
+    const run = vi.fn()
+    answer('cell:hide')
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT), { hide: { from: 'view', run } })
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledWith(row, columnOf(TEXT))
+  })
+
+  it('offers a host with no column look the bare menu, never Style', async () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { style: () => null, hide: { from: 'row', run: vi.fn() } })
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(menuActions()).toEqual(['cell:hide'])
+  })
+
+  it('runs a Style answer through the host’s style write', async () => {
+    const setStyle = vi.fn()
+    answer('style:look:compact')
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { setStyle })
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(setStyle).toHaveBeenCalledWith(columnOf(SELECT), 'look', 'compact')
+  })
+
+  it('holds the host’s ghost for as long as the menu is open', async () => {
+    let held = 0
+    const hold = vi.fn(async <T,>(show: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
+      held += 1
+      const answered = await show()
+      held -= 1
+      return answered
+    })
+    menu = vi.fn(async () => {
+      expect(held).toBe(1)
+      return ok(null)
+    })
+    ;(window as unknown as { nexus: unknown }).nexus = stubDialer({ menu })
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT), { hold: hold as SeatHost['hold'] })
+    await rightClick()
+    expect(hold).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(held).toBe(0)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('a value seat’s panes', () => {
+  it('closes once the element it opened from leaves the page', () => {
+    const away = document.createElement('div')
+    document.body.appendChild(away)
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { anchor: () => away })
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(seat.open?.mode).toBe('picker')
+    away.remove()
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { anchor: () => away })
+    expect(seat.open).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('closes once its column no longer resolves', () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    expect(seat.open?.mode).toBe('picker')
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), { columnOf: () => undefined })
+    expect(seat.open).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('keeps the picker on its last value through its exit', async () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT))
+    act(() => el().click())
+    act(() => seat.close())
+    expect(portalText()).toContain('Alpha')
+    await settle(450)
+    expect(portalText()).not.toContain('Alpha')
+  })
+
+  it('mounts a fresh popover for every open of the same value', async () => {
+    mount(columnOf(TEXT))
+    act(() => seat.pane(row, columnOf(TEXT), el()))
+    const first = document.querySelector('[data-picker-portal] .cm-editor')
+    act(() => seat.close())
+    await settle(450)
+    act(() => seat.pane(row, columnOf(TEXT), el()))
+    const second = document.querySelector('[data-picker-portal] .cm-editor')
+    expect(first).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(second).not.toBe(first)
+  })
+
+  it('leaves a click or right-click from a pane portalled out of it alone', async () => {
+    mount(columnOf(SELECT), undefined, createPortal(<b data-pane="" />, document.body))
+    const pane = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-pane]')!
+    act(() => pane.click())
+    expect(seat.open).toBeNull()
+    await act(async () => {
+      pane.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true }))
+    })
+    expect(menu).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('the menu seat', () => {
+  const LINK = def('prop_l', 'link')
+  let trigger: HTMLElement
+  const request = (column: ResolvedColumn, commit = vi.fn()) => ({
+    rowOf: () => row,
+    column,
+    trigger,
+    commit,
+  })
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    trigger = document.createElement('div')
+    document.body.appendChild(trigger)
+    useSession.setState({ tree: makeTree({ registry: [LINK, DATE, TEXT, SELECT] }) })
+  })
+  afterEach(() => {
+    trigger.remove()
+    useSession.setState({ pendingPick: null })
+  })
+
+  it('an option created while its picker is open joins its list', () => {
+    act(() => root.render(<MenuSeat />))
+    act(() => useSession.getState().requestPick(request(columnOf(SELECT))))
+    const beta = { id: 'opt_beta', key: 'beta', label: 'Beta' }
+    const grown = { ...SELECT, select_options: [...(SELECT.select_options ?? []), beta] }
+    act(() => useSession.setState({ tree: makeTree({ registry: [LINK, DATE, TEXT, grown] }) }))
+    expect(portalText()).toContain('Beta')
+  })
+
+  it('a Link value picked from the page menu commits a page link through the index, under the page’s own title', () => {
+    const picked = vi.fn()
+    act(() => root.render(<MenuSeat />))
+    act(() => useSession.getState().requestPick(request(columnOf(LINK), picked)))
+    const dom = document.querySelector(
+      '[data-picker-portal]:not([data-dismissal-shield]) .value-field .cm-editor',
+    ) as HTMLElement
+    const view = EditorView.findFromDOM(dom)!
+    act(() => {
+      view.dispatch({
+        changes: { from: 0, insert: '[[alpha]]' },
+        selection: { anchor: 9 },
+        userEvent: 'input.type',
+      })
+    })
+    expect(view.dom.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('false')
+    act(() => {
+      view.contentDOM.dispatchEvent(
+        new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }),
+      )
+    })
+    expect(picked).toHaveBeenCalledWith(columnOf(LINK), { kind: 'link', value: '[[Alpha]]' })
+  })
+
+  it('a Date opens the calendar and holds the request while it stands', () => {
+    act(() => root.render(<MenuSeat />))
+    act(() => useSession.getState().requestPick(request(columnOf(DATE))))
+    expect(useSession.getState().pendingPick).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(document.querySelector('[data-picker-portal]')).not.toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('a dismissed pane lets the request go', () => {
+    act(() => root.render(<MenuSeat />))
+    act(() => useSession.getState().requestPick(request(columnOf(TEXT))))
+    act(() => {
+      document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }))
+    })
+    expect(useSession.getState().pendingPick).toBeNull()
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Properties/Pickers/pickModel.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import type { OptionPickKind, PropertyDefinition } from '../properties'
+import type { PropertyValue } from '../propertyValue'
+import { propertyColumn } from '../../Views/Pipeline/columns'
+import { type PickCommit, pickGroups, pickOver } from './pickModel'
+
+const optionDef = (type: 'select' | 'multiSelect'): PropertyDefinition => ({
+  id: 'prop_p',
+  label: 'P',
+  key: 'P',
+  type,
+  select_options: [
+    { id: 'opt_a', key: 'a', label: 'a' },
+    { id: 'opt_b', key: 'b', label: 'b' },
+    { id: 'opt_c', key: 'c', label: 'c' },
+  ],
+})
+const select = (value: string): PropertyValue => ({ kind: 'select', value })
+const multi = (...value: string[]): PropertyValue => ({ kind: 'multiSelect', value })
+const spaces = (...value: string[]): PropertyValue => ({ kind: 'context', value })
+
+/** The commits one pick of `value` makes over `currents`, and whether it closed the picker. */
+function pickOf(kind: OptionPickKind, currents: (PropertyValue | null)[], value: string) {
+  const onCommit = vi.fn<(commits: PickCommit[]) => void>()
+  const onClose = vi.fn()
+  pickOver(kind, currents, onCommit, onClose).pick(value)
+  return { commits: onCommit.mock.calls[0][0], closed: onClose.mock.calls.length > 0 }
+}
+
+describe('pickGroups', () => {
+  it('offers an option under its id and names it by its label, never by its key', () => {
+    const named = propertyColumn({
+      ...optionDef('select'),
+      select_options: [{ id: 'opt_new', key: 'new', label: 'New' }],
+    })
+    const offered = pickGroups(named).flatMap((g) => g.options)
+    expect(offered.map((o) => [o.value, o.label])).toEqual([['opt_new', 'New']])
+  })
+})
+
+describe('pickOver', () => {
+  it('marks as picked only what every row holds', () => {
+    const rows = [multi('opt_a', 'opt_b'), multi('opt_a'), multi('opt_a', 'opt_c')]
+    expect(pickOver('multiSelect', rows, vi.fn(), vi.fn()).selected).toEqual(['opt_a'])
+    expect(
+      pickOver('select', [select('opt_a'), select('opt_b')], vi.fn(), vi.fn()).selected,
+    ).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  it('a list value joins every row lacking it, keeps what each holds, and leaves the picker open', () => {
+    const { commits, closed } = pickOf(
+      'multiSelect',
+      [multi('opt_a'), multi('opt_b', 'opt_c'), null],
+      'opt_b',
+    )
+    expect(commits).toEqual([
+      { index: 0, next: multi('opt_a', 'opt_b') },
+      { index: 2, next: multi('opt_b') },
+    ])
+    expect(closed).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('a list value every row holds leaves each of them', () => {
+    expect(pickOf('context', [spaces('a', 'b'), spaces('b', 'c')], 'b').commits).toEqual([
+      { index: 0, next: spaces('a') },
+      { index: 1, next: spaces('c') },
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('a Select lands on every row not already holding it, and closes the picker', () => {
+    const { commits, closed } = pickOf('select', [select('opt_a'), select('opt_b'), null], 'opt_a')
+    expect(commits).toEqual([
+      { index: 1, next: select('opt_a') },
+      { index: 2, next: select('opt_a') },
+    ])
+    expect(closed).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('a Select every row holds clears from all of them', () => {
+    expect(pickOf('select', [select('opt_a'), select('opt_a')], 'opt_a').commits).toEqual([
+      { index: 0, next: null },
+      { index: 1, next: null },
+    ])
+  })
+})
```

##### Core/Properties/Schema/typeRows.test.ts

```/Core/Properties/Schema/typeRows.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import type { MenuRow } from '@pommora/uix/Menus'
+import { dateDefaults } from '../columnStyles'
+import type { PropertyDefinition, PropertyType } from '../properties'
+import { rowsFor } from './typeRows'
+
+type RowContext = Parameters<typeof rowsFor>[1]
+
+const ctx = (over: Partial<RowContext> = {}): RowContext => ({
+  style: dateDefaults('full'),
+  setStyle: vi.fn(),
+  configure: vi.fn(),
+  assetRoot: 'Assets',
+  ...over,
+})
+const def = (type: PropertyType, fields: Partial<PropertyDefinition> = {}): PropertyDefinition =>
+  ({ id: 'prop_x', label: 'X', key: 'X', type, ...fields }) as PropertyDefinition
+
+type Item = Extract<MenuRow, { kind: 'item' }>
+const items = (rows: MenuRow[]): Item[] => rows.filter((r): r is Item => r.kind === 'item')
+/** The rows a viewer sees: a row revealed as `false` is collapsed. */
+const shown = (rows: MenuRow[]): string[] =>
+  items(rows)
+    .filter((r) => r.reveal !== false)
+    .map((r) => String(r.label))
+const trailing = (rows: MenuRow[], label: string) => {
+  const t = items(rows).find((r) => r.label === label)?.trailing
+  if (!t) throw new Error(`no row "${label}"`)
+  return t
+}
+const pick = (rows: MenuRow[], label: string, value: string): void => {
+  const t = trailing(rows, label)
+  if (t.kind !== 'picker') throw new Error(`"${label}" is no picker`)
+  t.onPick(value)
+}
+const typed = (rows: MenuRow[], label: string, text: string): void => {
+  const t = trailing(rows, label)
+  if (t.kind !== 'picker' || !t.typeable) throw new Error(`"${label}" takes no typing`)
+  t.typeable.onCommit(text)
+}
+
+describe('rowsFor', () => {
+  it('a Number shows Currency only for currency, hides Separators and Fraction for Percent, and offers Style only where a bar has a ceiling', () => {
+    expect(shown(rowsFor(def('number'), ctx()))).toEqual([
+      'Format',
+      'Separators',
+      'Decimals',
+      'Fraction',
+    ])
+    expect(shown(rowsFor(def('number', { number_family: 'currency' }), ctx()))).toEqual([
+      'Format',
+      'Currency',
+      'Separators',
+      'Decimals',
+      'Fraction',
+    ])
+    expect(shown(rowsFor(def('number', { number_family: 'percent' }), ctx()))).toEqual([
+      'Format',
+      'Decimals',
+      'Style',
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('the fraction Value row shows only while Fraction is on, takes only a positive number, refuses text that only partly parses, and a blank clears it', () => {
+    const c = ctx()
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('number', { number_fraction: true, number_denominator: 10 }), c)
+    expect(shown(rows)).toEqual(['Format', 'Separators', 'Decimals', 'Fraction', 'Value', 'Style'])
+    typed(rows, 'Value', '12abc')
+    expect(c.configure).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    typed(rows, 'Value', '0')
+    typed(rows, 'Value', '-2')
+    expect(c.configure).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    typed(rows, 'Value', '4')
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ number_denominator: 4 })
+    typed(rows, 'Value', '')
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ number_denominator: undefined })
+  })
+
+  it("a Number's format writes the definition and its Style the view", () => {
+    const c = ctx()
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('number', { number_family: 'percent' }), c)
+    pick(rows, 'Format', 'currency')
+    pick(rows, 'Style', 'bar')
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ number_family: 'currency' })
+    expect(c.setStyle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ look: 'bar' })
+  })
+
+  it('a Date shows its Day row only for the worded formats, and each pick writes the view', () => {
+    expect(shown(rowsFor(def('dateTime'), ctx({ style: dateDefaults('monthDayYear') })))).toEqual([
+      'Date',
+      'Time',
+    ])
+    const c = ctx({ style: { ...dateDefaults('full'), weekday: 'none' } })
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('dateTime'), c)
+    expect(rows[0]).toEqual({ kind: 'heading', label: 'Format' })
+    expect(shown(rows)).toEqual(['Date', 'Day', 'Time'])
+    pick(rows, 'Date', 'short')
+    pick(rows, 'Day', 'long')
+    expect(c.setStyle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ date_format: 'short' })
+    expect(c.setStyle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ weekday: 'long' })
+  })
+
+  it("a Link's underline, color, and format write the definition", () => {
+    const c = ctx()
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('link'), c)
+    const underline = trailing(rows, 'Underline')
+    if (underline.kind !== 'switch') throw new Error('Underline is no switch')
+    underline.onChange(true)
+    pick(rows, 'Format', 'link-full')
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ link_underline: true })
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ link_display: 'link-full' })
+    expect(c.setStyle).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it("a Checkbox's swatch paints the Nexus's checkbox color when unset; its Color writes the definition and its Style the view", () => {
+    const c = ctx({ style: { ...dateDefaults('full'), look: 'switch' } })
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('checkbox'), c)
+    const color = trailing(rows, 'Color')
+    if (color.kind !== 'color') throw new Error('Color is no swatch')
+    expect(color.css).toContain('var(--checkbox-base)')
+    color.onPick('blue-1')
+    pick(rows, 'Style', 'checkbox')
+    expect(c.configure).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ checkbox_color: 'blue-1' })
+    expect(c.setStyle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ look: 'checkbox' })
+  })
+
+  it('a File offers its directory field and nothing else', () => {
+    const rows = rowsFor(def('file'), ctx())
+    expect(shown(rows)).toEqual(['Directory'])
+    expect(trailing(rows, 'Directory').kind).toBe('field')
+  })
+
+  it('only the Date rows carry glyphs, and the option types, Text, and Context answer none', () => {
+    for (const type of ['number', 'link', 'checkbox', 'file'] as const)
+      expect(items(rowsFor(def(type), ctx())).every((r) => r.icon === undefined)).toBe(true)
+    expect(items(rowsFor(def('dateTime'), ctx())).every((r) => r.icon !== undefined)).toBe(true)
+    for (const type of ['select', 'multiSelect', 'status', 'text', 'context'] as const)
+      expect(rowsFor(def(type), ctx())).toEqual([])
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Testing/hostFs.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { SIDECAR_FILENAME } from '../Paths/nexusPaths'
+import { join } from '../Paths/posix'
+import { orderedDefs, readRegistry } from '../Properties/propertiesRegistry'
+import { FIXTURE_DEFS, STATUS_DEF } from './definitions'
+import { readJsonAt, seedNexus, tempRoot } from './hostFs'
+
+let root: string
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+describe('seedNexus', () => {
+  it('seeds a registry that reads back in the order given, and a Collection folder’s assignment under the folder’s name', async () => {
+    root = tempRoot('pom-seed-')
+    const when = FIXTURE_DEFS.prop_when
+    await seedNexus(root, { defs: [when, STATUS_DEF], assigned: { Notes: [STATUS_DEF.id] } })
+    expect(orderedDefs(await readRegistry(root))).toEqual([when, STATUS_DEF])
+    expect(await readJsonAt(join(root, 'Notes', SIDECAR_FILENAME.collection))).toEqual({
+      id: 'Notes',
+      properties: ['prop_status'],
+    })
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Trash/deleteReach.test.ts diff
+      expect(await readNotes(root)).toEqual({})
```

```/Core/Trash/spend.test.ts diff
+    })
+    if (!again.ok) throw new Error('setup failed')
+    expect((await empty()).ok).toBe(true)
```

##### Core/Views/valueKinds.test.ts

```/Core/Views/valueKinds.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import type { DateGranularity } from './views'
+import { CREATABLE_TYPES } from '../Properties/properties'
+import { groupable, VALUE_KINDS } from './valueKinds'
+
+const bucket = (iso: string, g: DateGranularity) =>
+  VALUE_KINDS.dateTime.bucket?.({ kind: 'dateTime', value: iso }, g)
+
+describe('groupable', () => {
+  it('groups by Select, Status and Date only', () => {
+    expect(CREATABLE_TYPES.filter(groupable)).toEqual(['dateTime', 'select', 'status'])
+  })
+})
+
+describe('the Date bucket', () => {
+  it('formats month and year keys (zero-padded, lexicographically chronological)', () => {
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-15T12:00:00Z', 'month')).toBe('2026-06')
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-15T12:00:00Z', 'year')).toBe('2026')
+  })
+
+  it('formats day and week keys with the right shape', () => {
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-15T12:00:00Z', 'day')).toMatch(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-15T12:00:00Z', 'week')).toMatch(/^\d{4}-W\d{2}$/)
+  })
+
+  it('returns null for an unparseable date', () => {
+    expect(bucket('not-a-date', 'month')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('buckets a date-only value by its stored calendar date in any timezone', () => {
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-27', 'day')).toBe('2026-06-27')
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-27', 'month')).toBe('2026-06')
+    expect(bucket('2026-06-27', 'year')).toBe('2026')
+    // 2026-01-01 is a Thursday → ISO week 1; 2025-12-31 (Wed) shares it (its Thursday is Jan 1).
+    expect(bucket('2026-01-01', 'week')).toBe('2026-W01')
+    expect(bucket('2025-12-31', 'week')).toBe('2026-W01')
+  })
+
+  it('buckets a zoned value by the local day its cell shows', () => {
+    const lateEvening = new Date(2026, 5, 14, 23, 30)
+    expect(bucket(lateEvening.toISOString(), 'day')).toBe('2026-06-14')
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Views/Pipeline/group.test.ts diff
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-07', 'month', 'dayMonthYear', 'dash')).toBe('07-2026')
+  })
+
+  it('day buckets ride formatDate; dash swaps numeric separators', () => {
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-07-09', 'day', 'monthDayYear', 'dash')).toBe('07-09-2026')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-07-09', 'day', 'monthDayYear', 'slash')).toBe('07/09/2026')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-07-09', 'day', 'full', 'dash')).toBe('July 9th, 2026')
+  })
+
+  it('year + week buckets', () => {
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026', 'year', 'full', 'dash')).toBe('2026')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-W28', 'week', 'full', 'dash')).toBe('Week 28, 2026')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-W28', 'week', 'monthDayYear', 'dash')).toBe('W28-2026')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('2026-W28', 'week', 'monthDayYear', 'slash')).toBe('W28/2026')
+  })
+
+  it('unparseable keys fall back raw', () => {
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('junk', 'month', 'full', 'dash')).toBe('junk')
+    expect(formatBucketLabel('junk', 'week', 'monthDayYear', 'slash')).toBe('junk')
+  })
+})
```

##### UIX/Menus/paneDrop.test.ts

```/UIX/Menus/paneDrop.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import type { Geometry, Row } from '../Interactions/reorderModel'
+import { menuDropLine } from './MenuRows'
+import { type PaneDrop, paneSpec } from './paneDrop'
+
+const r = (id: string, top: number, bottom: number): Row => ({
+  id,
+  top,
+  bottom,
+  mid: (top + bottom) / 2,
+  left: 0,
+  right: 100,
+})
+
+const geometry = (rows: Row[], regions: Record<string, [number, number]>): Geometry => ({
+  rows,
+  groups: new Map(
+    Object.entries(regions).map(([key, [top, bottom]]) => [key, r(key, top, bottom)]),
+  ),
+  bottom: 200,
+})
+
+function drive(
+  input: { members: string[]; ordersRest: boolean; pinned?: string },
+  g: Geometry,
+  id: string,
+  y: number,
+) {
+  const onDrop = vi.fn<(drop: PaneDrop) => void>()
+  const spec = paneSpec({
+    ...input,
+    titles: { members: 'Assigned', rest: 'All' },
+    label: (x) => x,
+    glyph: () => null,
+    onDrop,
+    watch: [],
+  })
+  const s = spec.snap(id, g)
+  const slot = s && spec.resolve(id, { x: 0, y }, s)
+  if (s && slot) spec.commit(id, slot, s)
+  return {
+    slot,
+    line: s && slot ? spec.line?.(slot, s) : undefined,
+    drop: onDrop.mock.calls[0]?.[0],
+  }
+}
+
+describe('paneSpec — the schema pane', () => {
+  // a* = members, x* = the rest
+  const g = geometry([r('a1', 10, 30), r('a2', 30, 50), r('x1', 70, 90), r('x2', 90, 110)], {
+    members: [10, 50],
+    rest: [70, 110],
+  })
+  const pane = { members: ['a1', 'a2'], ordersRest: true }
+  const at = (id: string, y: number) => drive(pane, g, id, y)
+
+  it('a release below the pane writes nothing', () => {
+    expect(at('a2', 650).drop).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(at('x1', 650).drop).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('members→members reorders at the slot', () => {
+    const s = at('a2', 15)
+    expect(s.drop).toEqual({ kind: 'reorder-members', id: 'a2', toIndex: 0 })
+    expect(s.line).toEqual(menuDropLine({ edge: 10 }))
+  })
+
+  it('members→the rest leaves with the area highlight and NO line', () => {
+    const s = at('a1', 80)
+    expect(s.slot).toBe('leave')
+    expect(s.drop).toEqual({ kind: 'leave', id: 'a1' })
+    expect(s.line).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('the rest→members joins at the slot with a line', () => {
+    const s = at('x1', 30)
+    expect(s.drop).toEqual({ kind: 'join', id: 'x1', toIndex: 1 })
+    expect(s.line).toEqual(menuDropLine({ edge: 30 }))
+  })
+
+  it('the rest→the rest reorders the full order', () => {
+    expect(at('x1', 105).drop).toEqual({ kind: 'reorder-rest', id: 'x1', toIndex: 1 })
+  })
+
+  it('clamps a release outside both regions to the nearest lane', () => {
+    expect(at('a1', 200).slot).toBe('leave')
+    expect(at('a1', 55).drop).toEqual({ kind: 'reorder-members', id: 'a1', toIndex: 1 })
+  })
+
+  it('the members lane owns the space down to the rest heading, both directions', () => {
+    const tall = geometry([r('a1', 10, 30), r('a2', 30, 50), r('x1', 180, 200)], {
+      members: [10, 150],
+      rest: [150, 200],
+    })
+    const drop = (id: string, y: number) => drive(pane, tall, id, y).drop
+    expect(drop('a1', 120)).toEqual({ kind: 'reorder-members', id: 'a1', toIndex: 1 })
+    expect(drop('x1', 120)).toEqual({ kind: 'join', id: 'x1', toIndex: 2 })
+  })
+
+  it('an empty target region still yields the slot at its top (a join into an empty members lane)', () => {
+    const only = geometry([r('x1', 70, 90)], { members: [10, 50], rest: [70, 110] })
+    const s = drive({ members: [], ordersRest: true }, only, 'x1', 20)
+    expect(s.drop).toEqual({ kind: 'join', id: 'x1', toIndex: 0 })
+    expect(s.line).toEqual(menuDropLine({ edge: 10 }))
+  })
+})
+
+describe('paneSpec — the visibility pane', () => {
+  const g = geometry([r('a', 0, 20), r('b', 20, 40), r('h', 60, 80)], {
+    members: [0, 50],
+    rest: [50, 100],
+  })
+  const pane = { members: ['a', 'b'], ordersRest: false, pinned: 'pinned' }
+  const at = (id: string, y: number) => drive(pane, g, id, y)
+
+  it('reorders a shown row within the properties region', () => {
+    expect(at('a', 35).drop).toEqual({ kind: 'reorder-members', id: 'a', toIndex: 1 })
+  })
+
+  it('unhides a hidden row dragged into the properties region', () => {
+    expect(at('h', 5).drop).toEqual({ kind: 'join', id: 'h', toIndex: 0 })
+  })
+
+  it('hides a shown row dropped in the hidden zone — membership drop: highlight, no line', () => {
+    const s = at('a', 70)
+    expect(s.drop).toEqual({ kind: 'leave', id: 'a' })
+    expect(s.line).toBeNull()
+    expect(s.slot).toBe('leave')
+  })
+
+  it('keeps a hidden row inert over its own zone — no reorder within hidden', () => {
+    expect(at('h', 70).slot).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('never hides the pinned row — a drop into the hidden zone is a no-op', () => {
+    const withTitle = geometry([r('pinned', 0, 20), r('b', 20, 40), r('h', 60, 80)], {
+      members: [0, 50],
+      rest: [50, 100],
+    })
+    const s = drive({ ...pane, members: ['pinned', 'b'] }, withTitle, 'pinned', 70)
+    expect(s.slot).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('clamps below the rows to the hidden zone; outside the pane resolves nothing', () => {
+    expect(at('a', -10).slot).toBeNull()
+    expect(at('a', 150).slot).toBe('leave')
+    expect(at('a', 650).slot).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('never highlights during a positional drop in the shown zone', () => {
+    expect(at('h', 35).slot).not.toBe('leave')
+  })
+
+  it('steps into the hidden zone under its own title; row slots name their row', () => {
+    const spec = paneSpec({
+      ...pane,
+      titles: { members: 'Shown Properties', rest: 'Hidden Properties' },
+      label: (x) => x,
+      glyph: () => null,
+      onDrop: vi.fn(),
+      watch: [],
+    })
+    const s = spec.snap('a', g)!
+    const into = spec.step?.('leave', s)
+    expect(into?.part).toBe('into')
+    expect(into && spec.label(into.id)).toBe('Hidden Properties')
+    expect(spec.step?.(spec.resolve('a', { x: 0, y: 35 }, s)!, s)).toBeNull()
+  })
+})
```
